export function validateBundle(input: unknown): Session {
  const { session } = sessionBundleSchema.parse(input);
  const names = new Set<string>();
  const threadIds = new Set<string>();
  const episodeIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    if (names.has(thread.name) || threadIds.has(thread.thread_id)) throw new Error("Imported thread names and ids must be unique");

    for (const [index, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
      if (episode.thread_id !== thread.thread_id || episode.sequence !== index + 1) throw new Error("Imported episodes must have matching thread ids and gap-free sequences");
      if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) throw new Error("Imported episode ids must be unique");

    }

  return session;

```typescript
import { z } from "zod";
import { episodeSchema, errorSchema, sessionConfigSchema, threadSchema, usageSchema, type Session } from "./models";

const toolCallSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  arguments: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())
}).strict();

const messageSchema = z.object({
  role: z.enum(["system", "user", "assistant", "tool"]),
  content: z.string(),
  tool_calls: z.array(toolCallSchema).optional(),
  tool_call_id: z.string().optional()
}).strict();

const callResultSchema = z.object({
  call_id: z.string(),
  thread_name: z.string(),
  status: z.enum(["complete", "partial", "failed", "skipped"]),
  episode: episodeSchema.optional(),
  error: errorSchema.optional(),
  failed_dependencies: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  duration_ms: z.number().finite().nonnegative(),
  token_usage: usageSchema
}).strict();

const batchReportSchema = z.object({
  batch_id: z.string(),
  rationale: z.string(),
  started_at: z.string().datetime(),
  finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  status: z.enum(["running", "complete"]),
  calls: z.array(callResultSchema),
  counts: z.object({
    complete: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    partial: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    failed: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    skipped: z.number().int().nonnegative()
  }).strict(),
  token_usage: usageSchema,
  duration_ms: z.number().finite().nonnegative()
}).strict();

const runSchema = z.object({
  run_id: z.string(),
  prompt: z.string(),
  started_at: z.string().datetime(),
  finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  status: z.enum(["running", "complete", "failed", "cancelled"]),
  phase: z.enum(["planning", "dispatching", "finished"]),
  model: z.string(),
  batches: z.array(batchReportSchema),
  token_usage: usageSchema,
  final_answer: z.string().optional(),
  error: errorSchema.optional(),
  cancel_requested: z.boolean(),
  heartbeat_at: z.string().datetime()
}).strict();

const steeringSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  text: z.string().max(12000),
  thread_name: z.string().optional(),
  queued_at: z.string().datetime(),
  consumed_at: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  consumption_point: z.string().optional()
}).strict();

const eventSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: z.string(),
  message: z.string(),
  created_at: z.string().datetime(),
  session_id: z.string(),
  run_id: z.string().optional(),
  batch_id: z.string().optional(),
  call_id: z.string().optional(),
  thread_id: z.string().optional(),
  episode_id: z.string().optional(),
  details: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional()
}).strict();

export const sessionBundleSchema = z.object({
  format: z.literal("nested-session"),
  version: z.literal(1),
  exported_at: z.string().datetime(),
  session: z.object({
    id: z.string().regex(/^ses_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/),
    name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100),
    created_at: z.string().datetime(),
    updated_at: z.string().datetime(),
    data: z.object({
      threads: z.array(threadSchema).max(1000),
      runs: z.array(runSchema).max(10000),
      steering: z.array(steeringSchema).max(10000),
      messages: z.array(messageSchema).max(100000),
      events: z.array(eventSchema).max(1000000),
      config: sessionConfigSchema,
      description: z.string().max(24000)
    }).strict()
  }).strict()
}).strict();

export function validateBundle(input: unknown): Session {
  const { session } = sessionBundleSchema.parse(input);
  const names = new Set<string>();
  const threadIds = new Set<string>();
  const episodeIds = new Set<string>();

  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    if (names.has(thread.name) || threadIds.has(thread.thread_id)) {
      throw new Error("Imported thread names and ids must be unique");
    }

    names.add(thread.name);
    threadIds.add(thread.thread_id);

    for (const [index, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
      if (
        episode.thread_id !== thread.thread_id ||
        episode.sequence !== index + 1
      ) {
        throw new Error("Imported episodes must have matching thread ids and gap-free sequences");
      }

      if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) {
        throw new Error("Imported episode ids must be unique");
      }

      episodeIds.add(episode.episode_id);
    }
  }

  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    for (const episode of thread.episodes) {
      for (const ref of episode.source_episode_refs) {
        if (!episodeIds.has(ref)) {
          throw new Error(`Imported source episode reference is missing: ${ref}`);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return session;
}
```

```typescript
    for (const [threadIndex, thread] of session.data.threads.entries()) {
      if (threadNames.has(thread.name)) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate thread name: ${thread.name}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "name"] });
      }
      threadNames.add(thread.name);
      if (threadIds.has(thread.thread_id)) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate thread id: ${thread.thread_id}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "thread_id"] });
      }
      threadIds.add(thread.thread_id);
      for (const [episodeIndex, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
        if (episode.thread_id !== thread.thread_id) {
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Episode ${episode.episode_id} declares thread id ${episode.thread_id} but is nested under thread ${thread.thread_id}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "episodes", episodeIndex, "thread_id"] });
        }
        if (episode.sequence !== episodeIndex + 1) {
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Episode ${episode.episode_id} has sequence ${episode.sequence} but occupies position ${episodeIndex + 1} in thread ${thread.thread_id}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "episodes", episodeIndex, "sequence"] });
        }
        if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) {
          ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate episode id: ${episode.episode_id}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "episodes", episodeIndex, "episode_id"] });
        }
        episodeIds.add(episode.episode_id);
      }
    }
    for (const [threadIndex, thread] of session.data.threads.entries()) {
      for (const [episodeIndex, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
        for (const [refIndex, ref] of episode.source_episode_refs.entries()) {
          if (ref === episode.episode_id) {

          } else if (!episodeIds.has(ref)) {
            ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Source episode reference is missing: ${ref}`, path: ["data", "threads", threadIndex, "episodes", episodeIndex, "source_episode_refs", refIndex] });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    const runIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const [runIndex, run] of session.data.runs.entries()) {
      if (runIds.has(run.run_id)) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate run id: ${run.run_id}`, path: ["data", "runs", runIndex, "run_id"] });
      }
      runIds.add(run.run_id);
    }
    const steeringIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const [steeringIndex, steering] of session.data.steering.entries()) {
      if (steeringIds.has(steering.id)) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate steering id: ${steering.id}`, path: ["data", "steering", steeringIndex, "id"] });
      }
      steeringIds.add(steering.id);
    }
    const eventIds = new Set<string>();
    for (const [eventIndex, sessionEvent] of session.data.events.entries()) {
      if (eventIds.has(sessionEvent.id)) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Duplicate event id: ${sessionEvent.id}`, path: ["data", "events", eventIndex, "id"] });
      }
      eventIds.add(sessionEvent.id);
      if (sessionEvent.session_id !== session.id) {
        ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", message: `Event ${sessionEvent.id} belongs to session ${sessionEvent.session_id} but the bundle session id is ${session.id}`, path: ["data", "events", eventIndex, "session_id"] });
      }

export const sessionBundleSchema = z
  .object({
    format: z.literal("nested-session"),
    version: z.literal(1),
    exported_at: z.string().datetime(),
    session: sessionSchema,
  })
  .strict();

export function validateBundle(input: unknown): Session {
  const { session } = sessionBundleSchema.parse(input);
  return session;
}
```

```ts
import { episodeSchema, errorSchema, sessionConfigSchema, threadSchema, usageSchema, type Session } from "./models";

const toolCallSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), arguments: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) }).strict();

const callResultSchema = z.object({ call_id: z.string(), thread_name: z.string(), status: z.enum(["complete", "partial", "failed", "skipped"]), episode: episodeSchema.optional(), error: errorSchema.optional(), failed_dependencies: z.array(z.string()).optional(), duration_ms: z.number().nonnegative(), token_usage: usageSchema }).strict();
const batchReportSchema = z.object({ batch_id: z.string(), rationale: z.string(), started_at: z.string().datetime(), finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), status: z.enum(["running", "complete"]), calls: z.array(callResultSchema), counts: z.object({ complete: z.number().int().nonnegative(), partial: z.number().int().nonnegative(), failed: z.number().int().nonnegative(), skipped: z.number().int().nonnegative() }).strict(), token_usage: usageSchema, duration_ms: z.number().nonnegative() }).strict();
const runSchema = z.object({ run_id: z.string(), prompt: z.string(), started_at: z.string().datetime(), finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), status: z.enum(["running", "complete", "failed", "cancelled"]), phase: z.enum(["planning", "dispatching", "finished"]), model: z.string(), batches: z.array(batchReportSchema), token_usage: usageSchema, final_answer: z.string().optional(), error: errorSchema.optional(), cancel_requested: z.boolean(), heartbeat_at: z.string().datetime() }).strict();
const steeringSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), text: z.string().max(12000), thread_name: z.string().optional(), queued_at: z.string().datetime(), consumed_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), consumption_point: z.string().optional() }).strict();
const eventSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), type: z.string(), message: z.string(), created_at: z.string().datetime(), session_id: z.string(), run_id: z.string().optional(), batch_id: z.string().optional(), call_id: z.string().optional(), thread_id: z.string().optional(), episode_id: z.string().optional(), details: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional() }).strict();
export const sessionBundleSchema = z.object({ format: z.literal("nested-session"), version: z.literal(1), exported_at: z.string().datetime(), session: z.object({ id: z.string().regex(/^ses_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/), name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100), created_at: z.string().datetime(), updated_at: z.string().datetime(), data: z.object({ threads: z.array(threadSchema).max(1000), runs: z.array(runSchema).max(10000), steering: z.array(steeringSchema).max(10000), messages: z.array(messageSchema).max(100000), events: z.array(eventSchema).max(1000000), config: sessionConfigSchema, description: z.string().max(24000) }).strict() }).strict() }).strict();
export function validateBundle(input: unknown): Session {
  const { session } = sessionBundleSchema.parse(input);
  const names = new Set<string>();
  const threadIds = new Set<string>();
  const episodeIds = new Set<string>();
  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    if (names.has(thread.name) || threadIds.has(thread.thread_id)) throw new Error("Imported thread names and ids must be unique");
    names.add(thread.name); threadIds.add(thread.thread_id);
    for (const [index, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
      if (episode.thread_id !== thread.thread_id || episode.sequence !== index + 1) throw new Error("Imported episodes must have matching thread ids and gap-free sequences");
      if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) throw new Error("Imported episode ids must be unique");
      episodeIds.add(episode.episode_id);
    }
  }
  for (const thread of session.data.threads) for (const episode of thread.episodes) for (const ref of episode.source_episode_refs) if (!episodeIds.has(ref)) throw new Error(`Imported source episode reference is missing: ${ref}`);
  return session;
}
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { episodeSchema, errorSchema, sessionConfigSchema, threadSchema, usageSchema, type Session } from "./models";

type JsonValue = string | number | boolean | null | JsonValue[] | { [key: string]: JsonValue };
type IssuePath = Array<string | number>;

function addIssue(ctx: z.RefinementCtx, path: IssuePath, message: string): void {
  ctx.addIssue({ code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom, path, message });
}

function addDateOrderIssue(ctx: z.RefinementCtx, earlier: string, later: string | undefined, laterPath: IssuePath, message: string): void {
  if (later !== undefined && Date.parse(later) < Date.parse(earlier)) addIssue(ctx, laterPath, message);
}

function addDateCeilingIssue(ctx: z.RefinementCtx, value: string | undefined, ceiling: string | undefined, valuePath: IssuePath, message: string): void {
  if (value !== undefined && ceiling !== undefined && Date.parse(value) > Date.parse(ceiling)) addIssue(ctx, valuePath, message);
}

function valuesDeepEqual(left: unknown, right: unknown): boolean {
  if (Object.is(left, right)) return true;
  if (left instanceof Date || right instanceof Date) return left instanceof Date && right instanceof Date && left.getTime() === right.getTime();
  if (typeof left !== typeof right) return false;
  if (left === null || right === null) return false;
  if (Array.isArray(left) || Array.isArray(right)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(left) || !Array.isArray(right) || left.length !== right.length) return false;
    for (let index = 0; index < left.length; index += 1) if (!valuesDeepEqual(left[index], right[index])) return false;
    return true;
  }
  if (typeof left === "object" && typeof right === "object") {
    const leftRecord = left as Record<string, unknown>;
    const rightRecord = right as Record<string, unknown>;
    const leftKeys = Object.keys(leftRecord);
    const rightKeys = Object.keys(rightRecord);
    if (leftKeys.length !== rightKeys.length) return false;
    for (const key of leftKeys) {
      if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rightRecord, key)) return false;
      if (!valuesDeepEqual(leftRecord[key], rightRecord[key])) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

const jsonValueSchema: z.ZodType<JsonValue> = z.lazy(() => z.union([z.string(), z.number().finite(), z.boolean(), z.null(), z.array(jsonValueSchema), z.record(z.string(), jsonValueSchema)]));
const nonEmptyStringSchema = z.string().min(1);
const nonnegativeFiniteNumberSchema = z.number().finite().nonnegative();
const nonnegativeIntegerSchema = z.number().finite().int().nonnegative();
const callStatusSchema = z.enum(["complete", "partial", "failed", "skipped"]);

const toolCallSchema = z.object({ id: nonEmptyStringSchema, name: nonEmptyStringSchema, arguments: z.record(z.string(), jsonValueSchema) }).strict();
const messageSchema = z.object({ role: z.enum(["system", "user", "assistant", "tool"]), content: z.string(), tool_calls: z.array(toolCallSchema).min(1).optional(), tool_call_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional() }).strict().superRefine((message, ctx) => {
  if (message.role === "tool") {
    if (message.tool_call_id === undefined) addIssue(ctx, ["tool_call_id"], "Tool messages must include tool_call_id");
  } else if (message.tool_call_id !== undefined) {
    addIssue(ctx, ["tool_call_id"], "Only tool messages can include tool_call_id");
  }
  if (message.role !== "assistant" && message.tool_calls !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, ["tool_calls"], "Only assistant messages can include tool_calls");
});
const callResultSchema = z.object({ call_id: nonEmptyStringSchema, thread_name: nonEmptyStringSchema, status: callStatusSchema, episode: episodeSchema.optional(), error: errorSchema.optional(), failed_dependencies: z.array(nonEmptyStringSchema).optional(), duration_ms: nonnegativeFiniteNumberSchema, token_usage: usageSchema }).strict();
const batchReportSchema = z.object({ batch_id: nonEmptyStringSchema, rationale: z.string(), started_at: z.string().datetime(), finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), status: z.enum(["running", "complete"]), calls: z.array(callResultSchema), counts: z.object({ complete: nonnegativeIntegerSchema, partial: nonnegativeIntegerSchema, failed: nonnegativeIntegerSchema, skipped: nonnegativeIntegerSchema }).strict(), token_usage: usageSchema, duration_ms: nonnegativeFiniteNumberSchema }).strict();
const runSchema = z.object({ run_id: nonEmptyStringSchema, prompt: z.string(), started_at: z.string().datetime(), finished_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), status: z.enum(["running", "complete", "failed", "cancelled"]), phase: z.enum(["planning", "dispatching", "finished"]), model: nonEmptyStringSchema, batches: z.array(batchReportSchema), token_usage: usageSchema, final_answer: z.string().optional(), error: errorSchema.optional(), cancel_requested: z.boolean(), heartbeat_at: z.string().datetime() }).strict();
const steeringSchema = z.object({ id: nonEmptyStringSchema, text: z.string().max(12000), thread_name: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), queued_at: z.string().datetime(), consumed_at: z.string().datetime().optional(), consumption_point: z.string().optional() }).strict();
const eventSchema = z.object({ id: nonEmptyStringSchema, type: nonEmptyStringSchema, message: z.string(), created_at: z.string().datetime(), session_id: nonEmptyStringSchema, run_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), batch_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), call_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), thread_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), episode_id: nonEmptyStringSchema.optional(), details: z.record(z.string(), jsonValueSchema).optional() }).strict();

const baseSessionBundleSchema = z.object({ format: z.literal("nested-session"), version: z.literal(1), exported_at: z.string().datetime(), session: z.object({ id: z.string().regex(/^ses_[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/), name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100), created_at: z.string().datetime(), updated_at: z.string().datetime(), data: z.object({ threads: z.array(threadSchema).max(1000), runs: z.array(runSchema).max(10000), steering: z.array(steeringSchema).max(10000), messages: z.array(messageSchema).max(100000), events: z.array(eventSchema).max(1000000), config: sessionConfigSchema, description: z.string().max(24000) }).strict() }).strict() }).strict();

type ParsedSessionBundle = z.infer<typeof baseSessionBundleSchema>;
type CallStatus = z.infer<typeof callStatusSchema>;
type EpisodeInfo = { threadId: string; sequence: number; episode: unknown };
type BatchInfo = { runId: string };
type CallInfo = { batchId: string; threadName: string; status: CallStatus };

function validateParsedBundle(bundle: ParsedSessionBundle, ctx: z.RefinementCtx): void {
  const session = bundle.session;
  const data = session.data;
  const threadNames = new Set<string>();
  const threadIds = new Set<string>();
  const threadNameToThreadId = new Map<string, string>();
  const episodeIds = new Set<string>();
  const episodeInfoById = new Map<string, EpisodeInfo>();
  const runIds = new Set<string>();
  const batchIds = new Set<string>();
  const batchInfoById = new Map<string, BatchInfo>();
  const callIds = new Set<string>();
  const callInfoById = new Map<string, CallInfo>();
  const steeringIds = new Set<string>();
  const eventIds = new Set<string>();
  const assistantToolCallIds = new Set<string>();
  const toolResponseIds = new Set<string>();

  addDateOrderIssue(ctx, session.created_at, session.updated_at, ["session", "updated_at"], "Imported session updated_at must not be earlier than created_at");
  addDateOrderIssue(ctx, session.created_at, bundle.exported_at, ["exported_at"], "Imported bundle exported_at must not be earlier than session created_at");
  addDateOrderIssue(ctx, session.updated_at, bundle.exported_at, ["exported_at"], "Imported bundle exported_at must not be earlier than session updated_at");

  for (const [threadIndex, thread] of data.threads.entries()) {
    const threadPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "threads", threadIndex];

    if (threadNames.has(thread.name)) addIssue(ctx, [...threadPath, "name"], "Imported thread names must be unique");
    else {
      threadNames.add(thread.name);
      threadNameToThreadId.set(thread.name, thread.thread_id);
    }

    if (threadIds.has(thread.thread_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...threadPath, "thread_id"], "Imported thread ids must be unique");
    else threadIds.add(thread.thread_id);

    for (const [episodeIndex, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
      const episodePath: IssuePath = [...threadPath, "episodes", episodeIndex];

      if (episode.thread_id !== thread.thread_id) addIssue(ctx, [...episodePath, "thread_id"], "Imported episodes must have matching thread ids");
      if (episode.sequence !== episodeIndex + 1) addIssue(ctx, [...episodePath, "sequence"], "Imported episodes must have gap-free one-based sequences");

      if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...episodePath, "episode_id"], "Imported episode ids must be unique");
      else {
        episodeIds.add(episode.episode_id);
        episodeInfoById.set(episode.episode_id, { threadId: episode.thread_id, sequence: episode.sequence, episode });
      }
    }
  }

  for (const [threadIndex, thread] of data.threads.entries()) {
    const threadPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "threads", threadIndex];
    for (const [episodeIndex, episode] of thread.episodes.entries()) {
      const episodePath: IssuePath = [...threadPath, "episodes", episodeIndex];
      const sourceEpisodeRefs = episode.source_episode_refs ?? [];
      const seenSourceRefs = new Set<string>();

      for (const [sourceIndex, ref] of sourceEpisodeRefs.entries()) {
        const sourcePath: IssuePath = [...episodePath, "source_episode_refs", sourceIndex];
        const referencedEpisode = episodeInfoById.get(ref);

        if (seenSourceRefs.has(ref)) addIssue(ctx, sourcePath, "Imported source episode references must be unique within an episode");
        else seenSourceRefs.add(ref);

        if (referencedEpisode === undefined) addIssue(ctx, sourcePath, `Imported source episode reference is missing: ${ref}`);
        else if (referencedEpisode.threadId === episode.thread_id && referencedEpisode.sequence >= episode.sequence) addIssue(ctx, sourcePath, "Imported source episode references in the same thread must point to earlier episodes");
      }
    }
  }

  for (const [runIndex, run] of data.runs.entries()) {
    const runPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "runs", runIndex];

    if (runIds.has(run.run_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "run_id"], "Imported run ids must be unique");
    else runIds.add(run.run_id);

    addDateOrderIssue(ctx, run.started_at, run.finished_at, [...runPath, "finished_at"], "Imported run finished_at must not be earlier than started_at");
    addDateOrderIssue(ctx, run.started_at, run.heartbeat_at, [...runPath, "heartbeat_at"], "Imported run heartbeat_at must not be earlier than started_at");
    addDateCeilingIssue(ctx, run.heartbeat_at, run.finished_at, [...runPath, "heartbeat_at"], "Imported run heartbeat_at must not be later than finished_at");

    if (run.status === "running") {
      if (run.finished_at !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "finished_at"], "Imported running runs must not have finished_at");
      if (run.phase === "finished") addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "phase"], "Imported running runs must not have finished phase");
    } else {
      if (run.finished_at === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "finished_at"], "Imported terminal runs must have finished_at");
      if (run.phase !== "finished") addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "phase"], "Imported terminal runs must have finished phase");
    }

    if (run.status === "failed") {
      if (run.error === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "error"], "Imported failed runs must include an error");
    } else if ((run.status === "running" || run.status === "complete") && run.error !== undefined) {
      addIssue(ctx, [...runPath, "error"], "Imported running and complete runs must not include an error");
    }

    for (const [batchIndex, batch] of run.batches.entries()) {
      const batchPath: IssuePath = [...runPath, "batches", batchIndex];

      if (batchIds.has(batch.batch_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...batchPath, "batch_id"], "Imported batch ids must be unique");
      else {
        batchIds.add(batch.batch_id);
        batchInfoById.set(batch.batch_id, { runId: run.run_id });
      }

      addDateOrderIssue(ctx, run.started_at, batch.started_at, [...batchPath, "started_at"], "Imported batch started_at must not be earlier than its run started_at");
      addDateOrderIssue(ctx, batch.started_at, batch.finished_at, [...batchPath, "finished_at"], "Imported batch finished_at must not be earlier than started_at");
      addDateCeilingIssue(ctx, batch.finished_at, run.finished_at, [...batchPath, "finished_at"], "Imported batch finished_at must not be later than its run finished_at");

      if (batch.status === "running") {
        if (batch.finished_at !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...batchPath, "finished_at"], "Imported running batches must not have finished_at");
      } else if (batch.finished_at === undefined) {
        addIssue(ctx, [...batchPath, "finished_at"], "Imported complete batches must have finished_at");
      }

      if (run.status !== "running" && batch.status === "running") addIssue(ctx, [...batchPath, "status"], "Imported terminal runs must not contain running batches");

      const counts = { complete: 0, partial: 0, failed: 0, skipped: 0 };

      for (const [callIndex, call] of batch.calls.entries()) {
        const callPath: IssuePath = [...batchPath, "calls", callIndex];
        counts[call.status] += 1;

        if (callIds.has(call.call_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "call_id"], "Imported call ids must be unique");
        else {
          callIds.add(call.call_id);
          callInfoById.set(call.call_id, { batchId: batch.batch_id, threadName: call.thread_name, status: call.status });
        }

        const expectedThreadId = threadNameToThreadId.get(call.thread_name);
        if (expectedThreadId === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "thread_name"], `Imported call references missing thread name: ${call.thread_name}`);

        if (call.status === "complete") {
          if (call.episode === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode"], "Imported complete calls must include an episode");
          if (call.error !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "error"], "Imported complete calls must not include an error");
          if ((call.failed_dependencies ?? []).length > 0) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "failed_dependencies"], "Imported complete calls must not include failed dependencies");
        } else if (call.status === "partial") {
          if (call.episode === undefined && call.error === undefined) addIssue(ctx, callPath, "Imported partial calls must include an episode or an error");
        } else if (call.status === "failed") {
          if (call.error === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "error"], "Imported failed calls must include an error");
          if (call.episode !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode"], "Imported failed calls must not include an episode");
        } else {
          if (call.episode !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode"], "Imported skipped calls must not include an episode");
          if (call.failed_dependencies === undefined || call.failed_dependencies.length === 0) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "failed_dependencies"], "Imported skipped calls must include failed dependencies");
        }

        if (call.episode !== undefined) {
          if (expectedThreadId !== undefined && call.episode.thread_id !== expectedThreadId) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode", "thread_id"], "Imported call result episode thread_id must match call thread_name");
          const canonicalEpisode = episodeInfoById.get(call.episode.episode_id);
          if (canonicalEpisode === undefined) {
            addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode", "episode_id"], "Imported call result episode must exist in session threads");
          } else {
            if (call.episode.thread_id !== canonicalEpisode.threadId) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode", "thread_id"], "Imported call result episode thread_id must match the stored episode");
            if (call.episode.sequence !== canonicalEpisode.sequence) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode", "sequence"], "Imported call result episode sequence must match the stored episode");
            if (!valuesDeepEqual(call.episode, canonicalEpisode.episode)) addIssue(ctx, [...callPath, "episode"], "Imported call result episode must match the episode stored in its thread");
          }
        }
      }

      if (batch.counts.complete !== counts.complete || batch.counts.partial !== counts.partial || batch.counts.failed !== counts.failed || batch.counts.skipped !== counts.skipped) addIssue(ctx, [...batchPath, "counts"], "Imported batch counts must match call statuses");
    }
  }

  for (const [runIndex, run] of data.runs.entries()) {
    const runPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "runs", runIndex];
    for (const [batchIndex, batch] of run.batches.entries()) {
      const batchPath: IssuePath = [...runPath, "batches", batchIndex];
      for (const [callIndex, call] of batch.calls.entries()) {
        if (call.failed_dependencies === undefined) continue;
        const callPath: IssuePath = [...batchPath, "calls", callIndex];
        const seenDependencies = new Set<string>();

        for (const [dependencyIndex, dependency] of call.failed_dependencies.entries()) {
          const dependencyPath: IssuePath = [...callPath, "failed_dependencies", dependencyIndex];
          const dependencyInfo = callInfoById.get(dependency);

          if (seenDependencies.has(dependency)) addIssue(ctx, dependencyPath, "Imported failed dependencies must be unique within a call");
          else seenDependencies.add(dependency);

          if (dependency === call.call_id) addIssue(ctx, dependencyPath, "Imported failed dependencies must not reference the same call");
          if (dependencyInfo === undefined) {
            addIssue(ctx, dependencyPath, `Imported failed dependency is missing: ${dependency}`);
          } else {
            if (dependencyInfo.status === "complete") addIssue(ctx, dependencyPath, "Imported failed dependencies must not reference complete calls");
            const dependencyBatchInfo = batchInfoById.get(dependencyInfo.batchId);
            if (dependencyBatchInfo !== undefined && dependencyBatchInfo.runId !== run.run_id) addIssue(ctx, dependencyPath, "Imported failed dependencies must reference calls in the same run");
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  for (const [steeringIndex, steering] of data.steering.entries()) {
    const steeringPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "steering", steeringIndex];

    if (steeringIds.has(steering.id)) addIssue(ctx, [...steeringPath, "id"], "Imported steering ids must be unique");
    else steeringIds.add(steering.id);

    if (steering.thread_name !== undefined && !threadNameToThreadId.has(steering.thread_name)) addIssue(ctx, [...steeringPath, "thread_name"], `Imported steering references missing thread name: ${steering.thread_name}`);
    addDateOrderIssue(ctx, steering.queued_at, steering.consumed_at, [...steeringPath, "consumed_at"], "Imported steering consumed_at must not be earlier than queued_at");
    if (steering.consumed_at === undefined && steering.consumption_point !== undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...steeringPath, "consumption_point"], "Imported unconsumed steering must not include consumption_point");
  }

  for (const [messageIndex, message] of data.messages.entries()) {
    const messagePath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "messages", messageIndex];

    if (message.role === "assistant" && message.tool_calls !== undefined) {
      for (const [toolCallIndex, toolCall] of message.tool_calls.entries()) {
        const toolCallPath: IssuePath = [...messagePath, "tool_calls", toolCallIndex, "id"];
        if (assistantToolCallIds.has(toolCall.id)) addIssue(ctx, toolCallPath, "Imported assistant tool call ids must be unique");
        else assistantToolCallIds.add(toolCall.id);
      }
    }

    if (message.role === "tool" && message.tool_call_id !== undefined) {
      if (toolResponseIds.has(message.tool_call_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...messagePath, "tool_call_id"], "Imported tool response messages must reference unique tool_call_id values");
      else toolResponseIds.add(message.tool_call_id);
    }
  }

  for (const [messageIndex, message] of data.messages.entries()) {
    if (message.role === "tool" && message.tool_call_id !== undefined && !assistantToolCallIds.has(message.tool_call_id)) addIssue(ctx, ["session", "data", "messages", messageIndex, "tool_call_id"], `Imported tool message references missing assistant tool call: ${message.tool_call_id}`);
  }

  for (const [eventIndex, event] of data.events.entries()) {
    const eventPath: IssuePath = ["session", "data", "events", eventIndex];

    if (eventIds.has(event.id)) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "id"], "Imported event ids must be unique");
    else eventIds.add(event.id);

    if (event.session_id !== session.id) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "session_id"], "Imported event session_id must match imported session id");
    addDateOrderIssue(ctx, session.created_at, event.created_at, [...eventPath, "created_at"], "Imported event created_at must not be earlier than session created_at");
    addDateCeilingIssue(ctx, event.created_at, bundle.exported_at, [...eventPath, "created_at"], "Imported event created_at must not be later than exported_at");

    if (event.run_id !== undefined && !runIds.has(event.run_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "run_id"], `Imported event references missing run id: ${event.run_id}`);

    if (event.batch_id !== undefined) {
      const batchInfo = batchInfoById.get(event.batch_id);
      if (batchInfo === undefined) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "batch_id"], `Imported event references missing batch id: ${event.batch_id}`);
      else if (event.run_id !== undefined && batchInfo.runId !== event.run_id) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "batch_id"], "Imported event batch_id must belong to event run_id");
    }

    if (event.call_id !== undefined) {
      const callInfo = callInfoById.get(event.call_id);
      if (callInfo === undefined) {
        addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "call_id"], `Imported event references missing call id: ${event.call_id}`);
      } else {
        if (event.batch_id !== undefined && callInfo.batchId !== event.batch_id) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "call_id"], "Imported event call_id must belong to event batch_id");
        const callBatchInfo = batchInfoById.get(callInfo.batchId);
        if (event.run_id !== undefined && callBatchInfo !== undefined && callBatchInfo.runId !== event.run_id) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "call_id"], "Imported event call_id must belong to event run_id");
        const callThreadId = threadNameToThreadId.get(callInfo.threadName);
        if (event.thread_id !== undefined && callThreadId !== undefined && event.thread_id !== callThreadId) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "thread_id"], "Imported event thread_id must match event call_id thread");
      }
    }

    if (event.thread_id !== undefined && !threadIds.has(event.thread_id)) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "thread_id"], `Imported event references missing thread id: ${event.thread_id}`);

    if (event.episode_id !== undefined) {
      const episodeInfo = episodeInfoById.get(event.episode_id);
      if (episodeInfo === undefined) {
        addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "episode_id"], `Imported event references missing episode id: ${event.episode_id}`);
      } else {
        if (event.thread_id !== undefined && episodeInfo.threadId !== event.thread_id) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "episode_id"], "Imported event episode_id must belong to event thread_id");
        if (event.call_id !== undefined) {
          const callInfo = callInfoById.get(event.call_id);
          const callThreadId = callInfo === undefined ? undefined : threadNameToThreadId.get(callInfo.threadName);
          if (callThreadId !== undefined && episodeInfo.threadId !== callThreadId) addIssue(ctx, [...eventPath, "episode_id"], "Imported event episode_id must belong to event call_id thread");
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

export const sessionBundleSchema = baseSessionBundleSchema.superRefine((bundle, ctx) => {
  validateParsedBundle(bundle, ctx);
});

export function validateBundle(input: unknown): Session {
  const { session } = sessionBundleSchema.parse(input);
  return session;
}
```

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  let kept = Math.max(0, max - 24);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) kept = Math.max(0, max - ` [truncated ${text.length - kept} chars]`.length);

export function buildContext(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, instructions: string): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {

```typescript
import { tokenCount } from "./providers";
import { WORKER_PROMPT } from "./prompts";
import type { Episode, Message, SessionConfig, Thread } from "./models";

export type SourceEpisode = {
  thread_name: string;
  episode: Episode;
};

type ContextEntry = {
  prefix: string;
  text: string;
  tokens: number;
};

const MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD = 8;
const MIN_HISTORY_CHARACTERS = 80;
const CONTEXT_BUDGET_ERROR_MESSAGE =
  "Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt, requested action, and retained history. Increase the context budget.";

function assertNonNegativeSafeInteger(value: number, name: string): void {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new RangeError(`${name} must be a non-negative safe integer.`);
  }
}

function addTokenCosts(left: number, right: number): number {
  const total = left + right;

  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(total) || total < 0) {
    throw new RangeError(
      "Context token count is outside the supported integer range.",
    );
  }

  return total;
}

function messageTokenCost(content: string): number {
  const count = tokenCount(content);
  assertNonNegativeSafeInteger(count, "tokenCount result");
  return addTokenCosts(count, MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD);
}

function serializeJson(value: unknown): string {
  const serialized = JSON.stringify(value);

  if (typeof serialized !== "string") {
    throw new TypeError("Episode data must serialize to a JSON string.");
  }

  return serialized;
}

function createContextEntry(prefix: string, text: string): ContextEntry {
  return {
    prefix,
    text,
    tokens: messageTokenCost(prefix + text),
  };
}

function safePrefixLength(text: string, length: number): number {
  if (length > 0 && length < text.length) {
    const previous = text.charCodeAt(length - 1);
    const next = text.charCodeAt(length);

    if (
      previous >= 0xd800 &&
      previous <= 0xdbff &&
      next >= 0xdc00 &&
      next <= 0xdfff
    ) {
      return length - 1;
    }
  }

  return length;
}

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (typeof max !== "number") {
    throw new TypeError("max must be a number.");
  }

  if (Number.isNaN(max) || max < 0) {
    throw new RangeError("max must be non-negative and not NaN.");
  }

  const limit = Math.floor(max);

  if (text.length <= limit) {
    return text;
  }

  if (limit === 0) {
    return "";
  }

  const fullMarker = ` [truncated ${text.length} chars]`;

  if (fullMarker.length > limit) {
    const kept = safePrefixLength(text, limit - 1);
    return text.slice(0, kept) + "…";
  }

  let low = 0;
  let high = limit;
  let kept = 0;

  while (low <= high) {
    const middle = low + Math.floor((high - low) / 2);
    const marker = ` [truncated ${text.length - middle} chars]`;

    if (middle + marker.length <= limit) {
      kept = middle;
      low = middle + 1;
    } else {
      high = middle - 1;
    }
  }

  kept = safePrefixLength(text, kept);

  const marker = ` [truncated ${text.length - kept} chars]`;
  return text.slice(0, kept) + marker;
}

function shrinkHistoryEntry(
  entry: ContextEntry,
  targetTokens: number,
): ContextEntry {
  if (
    entry.tokens <= targetTokens ||
    entry.text.length <= MIN_HISTORY_CHARACTERS
  ) {
    return entry;
  }

  const minimumEntry = createContextEntry(
    entry.prefix,
    truncate(entry.text, MIN_HISTORY_CHARACTERS),
  );

  let best = minimumEntry.tokens < entry.tokens ? minimumEntry : entry;
  let hasFittingCandidate = best.tokens <= targetTokens;
  let low = MIN_HISTORY_CHARACTERS + 1;
  let high = entry.text.length - 1;

  while (low <= high) {
    const middle = low + Math.floor((high - low) / 2);
    const candidate = createContextEntry(
      entry.prefix,
      truncate(entry.text, middle),
    );

    if (candidate.tokens <= targetTokens) {
      best = candidate;
      hasFittingCandidate = true;
      low = middle + 1;
    } else {
      if (!hasFittingCandidate && candidate.tokens < best.tokens) {
        best = candidate;
      }

      high = middle - 1;
    }
  }

  return best;
}

export function buildContext(
  thread: Thread,
  action: string,
  sources: SourceEpisode[],
  config: SessionConfig,
  instructions: string,
): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {
  const contextBudget = config.context_budget;
  const maxTokens = config.max_tokens;

  assertNonNegativeSafeInteger(contextBudget, "config.context_budget");
  assertNonNegativeSafeInteger(maxTokens, "config.max_tokens");

  const budget = contextBudget - maxTokens;

  if (budget < 0) {
    throw new Error(CONTEXT_BUDGET_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  const system = `${thread.system_prompt}\n\n${WORKER_PROMPT}\n\nWORKSTREAM: ${thread.name}\nLIMITS: ${config.max_turns} turns, ${Math.min(config.max_tool_calls, thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls)} tool calls, ${config.timeout_sec} seconds. Tool outputs capped at 24000 characters.\n\n${instructions}`;

  const protectedTokens = addTokenCosts(
    messageTokenCost(system),
    messageTokenCost(action),
  );

  if (protectedTokens > budget) {
    throw new Error(CONTEXT_BUDGET_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  const own = thread.episodes
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence)
    .map((episode) => ({
      episode,
      context: createContextEntry(
        `THIS THREAD'S OWN HISTORY — episode ${episode.sequence}\n`,
        serializeJson(episode),
      ),
    }));

  const external = sources.map((source) => ({
    source,
    context: createContextEntry(
      `EXTERNAL CONTEXT FROM THREAD <${source.thread_name}> — read-only\n`,
      serializeJson(source.episode),
    ),
  }));

  let usedTokens = protectedTokens;

  for (const item of own) {
    usedTokens = addTokenCosts(usedTokens, item.context.tokens);
  }

  for (const item of external) {
    usedTokens = addTokenCosts(usedTokens, item.context.tokens);
  }

  let removedExternal = 0;

  for (const item of external) {
    if (usedTokens <= budget) {
      break;
    }

    usedTokens -= item.context.tokens;
    removedExternal += 1;
  }

  if (removedExternal > 0) {
    external.splice(0, removedExternal);
  }

  for (const item of own) {
    if (usedTokens <= budget) {
      break;
    }

    const summary = serializeJson({
      episode_id: item.episode.episode_id,
      sequence: item.episode.sequence,
      summary: item.episode.summary,
      results: item.episode.results,
      context_note: "Older episode elided to summary and results",
    });

    const replacement = createContextEntry(item.context.prefix, summary);

    if (replacement.tokens < item.context.tokens) {
      usedTokens -= item.context.tokens - replacement.tokens;
      item.context = replacement;
    }
  }

  for (const item of own) {
    if (usedTokens <= budget) {
      break;
    }

    const availableTokens = budget - (usedTokens - item.context.tokens);
    const replacement = shrinkHistoryEntry(item.context, availableTokens);

    usedTokens -= item.context.tokens - replacement.tokens;
    item.context = replacement;
  }

  if (usedTokens > budget) {
    throw new Error(CONTEXT_BUDGET_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  const messages: Message[] = [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: system,
    },
    ...own.map(
      (item): Message => ({
        role: "user",
        content: item.context.prefix + item.context.text,
      }),
    ),
    ...external.map(
      (item): Message => ({
        role: "user",
        content: item.context.prefix + item.context.text,
      }),
    ),
    {
      role: "user",
      content: action,
    },
  ];

  return {
    messages,
    sourceIds: external.map((item) => item.source.episode.episode_id),
  };
}
```

```typescript
import { tokenCount } from "./providers";
import { WORKER_PROMPT } from "./prompts";
import type { Episode, Message, SessionConfig, Thread } from "./models";

export type SourceEpisode = { thread_name: string; episode: Episode };

export const TOOL_OUTPUT_CHAR_LIMIT = 24000;

const MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD = 8;
const MIN_TRUNCATED_EPISODE_CHARS = 80;
const ELISION_NOTE = "Episode elided to summary and results to fit the context budget";
const PROTECTED_BUDGET_ERROR = "Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt and requested action. Increase the context budget.";
const RETAINED_BUDGET_ERROR = "Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt, requested action, and retained history. Increase the context budget.";

type OwnSlot = { episode: Episode; text: string; tokens: number };
type ExternalSlot = { source: SourceEpisode; text: string; tokens: number };
type Measurement = { text: string; tokens: number };

function isHighSurrogate(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff;
}

function isLowSurrogate(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 0xdc00 && code <= 0xdfff;
}

function safeCutIndex(text: string, index: number): number {
  if (index > 0 && index < text.length && isHighSurrogate(text.charCodeAt(index - 1)) && isLowSurrogate(text.charCodeAt(index))) {
    return index - 1;
  }
  return index;
}

function truncationMarker(removed: number): string {
  return ` [truncated ${removed} chars]`;
}

function singleLine(value: unknown): string {
  return String(value).replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function messageTokens(content: string): number {
  return tokenCount(content) + MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD;
}

function ownContent(episode: Episode, text: string): string {
  return `THIS THREAD'S OWN HISTORY — episode ${episode.sequence}\n${text}`;
}

function externalContent(threadName: string, text: string): string {
  return `EXTERNAL CONTEXT FROM THREAD <${singleLine(String(threadName).replace(/[<>]/g, " "))}> — read-only\n${text}`;
}

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  const floored = Math.floor(max);
  if (Number.isNaN(floored)) {
    throw new RangeError(`truncate requires a numeric max length, received ${String(max)}.`);
  }
  const limit = Math.max(0, floored);
  if (text.length <= limit) {
    return text;
  }
  const widestMarkerLength = truncationMarker(text.length).length;
  if (widestMarkerLength > limit) {
    return text.slice(0, safeCutIndex(text, limit));
  }
  let kept = limit - widestMarkerLength;
  while (kept + 1 + truncationMarker(text.length - kept - 1).length <= limit) {
    kept += 1;
  }
  kept = safeCutIndex(text, kept);
  return text.slice(0, kept) + truncationMarker(text.length - kept);
}

export function buildContext(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, instructions: string): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {
  if (!Number.isFinite(config.context_budget) || !Number.isFinite(config.max_tokens) || config.max_tokens < 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid context configuration: context_budget (${String(config.context_budget)}) and max_tokens (${String(config.max_tokens)}) must be finite numbers, and max_tokens must not be negative.`);
  }
  const budget = config.context_budget - config.max_tokens;
  if (budget <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Context budget (${config.context_budget}) must be greater than the reserved output tokens (${config.max_tokens}). Increase the context budget.`);
  }
  const limits = `WORKSTREAM: ${singleLine(thread.name)}\nLIMITS: ${config.max_turns} turns, ${Math.min(config.max_tool_calls, thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls)} tool calls, ${config.timeout_sec} seconds. Tool outputs capped at ${TOOL_OUTPUT_CHAR_LIMIT} characters.`;
  const system = [thread.system_prompt, WORKER_PROMPT, limits, instructions]
    .filter((section): section is string => typeof section === "string" && section.trim().length > 0)
    .join("\n\n");
  let total = messageTokens(system) + messageTokens(action);
  if (total > budget) {
    throw new Error(PROTECTED_BUDGET_ERROR);
  }
  const own: OwnSlot[] = thread.episodes
    .slice()
    .sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence)
    .map((episode) => {
      const text = JSON.stringify(episode);
      return { episode, text, tokens: messageTokens(ownContent(episode, text)) };
    });
  for (const slot of own) {
    total += slot.tokens;
  }
  const external: ExternalSlot[] = [];
  if (total <= budget) {
    const candidates: ExternalSlot[] = sources.map((source) => {
      const text = JSON.stringify(source.episode);
      return { source, text, tokens: messageTokens(externalContent(source.thread_name, text)) };
    });
    for (const slot of candidates.slice().reverse()) {
      if (total + slot.tokens <= budget) {
        external.push(slot);
        total += slot.tokens;
      }
    }
    external.reverse();
  }
  for (const slot of own) {
    if (total <= budget) {
      break;
    }
    const text = JSON.stringify({ episode_id: slot.episode.episode_id, sequence: slot.episode.sequence, context_note: ELISION_NOTE, summary: slot.episode.summary, results: slot.episode.results });
    const tokens = messageTokens(ownContent(slot.episode, text));
    if (tokens < slot.tokens) {
      total += tokens - slot.tokens;
      slot.text = text;
      slot.tokens = tokens;
    }
  }
  for (const slot of own) {
    if (total <= budget) {
      break;
    }
    const original = slot.text;
    const others = total - slot.tokens;
    const measure = (length: number): Measurement => {
      const text = truncate(original, length);
      return { text, tokens: messageTokens(ownContent(slot.episode, text)) };
    };
    const minimal = measure(MIN_TRUNCATED_EPISODE_CHARS);
    if (others + minimal.tokens > budget) {
      if (minimal.tokens < slot.tokens) {
        slot.text = minimal.text;
        slot.tokens = minimal.tokens;
        total = others + minimal.tokens;
      }
      continue;
    }
    let low = MIN_TRUNCATED_EPISODE_CHARS;
    let high = original.length;
    let best = minimal;
    while (high - low > 1) {
      const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
      const candidate = measure(middle);
      if (others + candidate.tokens <= budget) {
        low = middle;
        best = candidate;
      } else {
        high = middle;
      }
    }
    slot.text = best.text;
    slot.tokens = best.tokens;
    total = others + best.tokens;
  }
  if (total > budget) {
    throw new Error(RETAINED_BUDGET_ERROR);
  }
  const messages: Message[] = [
    { role: "system", content: system },
    ...own.map((slot): Message => ({ role: "user", content: ownContent(slot.episode, slot.text) })),
    ...external.map((slot): Message => ({ role: "user", content: externalContent(slot.source.thread_name, slot.text) })),
    { role: "user", content: action },
  ];
  return { messages, sourceIds: external.map((slot) => slot.source.episode.episode_id) };
}
```

```typescript
import { tokenCount } from "./providers";
import { WORKER_PROMPT } from "./prompts";
import type { Episode, Message, SessionConfig, Thread } from "./models";

export type SourceEpisode = { thread_name: string; episode: Episode };

type HistoryEntry = { episode: Episode; text: string; tokens: number };

type ExternalEntry = SourceEpisode & { text: string; tokens: number };

const MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS = 8;
const CHARS_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE = 3;
const MIN_TRUNCATED_TEXT_LENGTH = 80;
const TOOL_OUTPUT_CAP_CHARS = 24000;
const ELIDED_EPISODE_NOTE = "Older episode elided to summary and results";

function truncationMarker(removed: number): string {
  return ` [truncated ${removed} chars]`;
}

function surrogateSafeCut(text: string, length: number): number {
  if (length <= 0 || length >= text.length) return length;
  const high = text.charCodeAt(length - 1);
  const low = text.charCodeAt(length);
  if (high >= 0xd800 && high <= 0xdbff && low >= 0xdc00 && low <= 0xdfff) return length - 1;
  return length;
}

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (Number.isNaN(max)) throw new RangeError("truncate: max must be a number, received NaN");
  const limit = Math.max(0, Math.floor(max));
  if (text.length <= limit) return text;
  let kept = Math.max(0, limit - truncationMarker(text.length).length);
  for (;;) {
    const next = Math.max(0, limit - truncationMarker(text.length - kept).length);
    if (next === kept) break;
    kept = next;
  }
  if (kept + truncationMarker(text.length - kept).length > limit) return text.slice(0, surrogateSafeCut(text, limit));
  const cut = surrogateSafeCut(text, kept);
  return text.slice(0, cut) + truncationMarker(text.length - cut);
}

export function buildContext(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, instructions: string): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {
  const budget = config.context_budget - config.max_tokens;
  if (!Number.isFinite(budget) || budget <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid context budget: context_budget (${config.context_budget}) minus max_tokens (${config.max_tokens}) must be a positive finite number of tokens.`);
  }
  const system = `${thread.system_prompt}\n\n${WORKER_PROMPT}\n\nWORKSTREAM: ${thread.name}\nLIMITS: ${config.max_turns} turns, ${Math.min(config.max_tool_calls, thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls)} tool calls, ${config.timeout_sec} seconds. Tool outputs capped at ${TOOL_OUTPUT_CAP_CHARS} characters.\n\n${instructions}`;
  const messageCost = (content: string): number => tokenCount(content) + MESSAGE_OVERHEAD_TOKENS;
  const ownContent = (sequence: number, text: string): string => `THIS THREAD'S OWN HISTORY — episode ${sequence}\n${text}`;
  const externalContent = (threadName: string, text: string): string => `EXTERNAL CONTEXT FROM THREAD <${threadName}> — read-only\n${text}`;
  const ownCost = (entry: HistoryEntry, text: string): number => messageCost(ownContent(entry.episode.sequence, text));
  const own: HistoryEntry[] = thread.episodes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence).map((episode) => {
    const text = JSON.stringify(episode);
    return { episode, text, tokens: messageCost(ownContent(episode.sequence, text)) };
  });
  const external: ExternalEntry[] = sources.map((source) => {
    const text = JSON.stringify(source.episode);
    return { ...source, text, tokens: messageCost(externalContent(source.thread_name, text)) };
  });
  let total = messageCost(system) + messageCost(action) + own.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.tokens, 0) + external.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.tokens, 0);
  const replace = (entry: HistoryEntry, text: string, tokens: number): void => {
    total += tokens - entry.tokens;
    entry.text = text;
    entry.tokens = tokens;
  };
  while (total > budget && external.length > 0) {
    const removed = external.shift();
    if (removed !== undefined) total -= removed.tokens;
  }
  for (const entry of own) {
    if (total <= budget) break;
    const elided = JSON.stringify({ episode_id: entry.episode.episode_id, sequence: entry.episode.sequence, summary: entry.episode.summary, results: entry.episode.results, context_note: ELIDED_EPISODE_NOTE });
    const elidedTokens = ownCost(entry, elided);
    if (elidedTokens < entry.tokens) replace(entry, elided, elidedTokens);
  }
  for (const entry of own) {
    if (total <= budget) break;
    const base = entry.text;
    const baseTokens = entry.tokens;
    let target = base.length;
    while (total > budget && target > MIN_TRUNCATED_TEXT_LENGTH) {
      const excess = Math.ceil((total - budget) * CHARS_PER_TOKEN_ESTIMATE);
      target = Math.max(MIN_TRUNCATED_TEXT_LENGTH, target - excess);
      const truncated = truncate(base, target);
      replace(entry, truncated, ownCost(entry, truncated));
    }
    if (total > budget && entry.tokens > baseTokens) replace(entry, base, baseTokens);
  }
  if (total > budget) {
    throw new Error(`Context budget of ${budget} tokens is too small: the protected system prompt, requested action, and minimally retained history still require ${total} tokens. Increase the context budget.`);
  }
  const messages: Message[] = [
    { role: "system", content: system },
    ...own.map((entry): Message => ({ role: "user", content: ownContent(entry.episode.sequence, entry.text) })),
    ...external.map((entry): Message => ({ role: "user", content: externalContent(entry.thread_name, entry.text) })),
    { role: "user", content: action },
  ];
  return { messages, sourceIds: external.map((entry) => entry.episode.episode_id) };
}
```

```typescript
import { tokenCount } from "./providers";
import { WORKER_PROMPT } from "./prompts";
import type { Episode, Message, SessionConfig, Thread } from "./models";

export type SourceEpisode = { thread_name: string; episode: Episode };

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(max)) {
    throw new Error("truncate max must be a finite number");
  }
  const limit = Math.max(0, Math.floor(max));
  if (text.length <= limit) {
    return text;
  }
  const markerFor = (removed: number): string => ` [truncated ${removed} chars]`;
  const align = (raw: number): number => {
    let kept = Math.max(0, Math.min(text.length, raw));
    if (kept > 0 && kept < text.length) {
      const code = text.charCodeAt(kept - 1);
      if (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff) {
        kept -= 1;
      }
    }
    return kept;
  };
  let kept = align(limit);
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 12; pass++) {
    const marker = markerFor(text.length - kept);
    if (marker.length > limit) {
      return text.slice(0, align(limit));
    }
    const next = align(limit - marker.length);
    if (next === kept) {
      const combined = text.slice(0, kept) + marker;
      if (combined.length <= limit) {
        return combined;
      }
      return text.slice(0, align(limit));
    }
    kept = next;
  }
  const marker = markerFor(text.length - kept);
  const adjusted = marker.length > limit ? align(limit) : align(limit - marker.length);
  const rebuilt = markerFor(text.length - adjusted);
  if (rebuilt.length <= limit && adjusted + rebuilt.length <= limit) {
    return text.slice(0, adjusted) + rebuilt;
  }
  return text.slice(0, align(limit));
}

export function buildContext(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, instructions: string): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {
  const system = `${thread.system_prompt}\n\n${WORKER_PROMPT}\n\nWORKSTREAM: ${thread.name}\nLIMITS: ${config.max_turns} turns, ${Math.min(config.max_tool_calls, thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls)} tool calls, ${config.timeout_sec} seconds. Tool outputs capped at 24000 characters.\n\n${instructions}`;
  const own = thread.episodes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence).map((episode) => {
    const text = JSON.stringify(episode);
    return { episode, text, base: text };
  });
  const external = sources.map((source) => ({ ...source, text: JSON.stringify(source.episode) }));
  const make = (): Message[] => [
    { role: "system", content: system },
    ...own.map((entry): Message => ({ role: "user", content: `THIS THREAD'S OWN HISTORY — episode ${entry.episode.sequence}\n${entry.text}` })),
    ...external.map((entry): Message => ({ role: "user", content: `EXTERNAL CONTEXT FROM THREAD <${entry.thread_name}> — read-only\n${entry.text}` })),
    { role: "user", content: action },
  ];
  const cost = (): number => make().reduce((total, message) => {
    const counted = tokenCount(message.content);
    if (typeof counted !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(counted) || counted < 0) {
      throw new Error("tokenCount returned a non-finite value");
    }
    return total + counted + 8;
  }, 0);
  const budget = config.context_budget - config.max_tokens;
  if (Number.isNaN(budget)) {
    throw new Error("Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt, requested action, and retained history. Increase the context budget.");
  }
  while (cost() > budget && external.length) {
    external.shift();
  }
  for (const item of own) {
    if (cost() <= budget) {
      break;
    }
    const compact = JSON.stringify({
      episode_id: item.episode.episode_id,
      sequence: item.episode.sequence,
      summary: item.episode.summary,
      results: item.episode.results,
      context_note: "Older episode elided to summary and results",
    });
    const previousText = item.text;
    const previousBase = item.base;
    const previousCost = cost();
    item.text = compact;
    item.base = compact;
    if (cost() >= previousCost) {
      item.text = previousText;
      item.base = previousBase;
    }
  }
  const minimum = 80;
  for (const item of own) {
    if (cost() <= budget) {
      break;
    }
    const low = Math.min(minimum, item.base.length);
    const high = item.base.length;
    const previousText = item.text;
    const previousCost = cost();
    item.text = truncate(item.base, low);
    const floorCost = cost();
    if (floorCost > budget) {
      if (floorCost >= previousCost) {
        item.text = previousText;
      }
      continue;
    }
    let bestLimit = low;
    let left = low + 1;
    let right = high;
    while (left <= right) {
      const mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
      item.text = truncate(item.base, mid);
      if (cost() <= budget) {
        bestLimit = mid;
        left = mid + 1;
      } else {
        right = mid - 1;
      }
    }
    item.text = truncate(item.base, bestLimit);
  }
  if (cost() > budget) {
    throw new Error("Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt, requested action, and retained history. Increase the context budget.");
  }
  return { messages: make(), sourceIds: external.map((source) => source.episode.episode_id) };
}
```

```typescript
import { tokenCount } from "./providers";
import { WORKER_PROMPT } from "./prompts";
import type { Episode, Message, SessionConfig, Thread } from "./models";

export type SourceEpisode = { thread_name: string; episode: Episode };

const MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD = 8;
const TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT = 24000;
const SUMMARY_CONTEXT_NOTE = "Older episode elided to summary and results";

type OwnContextEntry = {
  episode: Episode;
  episodeId: string;
  sequence: number;
  originalIndex: number;
  text: string;
};

type ExternalContextEntry = {
  thread_name: string;
  episode: Episode;
  episodeId: string;
  text: string;
};

function isHighSurrogate(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff;
}

function isLowSurrogate(code: number): boolean {
  return code >= 0xdc00 && code <= 0xdfff;
}

function safePrefixLength(text: string, length: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(length)) {
    return length > 0 ? text.length : 0;
  }

  const boundedLength = Math.max(0, Math.min(text.length, Math.floor(length)));

  if (boundedLength > 0 && boundedLength < text.length) {
    const previous = text.charCodeAt(boundedLength - 1);
    const next = text.charCodeAt(boundedLength);

    if (isHighSurrogate(previous) && isLowSurrogate(next)) {
      return boundedLength - 1;
    }
  }

  return boundedLength;
}

function safePrefix(text: string, length: number): string {
  return text.slice(0, safePrefixLength(text, length));
}

export function truncate(text: string, max: number): string {
  if (typeof text !== "string") {
    throw new Error("text must be a string.");
  }

  if (typeof max !== "number" || Number.isNaN(max)) {
    throw new Error("max must be a valid number.");
  }

  if (max === Infinity || text.length <= max) {
    return text;
  }

  if (max <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(max)) {
    return "";
  }

  const limit = Math.floor(max);

  if (limit <= 0) {
    return "";
  }

  if (text.length <= limit) {
    return text;
  }

  const marker = (kept: number): string => ` [truncated ${text.length - kept} chars]`;
  const fullMarker = marker(0);

  if (fullMarker.length > limit) {
    const ellipsis = "…";
    return ellipsis.length <= limit ? `${safePrefix(text, limit - ellipsis.length)}${ellipsis}` : "";
  }

  let low = 0;
  let high = Math.min(text.length, limit);
  let best = 0;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    const kept = safePrefixLength(text, mid);
    const candidateMarker = marker(kept);

    if (kept + candidateMarker.length <= limit) {
      best = kept;
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  const kept = safePrefixLength(text, best);
  const finalMarker = marker(kept);

  return kept + finalMarker.length <= limit ? `${text.slice(0, kept)}${finalMarker}` : fullMarker;
}

function stringifyContextValue(value: unknown): string {
  const ancestors: object[] = [];

  try {
    const json = JSON.stringify(value, function (this: unknown, _key: string, currentValue: unknown): unknown {
      if (typeof currentValue === "bigint") {
        return currentValue.toString();
      }

      if (typeof currentValue !== "object" || currentValue === null) {
        return currentValue;
      }

      while (ancestors.length > 0 && ancestors[ancestors.length - 1] !== this) {
        ancestors.pop();
      }

      if (ancestors.indexOf(currentValue) !== -1) {
        return "[Circular]";
      }

      ancestors.push(currentValue);
      return currentValue;
    });

    return typeof json === "string" ? json : "null";
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    throw new Error(`Unable to serialize context value: ${message}`);
  }
}

function requireObject(value: unknown, name: string): asserts value is Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be an object.`);
  }
}

function requireString(value: unknown, name: string): string {
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a string.`);
  }

  return value;
}

function requireFiniteNumber(value: unknown, name: string): number {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a finite number.`);
  }

  return value;
}

function requireNonNegativeFiniteNumber(value: unknown, name: string): number {
  const number = requireFiniteNumber(value, name);

  if (number < 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be non-negative.`);
  }

  return number;
}

function requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(value: unknown, name: string): number {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative safe integer.`);
  }

  return value;
}

function calculateCost(messages: Message[]): number {
  let total = 0;

  for (const message of messages) {
    const countedTokens = tokenCount(message.content);

    if (typeof countedTokens !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(countedTokens) || countedTokens < 0) {
      throw new Error("tokenCount returned an invalid token count.");
    }

    total += countedTokens + MESSAGE_TOKEN_OVERHEAD;

    if (!Number.isFinite(total)) {
      throw new Error("Context token cost exceeded the numeric range.");
    }
  }

  return total;
}

function createOwnEntry(episode: Episode, originalIndex: number): OwnContextEntry {
  requireObject(episode, `thread.episodes[${originalIndex}]`);

  const episodeId = requireString(episode.episode_id, `thread.episodes[${originalIndex}].episode_id`);
  const sequence = requireFiniteNumber(episode.sequence, `thread.episodes[${originalIndex}].sequence`);

  return {
    episode,
    episodeId,
    sequence,
    originalIndex,
    text: stringifyContextValue(episode),
  };
}

function createExternalEntry(source: SourceEpisode, index: number): ExternalContextEntry {
  requireObject(source, `sources[${index}]`);
  requireObject(source.episode, `sources[${index}].episode`);

  const threadName = requireString(source.thread_name, `sources[${index}].thread_name`);
  const episodeId = requireString(source.episode.episode_id, `sources[${index}].episode.episode_id`);

  return {
    thread_name: threadName,
    episode: source.episode,
    episodeId,
    text: stringifyContextValue(source.episode),
  };
}

function summarizeOwnEntry(entry: OwnContextEntry): string {
  return stringifyContextValue({
    episode_id: entry.episodeId,
    sequence: entry.sequence,
    summary: entry.episode.summary,
    results: entry.episode.results,
    context_note: SUMMARY_CONTEXT_NOTE,
  });
}

function fitEntryWithinBudget(entry: OwnContextEntry, makeMessages: () => Message[], budget: number): number {
  const originalText = entry.text;

  entry.text = "";
  let bestText = "";
  let bestCost = calculateCost(makeMessages());

  if (bestCost > budget) {
    return bestCost;
  }

  let low = 1;
  let high = originalText.length;

  while (low <= high) {
    const mid = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    const candidateText = truncate(originalText, mid);

    entry.text = candidateText;

    const candidateCost = calculateCost(makeMessages());

    if (candidateCost <= budget) {
      bestText = candidateText;
      bestCost = candidateCost;
      low = mid + 1;
    } else {
      high = mid - 1;
    }
  }

  entry.text = bestText;
  return bestCost;
}

export function buildContext(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, instructions: string): { messages: Message[]; sourceIds: string[] } {
  requireObject(thread, "thread");
  requireObject(config, "config");

  if (!Array.isArray(thread.episodes)) {
    throw new Error("thread.episodes must be an array.");
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(sources)) {
    throw new Error("sources must be an array.");
  }

  const toolPolicy = thread.tool_policy;
  requireObject(toolPolicy, "thread.tool_policy");

  const systemPrompt = requireString(thread.system_prompt, "thread.system_prompt");
  const workerPrompt = requireString(WORKER_PROMPT, "WORKER_PROMPT");
  const threadName = requireString(thread.name, "thread.name");
  const requestedAction = requireString(action, "action");
  const additionalInstructions = requireString(instructions, "instructions");
  const maxTurns = requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(config.max_turns, "config.max_turns");
  const configMaxToolCalls = requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(config.max_tool_calls, "config.max_tool_calls");
  const threadMaxToolCalls = requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(toolPolicy.max_tool_calls, "thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls");
  const timeoutSeconds = requireNonNegativeFiniteNumber(config.timeout_sec, "config.timeout_sec");
  const contextBudget = requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(config.context_budget, "config.context_budget");
  const maxTokens = requireNonNegativeSafeInteger(config.max_tokens, "config.max_tokens");

  if (contextBudget < maxTokens) {
    throw new Error("config.context_budget must be greater than or equal to config.max_tokens.");
  }

  const budget = contextBudget - maxTokens;
  const maxToolCalls = Math.min(configMaxToolCalls, threadMaxToolCalls);
  const system = `${systemPrompt}\n\n${workerPrompt}\n\nWORKSTREAM: ${threadName}\nLIMITS: ${maxTurns} turns, ${maxToolCalls} tool calls, ${timeoutSeconds} seconds. Tool outputs capped at ${TOOL_OUTPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT} characters.\n\n${additionalInstructions}`;
  const own = Array.from(thread.episodes, (episode, index) => createOwnEntry(episode, index)).sort((a, b) => (a.sequence === b.sequence ? a.originalIndex - b.originalIndex : a.sequence - b.sequence));
  const external = Array.from(sources, (source, index) => createExternalEntry(source, index));

  const make = (): Message[] => {
    const messages: Message[] = [{ role: "system", content: system }];

    for (const entry of own) {
      messages.push({ role: "user", content: `THIS THREAD'S OWN HISTORY — episode ${entry.sequence}\n${entry.text}` });
    }

    for (const entry of external) {
      messages.push({ role: "user", content: `EXTERNAL CONTEXT FROM THREAD <${entry.thread_name}> — read-only\n${entry.text}` });
    }

    messages.push({ role: "user", content: requestedAction });
    return messages;
  };

  const makeProtected = (): Message[] => [
    { role: "system", content: system },
    { role: "user", content: requestedAction },
  ];

  if (calculateCost(makeProtected()) > budget) {
    throw new Error("Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt and requested action. Increase the context budget or reduce max tokens.");
  }

  let currentCost = calculateCost(make());

  while (currentCost > budget && external.length > 0) {
    external.shift();
    currentCost = calculateCost(make());
  }

  for (const item of own) {
    if (currentCost <= budget) {
      break;
    }

    const previousText = item.text;
    const summarizedText = summarizeOwnEntry(item);

    item.text = summarizedText;

    const summarizedCost = calculateCost(make());

    if (summarizedCost <= currentCost) {
      currentCost = summarizedCost;
    } else {
      item.text = previousText;
    }
  }

  for (const item of own) {
    if (currentCost <= budget) {
      break;
    }

    currentCost = fitEntryWithinBudget(item, make, budget);
  }

  while (currentCost > budget && own.length > 0) {
    own.shift();
    currentCost = calculateCost(make());
  }

  if (currentCost > budget) {
    throw new Error("Context budget is too small for the protected system prompt and requested action. Increase the context budget or reduce max tokens.");
  }

  return { messages: make(), sourceIds: external.map((source) => source.episodeId) };
}
```

```typescript
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { validateBundle } from "./bundle";
import { event, now } from "./store";
import type { Session } from "./models";

export async function importSession(bundle: unknown): Promise<Session> {
  const session = structuredClone(validateBundle(bundle));
  const createdAt = new Date(session.created_at);

  if (!Number.isFinite(createdAt.getTime())) {
    throw new Error("The imported session has an invalid creation timestamp.");
  }

  const importedAt = now();

  for (const run of session.data.runs) {
    if (run.status === "running") {
      run.status = "failed";
      run.phase = "finished";
      run.finished_at = importedAt;
      run.error = {
        type: "imported_incomplete_run",
        message:
          "The exported run was marked as running. It has not been resumed automatically. Verify the actual workspace before starting a continuation.",
        recoverable: true,
        environment_may_have_advanced: true,
      };
    }
  }

  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    if (thread.status === "running") {
      thread.status = "failed";
    }
  }

  const messages: Array<(typeof session.data.messages)[number]> = [];
  const pendingToolCalls = new Set<string>();
  const incompleteCallContent = JSON.stringify({
    error: {
      type: "imported_incomplete_call",
      message:
        "The exported session contains no response for this tool call. It has not been replayed. Verify the actual workspace before continuing.",
      recoverable: true,
      environment_may_have_advanced: true,
    },
  });

  const appendIncompleteToolResponses = (): void => {
    pendingToolCalls.forEach((toolCallId) => {
      messages.push({
        role: "tool",
        tool_call_id: toolCallId,
        content: incompleteCallContent,
      });
    });

    pendingToolCalls.clear();
  };

  for (const message of session.data.messages) {
    const calls = message.tool_calls ?? [];

    if (message.role !== "assistant" && calls.length > 0) {
      throw new Error("Only assistant messages can contain tool calls.");
    }

    if (message.role === "tool") {
      const toolCallId = message.tool_call_id;

      if (typeof toolCallId !== "string" || toolCallId.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("A tool response is missing a valid tool call id.");
      }

      if (!pendingToolCalls.delete(toolCallId)) {
        throw new Error(
          "A tool response has no matching unanswered call in the preceding assistant message.",
        );
      }

      messages.push(message);
      continue;
    }

    appendIncompleteToolResponses();
    messages.push(message);

    for (const call of calls) {
      if (typeof call.id !== "string" || call.id.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("Tool calls must have non-empty string ids.");
      }

      if (pendingToolCalls.has(call.id)) {
        throw new Error(
          "An assistant message contains duplicate tool call ids.",
        );
      }

      pendingToolCalls.add(call.id);
    }
  }

  appendIncompleteToolResponses();

  session.data.messages.length = 0;

  for (const message of messages) {
    session.data.messages.push(message);
  }

  event(
    session.data,
    session.id,
    "session.imported",
    "Portable session imported. Workspace files are not part of the bundle; verify or restore them before continuing.",
  );

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existing = await tx
      .select({ id: sessions.id })
      .from(sessions)
      .where(eq(sessions.id, session.id))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(
        "A session with this id already exists. Import never overwrites retained history.",
      );
    }

    await tx.insert(sessions).values({
      id: session.id,
      name: session.name,
      data: session.data,
      createdAt,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
  });

  return session;
}
```
