[ERROR LIST]
- Line 18: Synthetic tool results for orphaned tool calls are appended to the end of `session.data.messages` instead of being placed directly after the assistant message that issued them (behind its existing tool results); any message that follows that assistant message ends up ahead of the result, breaking the tool-call/tool-result adjacency of the transcript.
- Line 18: `completed` is never updated when a synthetic result is pushed, so a `call.id` that appears in more than one message produces duplicate tool result messages with the same `tool_call_id`.
- Line 21–23: The existence check and the insert are two separate statements with no lock or conflict clause; under the default isolation level two concurrent imports of the same id both pass the check, and the loser fails with a raw unique-violation from the driver (or both rows are written if `id` is not constrained), so the "already exists" guarantee is not atomic.
- Line 23: `new Date(session.created_at)` is used without checking the result; an unparseable `created_at` yields an Invalid Date that reaches the driver mapping inside the transaction and fails with an opaque `RangeError: Invalid time value` instead of a meaningful import error.

[CRITIQUE]
- The line 18 ordering finding depends on the transcript convention that tool results must directly follow the assistant message that issued them; it is treated as a hard invariant because chat-completion providers reject transcripts that violate it, and the fix inserts results in place instead of appending.
- The race fix uses `onConflictDoNothing`/`returning`, which exist in drizzle's pg-core and sqlite-core insert builders and require `sessions.id` to be a primary key or unique column; the `eq`-based pre-check is kept so the import still fails fast and the `eq` import remains in use.
- The timestamp guard is moved ahead of all mutation work so an unusable bundle is rejected before any state is touched.
- Nothing is flagged for lines 16 and 19 because the thread and event shapes are defined outside this file and cannot be verified from it.

```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { validateBundle } from "./bundle";
import { event, now } from "./store";
import type { Session } from "./models";

const duplicateSessionMessage = "A session with this id already exists. Import never overwrites retained history.";

export async function importSession(bundle: unknown): Promise<Session> {
  const session = validateBundle(bundle);
  const createdAt = new Date(session.created_at);
  if (Number.isNaN(createdAt.getTime())) {
    throw new Error("The bundle created_at value is not a valid timestamp. Import refused.");
  }
  for (const run of session.data.runs) {
    if (run.status !== "running") continue;
    run.status = "failed";
    run.phase = "finished";
    run.finished_at = now();
    run.error = {
      type: "imported_incomplete_run",
      message: "The exported run was in flight. It has not been resumed automatically. Verify the actual workspace before starting a continuation.",
      recoverable: true,
      environment_may_have_advanced: true,
    };
  }
  for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
    if (thread.status === "running") thread.status = "failed";
  }
  const messages = session.data.messages;
  const completed = new Set<string>();
  for (const message of messages) {
    if (message.role === "tool" && message.tool_call_id) completed.add(message.tool_call_id);
  }
  const insertions: Array<{ position: number; results: typeof messages }> = [];
  for (const [index, message] of messages.entries()) {
    const results: typeof messages = [];
    for (const call of message.tool_calls ?? []) {
      if (completed.has(call.id)) continue;
      completed.add(call.id);
      results.push({
        role: "tool",
        tool_call_id: call.id,
        content: JSON.stringify({
          error: {
            type: "imported_incomplete_call",
            message: "This tool call was in flight at export time and has not been replayed.",
            recoverable: true,
            environment_may_have_advanced: true,
          },
        }),
      });
    }
    if (results.length === 0) continue;
    let position = index + 1;
    while (messages[position]?.role === "tool") position++;
    insertions.push({ position, results });
  }
  for (const insertion of insertions.reverse()) {
    messages.splice(insertion.position, 0, ...insertion.results);
  }
  event(session.data, session.id, "session.imported", "Portable session imported. Workspace files are not part of the bundle; verify or restore them before continuing.");
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existing = await tx.select({ id: sessions.id }).from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, session.id));
    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(duplicateSessionMessage);
    }
    const inserted = await tx
      .insert(sessions)
      .values({ id: session.id, name: session.name, data: session.data, createdAt, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .onConflictDoNothing({ target: sessions.id })
      .returning({ id: sessions.id });
    if (inserted.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(duplicateSessionMessage);
    }
  });
  return session;
}
```

```ts
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { validateBundle } from "./bundle";
import { event, now } from "./store";
import type { Session } from "./models";

export async function importSession(bundle: unknown): Promise<Session> {
  const session = validateBundle(bundle);
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existing = await tx.select({ id: sessions.id }).from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, session.id));
    if (existing.length) throw new Error("A session with this id already exists. Import never overwrites retained history.");
    for (const run of session.data.runs) {
      if (run.status === "running") {
        run.status = "failed";
        run.phase = "finished";
        run.finished_at = now();
        run.error = { type: "imported_incomplete_run", message: "The exported run was in flight. It has not been resumed automatically. Verify the actual workspace before starting a continuation.", recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced: true };
      }
    }
    for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
      if (thread.status === "running") thread.status = "failed";
    }
    const completed = new Set(session.data.messages.filter((message) => message.role === "tool" && message.tool_call_id != null && message.tool_call_id !== "").map((message) => message.tool_call_id));
    for (const message of session.data.messages.slice()) {
      for (const call of message.tool_calls ?? []) {
        if (call == null || call.id == null || call.id === "" || completed.has(call.id)) continue;
        completed.add(call.id);
        session.data.messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: { type: "imported_incomplete_call", message: "This tool call was in flight at export time and has not been replayed.", recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced: true } }) });
      }
    }
    event(session.data, session.id, "session.imported", "Portable session imported. Workspace files are not part of the bundle; verify or restore them before continuing.");
    await tx.insert(sessions).values({ id: session.id, name: session.name, data: session.data, createdAt: new Date(session.created_at), updatedAt: new Date() });
  });
  return session;
}
```

```typescript
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { validateBundle } from "./bundle";
import { event, now } from "./store";
import type { Session } from "./models";

type SessionMessage = Session["data"]["messages"][number];

const IMPORTED_INCOMPLETE_RUN_MESSAGE =
  "The exported run was in flight. It has not been resumed automatically. " +
  "Verify the actual workspace before starting a continuation.";

const IMPORTED_INCOMPLETE_CALL_MESSAGE = "This tool call was in flight at export time and has not been replayed.";

const SESSION_IMPORTED_MESSAGE =
  "Portable session imported. Workspace files are not part of the bundle; " +
  "verify or restore them before continuing.";

export async function importSession(bundle: unknown): Promise<Session> {
  const session: Session = validateBundle(bundle);
  const createdAt = new Date(session.created_at);

  if (Number.isNaN(createdAt.getTime())) {
    throw new Error("Imported session has an invalid created_at timestamp.");
  }

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const existing = await tx
      .select({ id: sessions.id })
      .from(sessions)
      .where(eq(sessions.id, session.id));

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error("A session with this id already exists. Import never overwrites retained history.");
    }

    for (const run of session.data.runs) {
      if (run.status !== "running") {
        continue;
      }

      run.status = "failed";
      run.phase = "finished";
      run.finished_at = now();
      run.error = {
        type: "imported_incomplete_run",
        message: IMPORTED_INCOMPLETE_RUN_MESSAGE,
        recoverable: true,
        environment_may_have_advanced: true,
      };
    }

    for (const thread of session.data.threads) {
      if (thread.status === "running") {
        thread.status = "failed";
      }
    }

    const completedToolCallIds = new Set<string>();

    for (const message of session.data.messages) {
      if (message.role === "tool" && typeof message.tool_call_id === "string") {
        completedToolCallIds.add(message.tool_call_id);
      }
    }

    for (let messageIndex = 0; messageIndex < session.data.messages.length; messageIndex += 1) {
      const message = session.data.messages[messageIndex];

      if (message === undefined || message.role !== "assistant") {
        continue;
      }

      const importedToolMessages: SessionMessage[] = [];

      for (const call of message.tool_calls ?? []) {
        if (completedToolCallIds.has(call.id)) {
          continue;
        }

        importedToolMessages.push({
          role: "tool",
          tool_call_id: call.id,
          content: JSON.stringify({
            error: {
              type: "imported_incomplete_call",
              message: IMPORTED_INCOMPLETE_CALL_MESSAGE,
              recoverable: true,
              environment_may_have_advanced: true,
            },
          }),
        });
        completedToolCallIds.add(call.id);
      }

      if (importedToolMessages.length === 0) {
        continue;
      }

      let insertionIndex = messageIndex + 1;

      while (insertionIndex < session.data.messages.length) {
        const nextMessage = session.data.messages[insertionIndex];

        if (nextMessage === undefined || nextMessage.role !== "tool") {
          break;
        }

        insertionIndex += 1;
      }

      session.data.messages.splice(insertionIndex, 0, ...importedToolMessages);
      messageIndex = insertionIndex + importedToolMessages.length - 1;
    }

    event(session.data, session.id, "session.imported", SESSION_IMPORTED_MESSAGE);

    await tx.insert(sessions).values({
      id: session.id,
      name: session.name,
      data: session.data,
      createdAt,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
  });

  return session;
}
```

```typescript
import { readFile, readdir, realpath, lstat } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { parse } from "yaml";
import { z } from "zod";
import { truncate } from "./context";

const MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH = 8;
const MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH = 24000;
const MAX_PROJECT_LENGTH = 48000;
const MAX_SKILLS_LENGTH = 16000;
const MAX_SKILLS_PER_DIRECTORY = 100;
const SKILLS_HEADING = "SELECTED SKILLS\n";
const INSTRUCTION_FILENAMES = ["AGENTS.md", ".nac/instructions.md"] as const;

const skillSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  when_to_use: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]),
  tools: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  always_include: z.boolean().default(false),
});

type LoadedSkill = {
  name: string;
  body: string;
  score: number;
  always: boolean;
};

function isMissing(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT"
  );
}

function isWithinRoot(root: string, candidate: string): boolean {
  const relative = path.relative(root, candidate);

  return (
    relative === "" ||
    (relative !== ".." &&
      !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) &&
      !path.isAbsolute(relative))
  );
}

function truncateToLimit(value: string, maximumLength: number): string {
  if (maximumLength <= 0) return "";
  if (value.length <= maximumLength) return value;

  const result = truncate(value, maximumLength).slice(0, maximumLength);
  const lastCodeUnit = result.charCodeAt(result.length - 1);

  if (lastCodeUnit >= 0xd800 && lastCodeUnit <= 0xdbff) {
    return result.slice(0, -1);
  }

  return result;
}

async function optionalRealpath(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await realpath(file);
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissing(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function optionalRead(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const information = await lstat(file);

    if (!information.isFile()) {
      throw new Error(`Path is not a regular file: ${file}`);
    }

    return await readFile(file, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissing(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function optionalReaddir(directory: string) {
  try {
    return await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissing(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function resolveDirectory(directory: string): Promise<string> {
  const canonical = await realpath(path.resolve(directory));
  const information = await lstat(canonical);

  if (!information.isDirectory()) {
    throw new Error(`Path is not a directory: ${directory}`);
  }

  return canonical;
}

async function loadWithIncludes(
  file: string,
  seen: Set<string>,
  root: string,
  depth = 0,
  maximumLength = MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH,
): Promise<string> {
  const limit = Math.min(MAX_INSTRUCTION_LENGTH, maximumLength);

  if (limit <= 0) return "";

  const resolvedFile = path.resolve(file);

  if (!isWithinRoot(root, resolvedFile)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Instruction include escapes its instruction root: ${resolvedFile}`,
    );
  }

  const canonical = await optionalRealpath(resolvedFile);

  if (canonical === null) return "";

  if (!isWithinRoot(root, canonical)) {
    throw new Error(
      `Instruction include escapes its instruction root: ${resolvedFile}`,
    );
  }

  if (seen.has(canonical)) return "";

  if (depth > MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH) {
    throw new Error(
      `Instruction include depth exceeds ${MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH}: ${resolvedFile}`,
    );
  }

  const content = await optionalRead(canonical);

  if (content === null) return "";

  seen.add(canonical);

  const chunks: string[] = [];
  let resultLength = 0;
  let cursor = 0;

  function append(value: string): boolean {
    const remaining = limit - resultLength;
    const part = truncateToLimit(value, remaining);

    if (part.length > 0) {
      chunks.push(part);
      resultLength += part.length;
    }

    return value.length <= remaining;
  }

  const includePattern = /^@include(?:[ \t]+([^\r\n]*))?$/gm;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;

  while ((match = includePattern.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const literal = content.slice(cursor, match.index);

    if (!append(literal) || resultLength >= limit) {
      return chunks.join("");
    }

    const target = match[1]?.trim();

    if (!target) {
      throw new Error(
        `Instruction include path is empty in ${resolvedFile}`,
      );
    }

    cursor = match.index + match[0].length;

    const includedFile = path.resolve(path.dirname(resolvedFile), target);
    const includedContent = await loadWithIncludes(
      includedFile,
      seen,
      root,
      depth + 1,
      limit - resultLength,
    );

    if (!append(includedContent) || resultLength >= limit) {
      return chunks.join("");
    }
  }

  append(content.slice(cursor));

  return chunks.join("");
}

async function loadProjectInstructions(
  cwd: string,
  root: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const directories: string[] = [];
  let current = cwd;

  while (isWithinRoot(root, current)) {
    directories.push(current);

    if (path.relative(root, current) === "") break;

    const parent = path.dirname(current);

    if (parent === current) break;

    current = parent;
  }

  directories.reverse();

  const project: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  let projectLength = 0;

  for (const directory of directories) {
    for (const name of INSTRUCTION_FILENAMES) {
      if (projectLength >= MAX_PROJECT_LENGTH) {
        return project.join("\n\n");
      }

      const file = path.join(directory, name);
      const heading = `PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS: ${path.relative(root, file)}\n`;
      const separatorLength = project.length > 0 ? 2 : 0;
      const available =
        MAX_PROJECT_LENGTH -
        projectLength -
        separatorLength -
        heading.length;

      if (available <= 0) continue;

      const content = await loadWithIncludes(
        file,
        seen,
        root,
        0,
        available,
      );

      if (content.length === 0) continue;

      const section = `${heading}${content}`;

      project.push(section);
      projectLength += separatorLength + section.length;
    }
  }

  return project.join("\n\n");
}

function tokenize(value: string): Set<string> {
  return new Set(value.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? []);
}

async function resolveSkillFile(
  file: string,
  root: string,
): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const information = await lstat(file);

    if (!information.isFile()) return null;

    const canonical = await realpath(file);

    if (!isWithinRoot(root, canonical)) return null;

    return canonical;
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissing(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

function parseSkill(
  content: string,
  file: string,
): {
  metadata: z.infer<typeof skillSchema>;
  body: string;
} {
  const source = content.startsWith("\uFEFF") ? content.slice(1) : content;
  const opening = /^---[ \t]*(?:\r\n|\n|\r)/.exec(source);

  if (opening === null) {
    throw new Error(`Skill ${file} requires YAML frontmatter`);
  }

  const remainder = source.slice(opening[0].length);
  const closing = /^---[ \t]*(?:\r\n|\n|\r|$)/m.exec(remainder);

  if (closing === null) {
    throw new Error(`Skill ${file} requires YAML frontmatter`);
  }

  const metadata = skillSchema.parse(
    parse(remainder.slice(0, closing.index)),
  );
  const body = remainder.slice(closing.index + closing[0].length);

  return { metadata, body };
}

async function loadSkills(
  searchPaths: readonly string[],
  keywords: ReadonlySet<string>,
): Promise<LoadedSkill[]> {
  const skills: LoadedSkill[] = [];
  const seenDirectories = new Set<string>();
  const seenFiles = new Set<string>();

  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
    const directory = await optionalRealpath(path.resolve(searchPath));

    if (directory === null || seenDirectories.has(directory)) continue;

    const entries = await optionalReaddir(directory);

    if (entries === null) continue;

    seenDirectories.add(directory);
    entries.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

    let loadedCount = 0;

    for (const entry of entries) {
      if (loadedCount >= MAX_SKILLS_PER_DIRECTORY) break;

      if (
        entry.isSymbolicLink() ||
        (!entry.isDirectory() && !entry.isFile())
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      const file = entry.isDirectory()
        ? path.join(directory, entry.name, "SKILL.md")
        : path.join(directory, entry.name);

      if (!file.endsWith(".md")) continue;

      const canonical = await resolveSkillFile(file, directory);

      if (canonical === null || seenFiles.has(canonical)) continue;

      const content = await optionalRead(canonical);

      if (!content) continue;

      seenFiles.add(canonical);

      const { metadata, body } = parseSkill(content, file);

      loadedCount += 1;

      const whenToUse = Array.isArray(metadata.when_to_use)
        ? metadata.when_to_use.join(" ")
        : metadata.when_to_use;
      const words = tokenize(
        `${metadata.name} ${metadata.description} ${whenToUse}`,
      );

      let score = 0;

      for (const word of words) {
        if (keywords.has(word)) score += 1;
      }

      if (score > 0 || metadata.always_include) {
        skills.push({
          name: metadata.name,
          body,
          score,
          always: metadata.always_include,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  return skills;
}

function renderSkills(skills: LoadedSkill[]): string {
  skills.sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(b.always) - Number(a.always) ||
      b.score - a.score ||
      a.name.localeCompare(b.name),
  );

  let remaining = MAX_SKILLS_LENGTH - SKILLS_HEADING.length;
  const selected: string[] = [];

  for (const skill of skills) {
    if (remaining <= 0) break;

    const heading = `SKILL: ${skill.name}\n`;
    const separatorLength = selected.length > 0 ? 2 : 0;
    const bodyBudget = remaining - separatorLength - heading.length;

    if (
      bodyBudget < 0 ||
      (bodyBudget === 0 && skill.body.length > 0)
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    const body = truncateToLimit(skill.body, bodyBudget);

    if (body.length === 0 && skill.body.length > 0) continue;

    const section = `${heading}${body}`;

    selected.push(section);
    remaining -= separatorLength + section.length;
  }

  return `${SKILLS_HEADING}${selected.join("\n\n")}`;
}

export async function loadInstructions(
  cwd: string,
  root: string,
  action: string,
  charter: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const canonicalRoot = await resolveDirectory(root);
  const canonicalCwd = await resolveDirectory(cwd);
  const project = await loadProjectInstructions(
    canonicalCwd,
    canonicalRoot,
  );

  const searchPaths = [
    path.join(canonicalRoot, ".nac/skills"),
    path.join(homedir(), ".config/nac/skills"),
    ...(process.env.NAC_SKILL_PATHS
      ?.split(path.delimiter)
      .filter(Boolean) ?? []),
  ];

  const keywords = tokenize(`${action} ${charter}`);
  const skills = await loadSkills(searchPaths, keywords);

  return `${project}\n\n${renderSkills(skills)}`;
}
```

- Line 9: `optionalRead` only tolerates `ENOENT`; `ENOTDIR` (e.g. `.nac` exists as a regular file when reading `.nac/instructions.md`) and `EISDIR` (e.g. `AGENTS.md` or a skill directory's `SKILL.md` is itself a directory) propagate and abort the whole `loadInstructions` call.
- Line 12-14: the file is read before its canonical location is checked against the root, so `@include <path outside root>` reads the foreign file from disk (or throws `EACCES`) before the containment error is raised; `realpath` runs after the read and is uncaught, so a file removed between the two calls throws `ENOENT` instead of being treated as absent.
- Line 16: containment is tested with `canonical.startsWith(root + path.sep)` against a raw, non-canonical `root`; if `root` ends with a separator (including the filesystem root `/`) or contains symlinked components (e.g. `/tmp` → `/private/tmp` on macOS), every canonical file path fails the test and a spurious "Instruction include escapes its instruction root" is thrown for every instruction file.
- Line 19: `\s+` in `/^@include\s+(.+)$/gm` matches line breaks, so a line containing only `@include` swallows the following line and treats it as an include path.
- Line 21: `String.prototype.replace` with a string replacement interprets `$&`, `$1`, `$$`, `` $` `` and `$'` inside the included file content, corrupting any included text that contains those sequences.
- Line 21: `replace(match[0], …)` replaces the first occurrence of the directive text in the already-mutated `result`; if previously inserted include content contains the same text, that occurrence is replaced instead and the real directive line remains unexpanded in the output.
- Line 28: `cwd` and `root` are compared as raw strings via `root + path.sep`; a relative or non-normalized `cwd`/`root`, a trailing separator on `root`, a `root` of `/`, or a `cwd` outside `root` leaves `directories` empty, so no project instructions (not even root-level `AGENTS.md`) are loaded, silently.
- Line 41: search paths are not trimmed, resolved or de-duplicated; a `NAC_SKILL_PATHS` entry equal to `<root>/.nac/skills` or `~/.config/nac/skills` scans the same directory twice and pushes every skill in it twice.
- Line 42: the tokenizer `/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g` excludes every non-ASCII letter, so accented or non-Latin words in `action`/`charter` are split or discarded and can never match (same regex on line 56).
- Line 46: `readdir` only tolerates `ENOENT`; `ENOTDIR` (a search-path component that is a regular file, e.g. `.nac`) aborts the whole call.
- Line 53: the frontmatter regex requires a newline after the closing `---`, so a skill whose closing fence is the last line of the file is rejected with the misleading "requires YAML frontmatter" error; a leading UTF-8 BOM (`\uFEFF`) causes the same rejection.

```typescript
function errorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
  return error instanceof Error ? (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code : undefined;

function isWithin(parent: string, child: string): boolean {
  const relative = path.relative(parent, child);
  return relative === "" || (relative !== ".." && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
}

function significantTerms(text: string): Set<string> {
  const terms: string[] = text.toLowerCase().match(/[\p{L}\p{N}]{3,}/gu) ?? [];
  return new Set(terms.filter((term) => !stopwords.has(term)));
}

async function optionalRead(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await readFile(file, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    const code = errorCode(error);
    if (code === "ENOENT" || code === "ENOTDIR" || code === "EISDIR") return null;
    throw error;
  }

function parseSkillMetadata(file: string, frontmatter: string): SkillMetadata {
  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = parse(frontmatter);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(`Skill ${file} has invalid YAML frontmatter: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  }
  const result = skillSchema.safeParse(parsed);
  if (!result.success) {
    const details = result.error.issues.map((issue) => `${issue.path.map((segment) => String(segment)).join(".") || "frontmatter"}: ${issue.message}`).join("; ");
    throw new Error(`Skill ${file} has invalid frontmatter (${details})`);
  }
  return result.data;
}

async function loadWithIncludes(file: string, seen: Set<string>, root: string, depth = 0): Promise<string> {
  if (depth > 8) throw new Error("Instruction include depth exceeds 8");
  const canonical = await optionalRealpath(file);
  if (canonical === null || seen.has(canonical)) return "";
  if (!isWithin(root, canonical)) throw new Error("Instruction include escapes its instruction root");
  const content = await optionalRead(canonical);
  if (content === null) return "";
  seen.add(canonical);
  const result = truncate(content, 24000);
  const directive = /^@include[ \t]+(.+)$/gm;
  let output = "";
  let cursor = 0;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((match = directive.exec(result)) !== null) {
    output += result.slice(cursor, match.index);
    output += await loadWithIncludes(path.resolve(path.dirname(file), match[1].trim()), seen, root, depth + 1);
    cursor = match.index + match[0].length;
  }
  return output + result.slice(cursor);
}

export async function loadInstructions(cwd: string, root: string, action: string, charter: string): Promise<string> {
  const resolvedRoot = path.resolve(root);
  const canonicalRoot = (await optionalRealpath(resolvedRoot)) ?? resolvedRoot;
  const resolvedCwd = path.resolve(cwd);
  const directories: string[] = [];
  let current = isWithin(resolvedRoot, resolvedCwd) ? resolvedCwd : resolvedRoot;
  while (isWithin(resolvedRoot, current)) {
    directories.unshift(current);
    const parent = path.dirname(current);
    if (parent === current) break;
    current = parent;
  }
  const project: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const directory of directories) {
    for (const name of ["AGENTS.md", ".nac/instructions.md"]) {
      const file = path.join(directory, name);
      const content = await loadWithIncludes(file, seen, canonicalRoot);
      if (content) project.push(`PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS: ${path.relative(resolvedRoot, file)}\n${content}`);
    }
  }
  const configured = process.env.NAC_SKILL_PATHS?.split(path.delimiter).map((entry) => entry.trim()).filter((entry) => entry.length > 0) ?? [];
  const searchPaths = [...new Set([path.join(resolvedRoot, ".nac/skills"), path.join(homedir(), ".config/nac/skills"), ...configured].map((directory) => path.resolve(directory)))];
  const keywords = significantTerms(`${action} ${charter}`);
  const skills: { name: string; body: string; score: number; always: boolean }[] = [];
  const names = new Set<string>();
  for (const directory of searchPaths) {
    const entries = await optionalReaddir(directory);
    if (entries === null) continue;
    for (const entry of entries.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).slice(0, 100)) {
      if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) continue;
      const file = entry.isDirectory() ? path.join(directory, entry.name, "SKILL.md") : path.join(directory, entry.name);
      if (!file.endsWith(".md")) continue;
      const content = await optionalRead(file);
      if (!content) continue;
      const match = /^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---(?:\r?\n([\s\S]*))?$/.exec(content.replace(/^\uFEFF/, ""));
      if (!match) throw new Error(`Skill ${file} requires YAML frontmatter`);
      const metadata = parseSkillMetadata(file, match[1]);
      if (names.has(metadata.name)) continue;
      names.add(metadata.name);
      const words = significantTerms(`${metadata.name} ${metadata.description} ${Array.isArray(metadata.when_to_use) ? metadata.when_to_use.join(" ") : metadata.when_to_use}`);
      const score = [...words].filter((word) => keywords.has(word)).length;
      if (score > 0 || metadata.always_include) skills.push({ name: metadata.name, body: match[2] ?? "", score, always: metadata.always_include });
    }
  }
  skills.sort((a, b) => Number(b.always) - Number(a.always) || b.score - a.score || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  let remaining = 16000;
  const selected: string[] = [];
  for (const skill of skills) {
    const header = `SKILL: ${skill.name}\n`;
    const overhead = header.length + (selected.length > 0 ? 2 : 0);
    const budget = remaining - overhead;
    if (budget < 200) break;
    const body = truncate(skill.body, budget);
    selected.push(`${header}${body}`);
    remaining -= overhead + body.length;
  }
  const sections: string[] = [];
  const projectText = truncate(project.join("\n\n"), 48000);
  if (projectText) sections.push(projectText);
  if (selected.length > 0) sections.push(`SELECTED SKILLS\n${selected.join("\n\n")}`);
  return sections.join("\n\n");
}
```

  if (depth > 8) throw new Error("Instruction include depth exceeds 8");
  const content = await optionalRead(file);
  if (content === null) return "";
  const canonical = await realpath(file);
  if (seen.has(canonical)) return "";
  const rootReal = await realpath(root);
  if (!canonical.startsWith(rootReal + path.sep) && canonical !== rootReal) throw new Error("Instruction include escapes its instruction root");
  seen.add(canonical);
  let result = truncate(content, 24000);
  const matches = Array.from(result.matchAll(/^@include\s+(.+)$/gm));
  for (let i = matches.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const match = matches[i];
    const included = path.resolve(path.dirname(canonical), match[1].trim());
    const replacement = await loadWithIncludes(included, seen, root, depth + 1);
    const start = match.index!;
    const end = start + match[0].length;
 result = result.slice(0, start) + replacement + result.slice(end);
  }
  return result;
}

```typescript
import { readFile, readdir, realpath } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { parse } from "yaml";
import { z } from "zod";
import { truncate } from "./context";

const skillSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  when_to_use: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]),
  tools: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  always_include: z.boolean().default(false),
});

const instructionScanLimit = 24000;
const projectTextLimit = 48000;
const skillTextLimit = 16000;
const skillMinimumRemaining = 200;
const maxSkillEntries = 100;

function isMissingPath(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null || !("code" in error)) return false;
  const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
  return code === "ENOENT" || code === "ENOTDIR";
}

function isPathInside(parent: string, child: string): boolean {
  const relative = path.relative(parent, child);
  return relative === "" || (relative !== ".." && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
}

function limitText(text: string, maxChars: number): string {
  if (maxChars <= 0) return "";
  if (text.length <= maxChars) return text;
  let end = maxChars;
  const previous = text.charCodeAt(end - 1);
  const next = text.charCodeAt(end);
  if (previous >= 0xd800 && previous <= 0xdbff && next >= 0xdc00 && next <= 0xdfff) end -= 1;
  if (end <= 0) return "";
  return text.slice(0, end);
}

async function canonicalise(input: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await realpath(path.resolve(input));
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissingPath(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function optionalRead(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await readFile(file, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissingPath(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

function sourceForIncludeScan(content: string, maxChars: number): string {
  if (content.length <= maxChars) return content;
  const prefix = content.slice(0, maxChars);
  const lastBreak = Math.max(prefix.lastIndexOf("\n"), prefix.lastIndexOf("\r"));
  const lineStart = lastBreak + 1;
  let lineEnd = content.length;
  for (let index = lineStart; index < content.length; index += 1) {
    const char = content[index];
    if (char === "\n" || char === "\r") {
      lineEnd = index;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (lineEnd > maxChars && /^@include(?:\s|$)/.test(content.slice(lineStart, lineEnd))) {
    return lastBreak === -1 ? "" : prefix.slice(0, lastBreak);
  }
  return prefix;
}

function splitFrontmatter(content: string): { meta: string; body: string } | null {
  const source = content.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "");
  const match = /^---[ \t]*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---[ \t]*(?:\r?\n([\s\S]*))?$/.exec(source);
  if (!match) return null;
  return { meta: match[1], body: match[2] ?? "" };
}

async function loadWithIncludes(file: string, seen: Set<string>, root: string, depth = 0): Promise<string> {
  if (depth > 8) throw new Error("Instruction include depth exceeds 8");
  const canonical = await canonicalise(file);
  if (canonical === null) return "";
  if (!isPathInside(root, canonical)) throw new Error("Instruction include escapes its instruction root");
  if (seen.has(canonical)) return "";
  seen.add(canonical);
  const content = await optionalRead(canonical);
  if (content === null) return "";
  const bounded = sourceForIncludeScan(content, instructionScanLimit);
  const matches = [...bounded.matchAll(/^@include\s+(\S(?:.*\S)?)[ \t]*$/gm)];
  if (matches.length === 0) return bounded;
  let result = "";
  let cursor = 0;
  for (const match of matches) {
    const start = match.index;
    if (start === undefined) throw new Error(`Instruction include match is missing an index in ${canonical}`);
    const includePath = (match[1] ?? "").trim();
    if (!includePath) throw new Error(`Instruction include is missing a path in ${canonical}`);
    result += bounded.slice(cursor, start);
    const included = path.resolve(path.dirname(canonical), includePath);
    result += await loadWithIncludes(included, seen, root, depth + 1);
    cursor = start + match[0].length;
  }
  result += bounded.slice(cursor);
  return result;
}

export async function loadInstructions(cwd: string, root: string, action: string, charter: string): Promise<string> {
  const project: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const canonicalRoot = await canonicalise(root);
  const canonicalCwd = canonicalRoot === null ? null : await canonicalise(cwd);
  if (canonicalRoot !== null && canonicalCwd !== null && isPathInside(canonicalRoot, canonicalCwd)) {
    const directories: string[] = [];
    let current = canonicalCwd;
    while (isPathInside(canonicalRoot, current)) {
      directories.unshift(current);
      if (current === canonicalRoot) break;
      const parent = path.dirname(current);
      if (parent === current) break;
      current = parent;
    }
    for (const directory of directories) {
      for (const name of ["AGENTS.md", ".nac/instructions.md"]) {
        const file = path.join(directory, name);
        const content = await loadWithIncludes(file, seen, canonicalRoot);
        if (!content) continue;
        project.push(`PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS: ${path.relative(canonicalRoot, file)}\n${content}`);
      }
    }
  }
  const configuredSkillPaths = [path.join(root, ".nac/skills")];
  try {
    configuredSkillPaths.push(path.join(homedir(), ".config/nac/skills"));
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof Error)) throw error;
  }
  const configuredSkillPathList = process.env.NAC_SKILL_PATHS;
  if (configuredSkillPathList) {
    for (const entry of configuredSkillPathList.split(path.delimiter)) {
      if (entry) configuredSkillPaths.push(entry);
    }
  }
  const searchPaths: string[] = [];
  const seenSearchPaths = new Set<string>();
  for (const configured of configuredSkillPaths) {
    const canonical = await canonicalise(configured);
    if (canonical === null || seenSearchPaths.has(canonical)) continue;
    seenSearchPaths.add(canonical);
    searchPaths.push(canonical);
  }
  const keywords = new Set(`${action} ${charter}`.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? []);
  const skills: { name: string; body: string; score: number; always: boolean }[] = [];
  const seenSkillFiles = new Set<string>();
  for (const directory of searchPaths) {
    const listed = await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).catch((error: unknown) => {
      if (isMissingPath(error)) return null;
      throw error;
    });
    if (listed === null) continue;
    const candidates = listed
      .filter((entry) => {
        if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) return false;
        if (entry.isDirectory()) return true;
        return entry.isFile() && entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".md");
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
      .slice(0, maxSkillEntries);
    for (const entry of candidates) {
      const file = entry.isDirectory() ? path.join(directory, entry.name, "SKILL.md") : path.join(directory, entry.name);
      if (!file.toLowerCase().endsWith(".md")) continue;
      const canonicalFile = await canonicalise(file);
      if (canonicalFile === null || seenSkillFiles.has(canonicalFile) || !isPathInside(directory, canonicalFile)) continue;
      seenSkillFiles.add(canonicalFile);
      const content = await optionalRead(canonicalFile);
      if (!content) continue;
      const parts = splitFrontmatter(content);
      if (!parts) throw new Error(`Skill ${file} requires YAML frontmatter`);
      let metadata: z.infer<typeof skillSchema>;
      try {
        metadata = skillSchema.parse(parse(parts.meta));
      } catch (error) {
        const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
        throw new Error(`Skill ${file} has invalid metadata: ${reason}`, { cause: error });
      }
      const whenToUse = Array.isArray(metadata.when_to_use) ? metadata.when_to_use.join(" ") : metadata.when_to_use;
      const words = new Set(`${metadata.name} ${metadata.description} ${whenToUse}`.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? []);
      const score = [...words].filter((word) => keywords.has(word)).length;
      const always = metadata.always_include === true;
      if (score > 0 || always) skills.push({ name: metadata.name, body: parts.body, score, always });
    }
  }
  skills.sort((a, b) => Number(b.always) - Number(a.always) || b.score - a.score || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  let remaining = skillTextLimit;
  const selected: string[] = [];
  for (const skill of skills) {
    if (remaining < skillMinimumRemaining) break;
    const separatorLength = selected.length === 0 ? 0 : 2;
    const prefix = `SKILL: ${skill.name}\n`;
    const overhead = separatorLength + prefix.length;
    if (overhead >= remaining) break;
    const allowance = remaining - overhead;
    const body = limitText(truncate(skill.body, allowance), allowance);
    selected.push(`${prefix}${body}`);
    remaining -= overhead + body.length;
  }
  return `${truncate(project.join("\n\n"), projectTextLimit)}\n\nSELECTED SKILLS\n${selected.join("\n\n")}`;
}
```

```typescript
import { readFile, readdir, realpath } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { homedir } from "node:os";
import { parse } from "yaml";
import { z } from "zod";
import { truncate } from "./context";

const skillSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string(),
  description: z.string(),
  when_to_use: z.union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())]),
  tools: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  always_include: z.boolean().default(false)
});

type SkillMetadata = z.infer<typeof skillSchema>;

type LoadedSkill = {
  name: string;
  body: string;
  score: number;
  always: boolean;
};

const MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH = 8;
const INSTRUCTION_FILE_CHARACTER_LIMIT = 24000;
const PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS_CHARACTER_LIMIT = 48000;
const SELECTED_SKILLS_CHARACTER_LIMIT = 16000;
const MIN_SELECTED_SKILL_BODY_CHARACTER_LIMIT = 200;

function getErrorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null || !("code" in error)) return undefined;
  const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
  return typeof code === "string" ? code : undefined;
}

function isMissingPathError(error: unknown): boolean {
  const code = getErrorCode(error);
  return code === "ENOENT" || code === "ENOTDIR";
}

async function optionalRead(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await readFile(file, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissingPathError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function optionalRealpath(file: string): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    return await realpath(file);
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissingPathError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

async function optionalReadDirectory(directory: string): Promise<import("node:fs").Dirent[] | null> {
  try {
    return await readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  } catch (error) {
    if (isMissingPathError(error)) return null;
    throw error;
  }
}

function isPathInsideOrEqual(file: string, root: string): boolean {
  const relative = path.relative(root, file);
  return relative === "" || (relative !== ".." && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
}

function pathKey(file: string): string {
  const resolved = path.resolve(file);
  return process.platform === "win32" ? resolved.toLowerCase() : resolved;
}

function stripByteOrderMark(value: string): string {
  return value.length > 0 && value.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? value.slice(1) : value;
}

function boundedTruncate(value: string, length: number): string {
  const limit = Number.isFinite(length) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(length)) : 0;
  if (limit === 0) return "";
  const truncated = truncate(value, limit);
  return truncated.length <= limit ? truncated : truncated.slice(0, limit);
}

function keywordSet(value: string): Set<string> {
  return new Set(value.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? []);
}

async function expandIncludes(content: string, baseDirectory: string, seen: Set<string>, root: string, depth: number): Promise<string> {
  const includePattern = /^@include[^\S\r\n]+([^\r\n]+)\r?$/gm;
  let result = "";
  let lastIndex = 0;

  for (const match of content.matchAll(includePattern)) {
    const index = match.index;
    if (index === undefined) continue;

    const matchedText = match[0] ?? "";
    const includeTarget = (match[1] ?? "").trim();
    if (includeTarget.length === 0) throw new Error("Instruction include path is empty");

    result += content.slice(lastIndex, index);
    result += await loadWithIncludes(path.resolve(baseDirectory, includeTarget), seen, root, depth + 1);
    lastIndex = index + matchedText.length;
  }

  result += content.slice(lastIndex);
  return result;
}

async function loadWithIncludes(file: string, seen: Set<string>, root: string, depth = 0): Promise<string> {
  const canonicalRoot = path.resolve(root);
  const canonical = await optionalRealpath(file);
  if (canonical === null) return "";
  if (!isPathInsideOrEqual(canonical, canonicalRoot)) throw new Error("Instruction include escapes its instruction root");

  const canonicalKey = pathKey(canonical);
  if (seen.has(canonicalKey)) return "";
  if (depth > MAX_INCLUDE_DEPTH) throw new Error("Instruction include depth exceeds 8");

  seen.add(canonicalKey);

  const content = await optionalRead(canonical);
  if (content === null) {
    seen.delete(canonicalKey);
    return "";
  }

  const limitedContent = boundedTruncate(stripByteOrderMark(content), INSTRUCTION_FILE_CHARACTER_LIMIT);
  const expanded = await expandIncludes(limitedContent, path.dirname(canonical), seen, canonicalRoot, depth);
  return boundedTruncate(expanded, INSTRUCTION_FILE_CHARACTER_LIMIT);
}

function parseSkillFile(file: string, content: string): { metadata: SkillMetadata; body: string } {
  const normalizedContent = stripByteOrderMark(content);
  const match = /^---\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---(?:\r?\n([\s\S]*))?$/.exec(normalizedContent);
  if (!match) throw new Error(`Skill ${file} requires YAML frontmatter`);

  return {
    metadata: skillSchema.parse(parse(match[1] ?? "")),
    body: match[2] ?? ""
  };
}

function skillFileForEntry(directory: string, entry: import("node:fs").Dirent): string | null {
  if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) return null;
  if (entry.isDirectory()) return path.join(directory, entry.name, "SKILL.md");
  if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.endsWith(".md")) return path.join(directory, entry.name);
  return null;
}

export async function loadInstructions(cwd: string, root: string, action: string, charter: string): Promise<string> {
  const resolvedRoot = path.resolve(root);
  const canonicalRoot = (await optionalRealpath(resolvedRoot)) ?? resolvedRoot;
  const resolvedCwd = path.resolve(cwd);
  const realCwd = await optionalRealpath(resolvedCwd);
  const canonicalCwd = realCwd ?? (isPathInsideOrEqual(resolvedCwd, resolvedRoot) ? path.resolve(canonicalRoot, path.relative(resolvedRoot, resolvedCwd)) : resolvedCwd);

  const directories: string[] = [];
  if (isPathInsideOrEqual(canonicalCwd, canonicalRoot)) {
    let current = canonicalCwd;
    while (isPathInsideOrEqual(current, canonicalRoot)) {
      directories.unshift(current);
      if (current === canonicalRoot) break;
      const parent = path.dirname(current);
      if (parent === current) break;
      current = parent;
    }
  }

  const project: string[] = [];
  const seenInstructions = new Set<string>();

  for (const directory of directories) {
    for (const name of ["AGENTS.md", ".nac/instructions.md"]) {
      const instructionFile = path.join(directory, name);
      const content = await loadWithIncludes(instructionFile, seenInstructions, canonicalRoot);
      if (content) project.push(`PROJECT INSTRUCTIONS: ${path.relative(canonicalRoot, instructionFile)}\n${content}`);
    }
  }

  const rootSkillDirectory = path.join(canonicalRoot, ".nac/skills");
  const rawSearchPaths = [
    rootSkillDirectory,
    path.join(homedir(), ".config/nac/skills"),
    ...(process.env.NAC_SKILL_PATHS?.split(path.delimiter).filter(Boolean) ?? [])
  ];

  const searchPaths: string[] = [];
  const seenSearchPaths = new Set<string>();

  for (const [index, rawDirectory] of rawSearchPaths.entries()) {
    const canonicalDirectory = await optionalRealpath(path.resolve(rawDirectory));
    if (canonicalDirectory === null) continue;
    if (index === 0 && !isPathInsideOrEqual(canonicalDirectory, canonicalRoot)) throw new Error("Project skill directory escapes its instruction root");

    const searchPathKey = pathKey(canonicalDirectory);
    if (seenSearchPaths.has(searchPathKey)) continue;

    seenSearchPaths.add(searchPathKey);
    searchPaths.push(canonicalDirectory);
  }

  const keywords = keywordSet(`${action} ${charter}`);
  const skills: LoadedSkill[] = [];
  const seenSkillFiles = new Set<string>();

  for (const directory of searchPaths) {
    const entries = await optionalReadDirectory(directory);
    if (entries === null) continue;

    for (const entry of entries.sort((a, b) => (a.name < b.name ? -1 : a.name > b.name ? 1 : 0))) {
      const file = skillFileForEntry(directory, entry);
      if (file === null) continue;

      const canonicalFile = await optionalRealpath(file);
      if (canonicalFile === null) continue;
      if (!isPathInsideOrEqual(canonicalFile, directory)) throw new Error(`Skill ${file} escapes its skill directory`);

      const skillFileKey = pathKey(canonicalFile);
      if (seenSkillFiles.has(skillFileKey)) continue;

      const content = await optionalRead(canonicalFile);
      if (content === null) continue;

      seenSkillFiles.add(skillFileKey);

      const { metadata, body } = parseSkillFile(canonicalFile, content);
      const usage = Array.isArray(metadata.when_to_use) ? metadata.when_to_use.join(" ") : metadata.when_to_use;
      const words = keywordSet(`${metadata.name} ${metadata.description} ${usage}`);
      const score = [...words].filter((word) => keywords.has(word)).length;

      if (score > 0 || metadata.always_include) {
        skills.push({ name: metadata.name, body, score, always: metadata.always_include });
      }
    }
  }

  skills.sort((a, b) => Number(b.always) - Number(a.always) || b.score - a.score || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  let remaining = SELECTED_SKILLS_CHARACTER_LIMIT;
  const selected: string[] = [];

  for (const skill of skills) {
    if (remaining < MIN_SELECTED_SKILL_BODY_CHARACTER_LIMIT) break;

    const separatorLength = selected.length === 0 ? 0 : 2;
    const header = `SKILL: ${skill.name}\n`;
    const bodyBudget = remaining - separatorLength - header.length;
    if (bodyBudget < MIN_SELECTED_SKILL_BODY_CHARACTER_LIMIT) continue;

    const body = boundedTruncate(skill.body, bodyBudget);
    selected.push(`${header}${body}`);
    remaining -= separatorLength + header.length + body.length;
  }

  return `${boundedTruncate(project.join("\n\n"), PROJECT_INSTRUCTIONS_CHARACTER_LIMIT)}\n\nSELECTED SKILLS\n${selected.join("\n\n")}`;
}
```

```typescript
  content: string;
  tool_calls?: ToolCall[];
  tool_call_id?: string;
};

export type RunRecord = {
  run_id: string;
  prompt: string;
  started_at: string;
  finished_at?: string;
  status: "running" | "complete" | "failed" | "cancelled";
  phase: "planning" | "dispatching" | "finished";
  model: string;
  batches: BatchReport[];
  token_usage: Usage;
  final_answer?: string;
  error?: EpisodeError;
  cancel_requested: boolean;
  heartbeat_at: string;
};

export type SteeringItem = {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  thread_name?: string;
  queued_at: string;
  consumed_at?: string;
  consumption_point?: string;
};

export type RuntimeEvent = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  message: string;
  created_at: string;
  session_id: string;
  run_id?: string;
  batch_id?: string;
  call_id?: string;
  thread_id?: string;
  episode_id?: string;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export const sessionConfigSchema = z
  .object({
    provider: z.enum(["openai", "anthropic"]).default("openai"),
    worker_model: z.string().min(1).max(100).default("gpt-4.1-mini"),
    orchestrator_model: z.string().min(1).max(100).default("gpt-4.1-mini"),
    max_parallel: z.number().int().min(1).max(12).default(4),
    max_turns: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(24),
    max_tool_calls: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).default(40),
    timeout_sec: z.number().int().min(10).max(1800).default(300),
    context_budget: z.number().int().min(4000).max(200000).default(48000),
    source_episode_limit: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
    temperature: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.2),
    max_tokens: z.number().int().min(256).max(16384).default(4096),
  })
  .strict();

export type SessionConfig = z.infer<typeof sessionConfigSchema>;

export type SessionData = {
  threads: Thread[];
  runs: RunRecord[];
  steering: SteeringItem[];
  messages: Message[];
  events: RuntimeEvent[];
  config: SessionConfig;
  description: string;
};

export type Session = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  data: SessionData;
};

export type WorkspaceSnapshot = {
  sessions: Session[];
  providers: {
    openai: boolean;
    anthropic: boolean;
  };
  workspace: string;
};

export const jsonSchema = (schema: z.ZodType): Record<string, unknown> =>
  z.toJSONSchema(schema) as Record<string, unknown>;

export function addUsage(a: Usage, b: Usage): Usage {
  const left = usageSchema.parse(a);
  const right = usageSchema.parse(b);

  return usageSchema.parse({
    input: left.input + right.input,
    output: left.output + right.output,
    total: left.total + right.total,
  });
}
```

```ts
  ctx.value.allow.forEach((tool, index) => {
    if (denied.has(tool)) {
      ctx.issues.push({ code: "custom", message: `tool "${tool}" cannot be listed in both allow and deny`, input: tool, path: ["allow", index], continue: true });

  });

    }
    if (episodeIds.has(episode.episode_id)) {

    if (sequences.has(episode.sequence)) {
      ctx.issues.push({ code: "custom", message: `duplicate sequence ${episode.sequence}`, input: episode.sequence, path: ["episodes", index, "sequence"], continue: true });
    }
    sequences.add(episode.sequence);
  });

export const batchSchema = z.strictObject({ rationale: z.string().max(4000).optional(), calls: z.array(callSchema).min(1).max(40) }).check((ctx) => {
  const callIds = new Set<string>();
  ctx.value.calls.forEach((call, index) => {
    if (callIds.has(call.call_id)) {
      ctx.issues.push({ code: "custom", message: `duplicate call_id "${call.call_id}"`, input: call.call_id, path: ["calls", index, "call_id"], continue: true });
    }
    callIds.add(call.call_id);
    call.depends_on.forEach((dependency, dependencyIndex) => {
      if (dependency === call.call_id) {
        ctx.issues.push({ code: "custom", message: `call "${call.call_id}" cannot depend on itself`, input: dependency, path: ["calls", index, "depends_on", dependencyIndex], continue: true });
      }
    });
  });
  const pending = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const call of ctx.value.calls) {
    pending.set(call.call_id, new Set(call.depends_on.filter((dependency) => dependency !== call.call_id && callIds.has(dependency))));
  }
  let progressed = true;
  while (progressed) {
    progressed = false;
    for (const [callId, dependencies] of pending) {
      if (dependencies.size === 0) {
        pending.delete(callId);
        for (const remaining of pending.values()) {
          remaining.delete(callId);
        }
        progressed = true;
      }
    }
  }
  ctx.value.calls.forEach((call, index) => {
    if (pending.has(call.call_id)) {
      ctx.issues.push({ code: "custom", message: `call "${call.call_id}" is part of a dependency cycle`, input: call.call_id, path: ["calls", index, "depends_on"], continue: true });
    }
  });
});
```

import { z } from "zod";

export const usageSchema = z
  .object({
    input: z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),
    output: z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),
    total: z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER),
  })
  .strict();

export type Usage = z.infer<typeof usageSchema>;

export const emptyUsage = (): Usage => ({ input: 0, output: 0, total: 0 });

export const errorSchema = z
  .object({
    type: z.string(),
    message: z.string(),
    recoverable: z.boolean(),
    environment_may_have_advanced: z.boolean(),
  })
  .strict();

export type EpisodeError = z.infer<typeof errorSchema>;

export const episodeSubmissionSchema = z
  .object({
    summary: z.string().min(1).max(4000),
    useful_files: z
      .array(
        z
          .object({
            path: z.string().min(1).max(1024),
            role: z.string().max(1000),
            line_range: z
              .tuple([z.number().int().positive(), z.number().int().positive()])
              .refine((range) => range[0] <= range[1], {
                message: "line_range start must be less than or equal to end",
              })
              .optional(),
            sha256: z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/).optional(),
          })
          .strict(),
      )
      .max(80),
    results: z
      .array(
        z
          .object({
            key: z.string().max(200),
            value: z.string().max(4000),
          })
          .strict(),
      )
      .max(80),
    open_questions: z.array(z.string().max(1000)).max(30),
    next_steps: z.array(z.string().max(1000)).max(30),
    status: z.enum(["complete", "partial", "failed"]),
  })
  .strict();

export const episodeSchema = episodeSubmissionSchema
  .extend({
    episode_id: z.string().min(1),
    thread_id: z.string().min(1),
    sequence: z.number().int().positive(),
    created_at: z.string().datetime(),
    requested_action: z.string().min(1),
    token_usage: usageSchema,
    duration_ms: z.number().nonnegative(),
    source_episode_refs: z.array(z.string().min(1)),
    error: errorSchema.optional(),
  })
  .strict();

export type Episode = z.infer<typeof episodeSchema>;

export const policySchema = z
  .object({
    allow: z.array(z.string()).max(30).default(() => []),
    deny: z.array(z.string()).max(30).default(() => []),
    allow_mutating: z.boolean().default(true),
    allow_shell: z.boolean().default(false),
    allow_network: z.boolean().default(false),
    working_dir: z.string().min(1).max(1024).default("."),
    max_tool_calls: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).default(40),
  })
  .strict();

export type ToolPolicy = z.infer<typeof policySchema>;

export const threadSchema = z
  .object({
    thread_id: z.string().min(1),
    name: z.string().min(1).max(80),
    system_prompt: z.string().min(1).max(16000),
    created_at: z.string().datetime(),
    updated_at: z.string().datetime(),
    status: z.enum(["ready", "running", "complete", "failed"]),
    tags: z.array(z.string().max(40)).max(12),
    tool_policy: policySchema,
    episodes: z.array(episodeSchema),
  })
  .strict();

export type Thread = z.infer<typeof threadSchema>;

export const callSchema = z
  .object({
    call_id: z.string().min(1).max(80),
    thread_name: z.string().min(1).max(80),
    create_if_missing: z.boolean().default(true),
    thread_system_prompt: z.string().min(1).max(16000).optional(),
    requested_action: z.string().min(1).max(24000),
    source_threads: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(40).default(() => []),
    source_episodes: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(100).default(() => []),
    depends_on: z.array(z.string().min(1)).max(40).default(() => []),
    tool_policy: policySchema.optional(),
    model: z.string().min(1).max(100).optional(),
    max_turns: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).optional(),
    timeout_sec: z.number().int().min(10).max(1800).optional(),
  })
  .strict();

export type ThreadCall = z.infer<typeof callSchema>;

export const batchSchema = z
  .object({
    rationale: z.string().max(4000).optional(),
    calls: z.array(callSchema).min(1).max(40),
  })
  .strict();

export type BatchPlan = z.infer<typeof batchSchema>;

export type CallResult = {
  call_id: string;
  thread_name: string;
  status: "complete" | "partial" | "failed" | "skipped";
  episode?: Episode;
  error?: EpisodeError;
  failed_dependencies?: string[];
  duration_ms: number;
  token_usage: Usage;
};

export type BatchReport = {
  batch_id: string;
  rationale: string;
  started_at: string;
  finished_at?: string;
  status: "running" | "complete";
  calls: CallResult[];
  counts: Record<CallResult["status"], number>;
  token_usage: Usage;
  duration_ms: number;
};

export type ToolCall = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  arguments: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type Message = {
  role: "system" | "user" | "assistant" | "tool";
  content: string;
  tool_calls?: ToolCall[];
  tool_call_id?: string;
};

export type RunRecord = {
  run_id: string;
  prompt: string;
  started_at: string;
  finished_at?: string;
  status: "running" | "complete" | "failed" | "cancelled";
  phase: "planning" | "dispatching" | "finished";
  model: string;
  batches: BatchReport[];
  token_usage: Usage;
  final_answer?: string;
  error?: EpisodeError;
  cancel_requested: boolean;
  heartbeat_at: string;
};

export type SteeringItem = {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  thread_name?: string;
  queued_at: string;
  consumed_at?: string;
  consumption_point?: string;
};

export type RuntimeEvent = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  message: string;
  created_at: string;
  session_id: string;
  run_id?: string;
  batch_id?: string;
  call_id?: string;
  thread_id?: string;
  episode_id?: string;
  details?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export const sessionConfigSchema = z
  .object({
    provider: z.enum(["openai", "anthropic"]).default("openai"),
    worker_model: z.string().min(1).max(100).default("gpt-4.1-mini"),
    orchestrator_model: z.string().min(1).max(100).default("gpt-4.1-mini"),
    max_parallel: z.number().int().min(1).max(12).default(4),
    max_turns: z.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(24),
    max_tool_calls: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).default(40),
    timeout_sec: z.number().int().min(10).max(1800).default(300),
    context_budget: z.number().int().min(4000).max(200000).default(48000),
    source_episode_limit: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
    temperature: z.number().min(0).max(1).default(0.2),
    max_tokens: z.number().int().min(256).max(16384).default(4096),
  })
  .strict();

export type SessionConfig = z.infer<typeof sessionConfigSchema>;

export type SessionData = {
  threads: Thread[];
  runs: RunRecord[];
  steering: SteeringItem[];
  messages: Message[];
  events: RuntimeEvent[];
  config: SessionConfig;
  description: string;
};

export type Session = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  data: SessionData;
};

export type WorkspaceSnapshot = {
  sessions: Session[];
  providers: { openai: boolean; anthropic: boolean };
  workspace: string;
};

export const jsonSchema = <T extends z.ZodType>(schema: T): Record<string, unknown> => {
  const converted: unknown = z.toJSONSchema(schema, { unrepresentable: "any" });
  if (typeof converted !== "object" || converted === null || Array.isArray(converted)) {
    throw new TypeError("JSON schema conversion did not return an object");
  }
  const output: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(converted)) {
    output[key] = value;
  }
  return output;
};

export function addUsage(a: Usage, b: Usage): Usage {
  const left = usageSchema.parse(a);
  const right = usageSchema.parse(b);
  return usageSchema.parse({
    input: left.input + right.input,
    output: left.output + right.output,
    total: left.total + right.total,
  });
}

```typescript
import { z } from "zod";

const maxSafeInteger = 9007199254740991;
const nonEmptyStringSchema = z.string().min(1);

const sha256Schema = z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
const lineRangeSchema = z
  .tuple([safePositiveIntegerSchema, safePositiveIntegerSchema])
  .refine(([start, end]) => start <= end, {
    path: [1],
    message: "line_range end must be greater than or equal to line_range start",
  });

export const usageSchema = z
  .object({
    input: safeNonNegativeIntegerSchema,
    output: safeNonNegativeIntegerSchema,
    total: safeNonNegativeIntegerSchema,
  })
  .strict()
  .refine((usage) => usage.total === usage.input + usage.output, {
    path: ["total"],
    message: "total must equal input + output",
  });
export type Usage = z.infer<typeof usageSchema>;
export const emptyUsage = (): Usage => ({ input: 0, output: 0, total: 0 });

export const jsonSchema = (schema: z.ZodType): Record<string, unknown> => {
  const zodWithJsonSchema = z as typeof z & { toJSONSchema?: (inputSchema: z.ZodType) => unknown };
  if (typeof zodWithJsonSchema.toJSONSchema !== "function") {
    throw new TypeError("z.toJSONSchema is not available.");
  }
  const result = zodWithJsonSchema.toJSONSchema(schema);
  if (typeof result !== "object" || result === null || Array.isArray(result)) {
    throw new TypeError("Expected z.toJSONSchema to return a JSON schema object.");
  }
  return result as Record<string, unknown>;
};

export function addUsage(a: Usage, b: Usage): Usage {
  const left = usageSchema.parse(a);
  const right = usageSchema.parse(b);
  const input = left.input + right.input;
  const output = left.output + right.output;
  return usageSchema.parse({ input, output, total: input + output });
}
```

```typescript
import type { ThreadCall } from "./models";

export class ScheduleError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly callIds: string[]) {
    super(message);
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
    this.name = "ScheduleError";
  }
}

export function topologicalWaves(calls: ThreadCall[]): ThreadCall[][] {
  const ids = new Set<string>();

  for (const call of calls) {
    if (ids.has(call.call_id)) {
      throw new ScheduleError(
        `Duplicate call id: ${call.call_id}`,
        [call.call_id],
      );
    }

    ids.add(call.call_id);
  }

  for (const call of calls) {
    for (const dependency of call.depends_on) {
      if (!ids.has(dependency)) {
        throw new ScheduleError(
          `Unknown dependency ${dependency} in ${call.call_id}`,
          [call.call_id, dependency],
        );
      }
    }
  }

  const completed = new Set<string>();
  const waves: ThreadCall[][] = [];

  while (completed.size < calls.length) {
    const wave = calls.filter(
      (call) =>
        !completed.has(call.call_id) &&
        call.depends_on.every((dependency) => completed.has(dependency)),
    );

    if (wave.length === 0) {
      const blocked = calls
        .filter((call) => !completed.has(call.call_id))
        .map((call) => call.call_id);

      throw new ScheduleError(
        `Dependency cycle blocks calls: ${blocked.join(", ")}`,
        blocked,
      );
    }

    const names = new Set<string>();
    const serialized: ThreadCall[] = [];

    for (const call of wave) {
      if (!names.has(call.thread_name)) {
        names.add(call.thread_name);
        serialized.push(call);
      }
    }

    waves.push(serialized);

    for (const call of serialized) {
      completed.add(call.call_id);
    }
  }

  return waves;
}

export async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(
  items: T[],
  limit: number,
  fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>,
): Promise<R[]> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) {
    throw new Error("Parallelism must be a positive integer");
  }

  const input = items.slice();
  const results: R[] = new Array<R>(input.length);
  const iterator = input.entries();
  let failed = false;

  const runWorker = async (): Promise<void> => {
    while (!failed) {
      const next = iterator.next();

      if (next.done === true) {
        return;
      }

      const [index, item] = next.value;

      try {
        results[index] = await fn(item);
      } catch (error) {
        failed = true;
        throw error;
      }
    }
  };

  await Promise.all(
    Array.from(
      { length: Math.min(limit, input.length) },
      () => runWorker(),
    ),
  );

  return results;
}
```

```typescript
import type { ThreadCall } from "./models";

export class ScheduleError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, public readonly callIds: string[]) {
    super(message);
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
    this.name = "ScheduleError";
  }
}

export function topologicalWaves(calls: ThreadCall[]): ThreadCall[][] {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const call of calls) {
    if (ids.has(call.call_id)) throw new ScheduleError(`Duplicate call id: ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id]);
    ids.add(call.call_id);
  }
  for (const call of calls) {
    for (const dependency of call.depends_on) {
      if (!ids.has(dependency)) throw new ScheduleError(`Unknown dependency ${dependency} in ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id, dependency]);
    }
  }
  const completed = new Set<string>();
  const waves: ThreadCall[][] = [];
  while (completed.size < calls.length) {
    const wave = calls.filter((call) => !completed.has(call.call_id) && call.depends_on.every((dependency) => completed.has(dependency)));
    if (!wave.length) {
      const blocked = calls.filter((call) => !completed.has(call.call_id)).map((call) => call.call_id);
      throw new ScheduleError(`Dependency cycle blocks calls: ${blocked.join(", ")}`, blocked);
    }
    const names = new Set<string>();
    const serialized: ThreadCall[] = [];
    for (const call of wave) {
      if (!names.has(call.thread_name)) {
        names.add(call.thread_name);
        serialized.push(call);
      }
    }
    waves.push(serialized);
    for (const call of serialized) completed.add(call.call_id);
  }
  return waves;
}

export async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) throw new Error("Parallelism must be a positive integer");
  const results: R[] = new Array(items.length);
  let cursor = 0;
  let failed = false;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, async () => {
    while (!failed && cursor < items.length) {
      const index = cursor++;
      try {
        results[index] = await fn(items[index]);
      } catch (error) {
        failed = true;
```

```typescript
import type { ThreadCall } from "./models";

export class ScheduleError extends Error {
  public readonly callIds: string[];

  constructor(message: string, callIds: string[]) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ScheduleError";
    this.callIds = callIds;
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ScheduleError.prototype);
  }
}

export function topologicalWaves(calls: ThreadCall[]): ThreadCall[][] {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  for (const call of calls) {
    if (ids.has(call.call_id)) {
      throw new ScheduleError(`Duplicate call id: ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id]);
    }
    ids.add(call.call_id);
  }
  for (const call of calls) {
    for (const dependency of call.depends_on) {
      if (!ids.has(dependency)) {
        throw new ScheduleError(`Unknown dependency ${dependency} in ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id, dependency]);
      }
    }
  }
  const remaining = new Set<string>(ids);
  const dependents = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const unmet = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const call of calls) {
    const uniqueDependencies = new Set<string>();
    for (const dependency of call.depends_on) {
      if (dependency === call.call_id || uniqueDependencies.has(dependency)) {
        continue;
      }
      uniqueDependencies.add(dependency);
      const current = dependents.get(dependency);
      if (current === undefined) {
        dependents.set(dependency, [call.call_id]);
      } else {
        current.push(call.call_id);
      }
    }
    unmet.set(call.call_id, uniqueDependencies.size);
  }
  const byId = new Map<string, ThreadCall>();
  for (const call of calls) {
    byId.set(call.call_id, call);
  }
  const waves: ThreadCall[][] = [];
  const completed = new Set<string>();
  while (remaining.size > 0) {
    const ready: ThreadCall[] = [];
    for (const call of calls) {
      if (!remaining.has(call.call_id)) {
        continue;
      }
      if ((unmet.get(call.call_id) ?? 0) === 0) {
        ready.push(call);
      }
    }
    if (ready.length === 0) {
      const blocked = calls.filter((call) => remaining.has(call.call_id)).map((call) => call.call_id);
      throw new ScheduleError(`Dependency cycle blocks calls: ${blocked.join(", ")}`, blocked);
    }
    const names = new Set<string>();
    const serialized: ThreadCall[] = [];
    for (const call of ready) {
      if (!names.has(call.thread_name)) {
        names.add(call.thread_name);
        serialized.push(call);
      }
    }
    waves.push(serialized);
    for (const call of serialized) {
      remaining.delete(call.call_id);
      completed.add(call.call_id);
      const nextIds = dependents.get(call.call_id);
      if (nextIds === undefined) {
        continue;
      }
      for (const nextId of nextIds) {
        const current = unmet.get(nextId);
        if (current === undefined) {
          continue;
        }
        unmet.set(nextId, current - 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return waves;
}

export async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) {
    throw new Error("Parallelism must be a positive integer");
  }
  const length = items.length;
  const results: R[] = new Array(length);
  let cursor = 0;
  let failure: unknown;
  let failed = false;
  const workerCount = Math.min(limit, length);
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
    while (!failed) {
      const index = cursor;
      if (index >= length) {
        return;
      }
      cursor = index + 1;
      const item = items[index] as T;
      try {
        results[index] = await fn(item);
      } catch (error) {
        if (!failed) {
          failed = true;
          failure = error;
        }
        return;
      }
    }
  }));
  if (failed) {
    throw failure;
  }
  return results;
}
```

```typescript
import type { ThreadCall } from "./models";

export class ScheduleError extends Error {
  public readonly callIds: string[];

  public constructor(message: string, callIds: readonly string[]) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ScheduleError";
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
    this.callIds = [...callIds];
  }
}

function assertThreadCall(call: unknown, index: number): asserts call is ThreadCall {
  if (call === null || typeof call !== "object") {
    throw new ScheduleError(`Invalid call at index ${index}`, []);
  }

  const candidate = call as {
    call_id?: unknown;
    thread_name?: unknown;
    depends_on?: unknown;
  };

  if (typeof candidate.call_id !== "string") {
    throw new ScheduleError(`Invalid call id at index ${index}`, []);
  }

  if (typeof candidate.thread_name !== "string") {
    throw new ScheduleError(`Invalid thread name in ${candidate.call_id}`, [candidate.call_id]);
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(candidate.depends_on)) {
    throw new ScheduleError(`Invalid dependencies in ${candidate.call_id}`, [candidate.call_id]);
  }

  for (let dependencyIndex = 0; dependencyIndex < candidate.depends_on.length; dependencyIndex += 1) {
    if (typeof candidate.depends_on[dependencyIndex] !== "string") {
      throw new ScheduleError(`Invalid dependency in ${candidate.call_id} at index ${dependencyIndex}`, [candidate.call_id]);
    }
  }
}

export function topologicalWaves(calls: ThreadCall[]): ThreadCall[][] {
  if (!Array.isArray(calls)) {
    throw new ScheduleError("Calls must be an array", []);
  }

  const orderedCalls = calls.slice();

  for (let index = 0; index < orderedCalls.length; index += 1) {
    assertThreadCall(orderedCalls[index], index);
  }

  const ids = new Set<string>();

  for (const call of orderedCalls) {
    if (ids.has(call.call_id)) {
      throw new ScheduleError(`Duplicate call id: ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id]);
    }

    ids.add(call.call_id);
  }

  for (const call of orderedCalls) {
    for (const dependency of call.depends_on) {
      if (!ids.has(dependency)) {
        throw new ScheduleError(`Unknown dependency ${dependency} in ${call.call_id}`, [call.call_id, dependency]);
      }
    }
  }

  const completed = new Set<string>();
  const waves: ThreadCall[][] = [];

  while (completed.size < orderedCalls.length) {
    const wave: ThreadCall[] = [];
    const threadNames = new Set<string>();

    for (const call of orderedCalls) {
      if (completed.has(call.call_id) || threadNames.has(call.thread_name)) {
        continue;
      }

      if (call.depends_on.every((dependency) => completed.has(dependency))) {
        threadNames.add(call.thread_name);
        wave.push(call);
      }
    }

    if (wave.length === 0) {
      const blocked = orderedCalls
        .filter((call) => !completed.has(call.call_id))
        .map((call) => call.call_id);

      throw new ScheduleError(`Dependency cycle blocks calls: ${blocked.join(", ")}`, blocked);
    }

    waves.push(wave);

    for (const call of wave) {
      completed.add(call.call_id);
    }
  }

  return waves;
}

export async function mapConcurrent<T, R>(items: T[], limit: number, fn: (item: T) => Promise<R>): Promise<R[]> {
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1) {
    throw new Error("Parallelism must be a positive integer");
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(items)) {
    throw new TypeError("Items must be an array");
  }

  if (typeof fn !== "function") {
    throw new TypeError("Mapper must be a function");
  }

  const input = items.slice();
  const results: R[] = new Array<R>(input.length);
  let cursor = 0;
  let stopped = false;

  const workerCount = Math.min(limit, input.length);
  const workers = Array.from({ length: workerCount }, async () => {
    while (!stopped) {
      const index = cursor;

      if (index >= input.length) {
        return;
      }

      cursor = index + 1;

      try {
        results[index] = await fn(input[index] as T);
      } catch (error) {
        stopped = true;
        throw error;
      }
    }
  });

  await Promise.all(workers);

  return results;
}
```

  const item: RuntimeEvent = { id: id("evt"), type, message: redact(message), created_at: now(), session_id: sessionId, ...refs };
