function hydrate(row: typeof sessions.$inferSelect): Session { return { id: row.id, name: row.name, created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(), updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(), data: row.data }; }
export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> { return (await db.select().from(sessions).orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt))).map(hydrate); }
export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
  if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
  return hydrate(row);
}
export async function mutateSession<T>(sessionId: string, fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update");
    if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
    const session = hydrate(row);
    const result = await fn(session);
    await tx.update(sessions).set({ name: session.name, data: session.data, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
    return result;
  });
}
export function createThread(name: string, prompt: string, tags: string[] = []): Thread {
  return { thread_id: id("thr"), name, system_prompt: prompt, created_at: now(), updated_at: now(), status: "ready", tags, tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}), episodes: [] };
}
export async function createSession(name: string, description = "", config: Partial<SessionConfig> = {}, starterThreads = true): Promise<Session> {
  const sessionId = id("ses");
  const data: SessionData = { threads: [], runs: [], steering: [], messages: [], events: [], config: await loadConfig(config), description };
  if (starterThreads) data.threads = [
    createThread("Research & discovery", "Investigate requirements and the current project. Verify facts, identify constraints, and produce actionable findings. Do not modify application code unless explicitly asked.", ["Research"]),
    createThread("Implementation", "Implement focused, maintainable changes that satisfy the requested acceptance criteria. Verify the existing environment, follow project instructions, and report the exact files changed.", ["Engineering"]),
    createThread("Review & validation", "Independently review changes, test acceptance criteria, and identify defects or regressions. Report verified evidence and concrete follow-up actions.", ["Quality"]),
  ];
  event(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Session created. Your workspace is ready.");
  for (const thread of data.threads) event(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} workstream created`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id });
  const [row] = await db.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name, data }).returning();
  return hydrate(row);
}

import { AsyncLocalStorage } from "node:async_hooks";
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadConfig, redact } from "./config";
import { policySchema, type RuntimeEvent, type Session, type SessionConfig, type SessionData, type Thread } from "./models";

type EventLogContext = {
  state: "pending" | "committed" | "failed";
  messages: string[];
};

const eventLogContext = new AsyncLocalStorage<EventLogContext>();

function writeEventLogBestEffort(message: string): void {
  try {
    console.info(message);
  } catch {
    try {
      console.error(message);
    } catch {
      return;
    }
  }
}

function recordEventLog(message: string): void {
  const context = eventLogContext.getStore();

  if (context?.state === "pending") {
    context.messages.push(message);
    return;
  }

  if (context?.state === "failed") {
    return;
  }

  writeEventLogBestEffort(message);
}

async function withCommittedEventLogs<T>(
  operation: () => Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  const context: EventLogContext = {
    state: "pending",
    messages: [],
  };

  let result: T;

  try {
    result = await eventLogContext.run(context, operation);
  } catch (error) {
    context.state = "failed";
    context.messages = [];
    throw error;
  }

  context.state = "committed";

  const messages = context.messages;
  context.messages = [];

  for (const message of messages) {
    writeEventLogBestEffort(message);
  }

  return result;
}

export const id = (prefix: string): string =>
  `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;

export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

export function event(
  data: SessionData,
  sessionId: string,
  type: string,
  message: string,
  refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent> = {},
): void {
  const item: RuntimeEvent = {
    ...refs,
    id: id("evt"),
    type,
    message: redact(message),
    created_at: now(),
    session_id: sessionId,
  };

  const serialized = JSON.stringify(item);

  if (serialized === undefined) {
    throw new Error("Session event could not be serialized");
  }

  const logMessage = redact(serialized);

  data.events.push(item);
  recordEventLog(logMessage);
}

function hydrate(row: typeof sessions.$inferSelect): Session {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
    updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    data: row.data,
  };
}

export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> {
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(sessions)
    .orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt));

  return rows.map(hydrate);
}

export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(sessions)
    .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));

  if (!row) {
    throw new Error("Session not found");
  }

  return hydrate(row);
}

export async function mutateSession<T>(
  sessionId: string,
  fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>,
): Promise<T> {
  return withCommittedEventLogs(() =>
    db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(sessions)
        .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId))
        .for("update");

      if (!row) {
        throw new Error("Session not found");
      }

      const session = hydrate(row);
      const result = await fn(session);

      const [updatedRow] = await tx
        .update(sessions)
        .set({
          name: session.name,
          data: session.data,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId))
        .returning({
          updatedAt: sessions.updatedAt,
        });

      if (!updatedRow) {
        throw new Error("Session was not updated");
      }

      session.updated_at = updatedRow.updatedAt.toISOString();

      return result;
    }),
  );
}

export function createThread(
  name: string,
  prompt: string,
  tags: string[] = [],
): Thread {
  return {
    thread_id: id("thr"),
    name,
    system_prompt: prompt,
    created_at: now(),
    updated_at: now(),
    status: "ready",
    tags,
    tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}),
    episodes: [],
  };
}

export async function createSession(
  name: string,
  description = "",
  config: Partial<SessionConfig> = {},
  starterThreads = true,
): Promise<Session> {
  const sessionId = id("ses");

  const data: SessionData = {
    threads: [],
    runs: [],
    steering: [],
    messages: [],
    events: [],
    config: await loadConfig(config),
    description,
  };

  if (starterThreads) {
    data.threads = [
      createThread(
        "Research & discovery",
        "Investigate requirements and the current project. Verify facts, identify constraints, and produce actionable findings. Do not modify application code unless explicitly asked.",
        ["Research"],
      ),
      createThread(
        "Implementation",
        "Implement focused, maintainable changes that satisfy the requested acceptance criteria. Verify the existing environment, follow project instructions, and report the exact files changed.",
        ["Engineering"],
      ),
      createThread(
        "Review & validation",
        "Independently review changes, test acceptance criteria, and identify defects or regressions. Report verified evidence and concrete follow-up actions.",
        ["Quality"],
      ),
    ];
  }

  return withCommittedEventLogs(() =>
    db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      event(
        data,
        sessionId,
        "session.created",
        "Session created. Your workspace is ready.",
      );

      for (const thread of data.threads) {
        event(
          data,
          sessionId,
          "thread.created",
          `${thread.name} workstream created`,
          {
            thread_id: thread.thread_id,
          },
        );
      }

      const [row] = await tx
        .insert(sessions)
        .values({
          id: sessionId,
          name,
          data,
        })
        .returning();

      if (!row) {
        throw new Error("Session was not created");
      }

      return hydrate(row);
    }),
  );
}

export async function ensureWorkspace(): Promise<void> {
  await withCommittedEventLogs(() =>
    db.transaction(
      async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(72419731)`);

            id: sessions.id,
          })
          .from(sessions)
          .limit(1);

        if (existing.length > 0) {
          return;
        }

        const sessionId = id("ses");

        const threads = [
          createThread(
            "Research & discovery",
            "Investigate requirements, inspect the project, and hand off verified findings and recommendations. Keep each task bounded.",
            ["Research"],
          ),
          createThread(
            "Implementation",
            "Build focused, maintainable changes against explicit acceptance criteria. Follow project instructions and verify your work.",
            ["Engineering"],
          ),
          createThread(
            "Review & validation",
            "Independently validate changes, inspect code, and report concrete evidence, defects, and next steps.",
            ["Quality"],
          ),

        const data: SessionData = {
          threads,
          runs: [],
          steering: [],
          messages: [],
          events: [],
          config: await loadConfig(),
          description:

        };

        event(
          data,
          sessionId,
          "session.created",
          "Your first session is ready",
        );

            },
          );

        const [row] = await tx
          .insert(sessions)
          .values({
            id: sessionId,

            data,
          })
          .returning({
            id: sessions.id,
          });

        if (!row) {
          throw new Error("Session was not created");
        }
      },
      {
        isolationLevel: "read committed",
      },
    ),
  );
}

export async function deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
  await withCommittedEventLogs(() =>
    db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [row] = await tx
        .select()
        .from(sessions)
        .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId))
        .for("update");

      if (!row) {
        throw new Error("Session not found");
      }

      if (row.data.runs.some((run) => run.status === "running")) {
        throw new Error(
          "Cancel the active run before deleting this session",
        );
      }

      const [deletedRow] = await tx
        .delete(sessions)
        .where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId))
        .returning({
          id: sessions.id,
        });

      if (!deletedRow) {
        throw new Error("Session was not deleted");
      }
    }),
  );
}

export const id = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 12)}`;
export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();
function appendEvent(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent> = {}): RuntimeEvent {
  const item: RuntimeEvent = { ...refs, id: id("evt"), type, message: redact(message), created_at: now(), session_id: sessionId };
  data.events.push(item);
  return item;
}
function logEvent(item: RuntimeEvent): void {
  console.info(redact(JSON.stringify(item)));
}
export function event(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent> = {}): void {
  logEvent(appendEvent(data, sessionId, type, message, refs));
}
function hydrate(row: typeof sessions.$inferSelect): Session { return { id: row.id, name: row.name, created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(), updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(), data: row.data }; }
export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> { return (await db.select().from(sessions).orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt))).map(hydrate); }
export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
  if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
  return hydrate(row);
}
export async function mutateSession<T>(sessionId: string, fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update");
    if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
    const session = hydrate(row);
    const result = await fn(session);
    await tx.update(sessions).set({ name: session.name, data: session.data, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
    return result;
  });
}
export function createThread(name: string, prompt: string, tags: string[] = []): Thread {
  const timestamp = now();
  return { thread_id: id("thr"), name, system_prompt: prompt, created_at: timestamp, updated_at: timestamp, status: "ready", tags: [...tags], tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}), episodes: [] };
}
export async function createSession(name: string, description = "", config: Partial<SessionConfig> = {}, starterThreads = true): Promise<Session> {
  const sessionId = id("ses");
  const data: SessionData = { threads: [], runs: [], steering: [], messages: [], events: [], config: await loadConfig(config), description };
  if (starterThreads) data.threads = [
    createThread("Research & discovery", "Investigate requirements and the current project. Verify facts, identify constraints, and produce actionable findings. Do not modify application code unless explicitly asked.", ["Research"]),
    createThread("Implementation", "Implement focused, maintainable changes that satisfy the requested acceptance criteria. Verify the existing environment, follow project instructions, and report the exact files changed.", ["Engineering"]),
    createThread("Review & validation", "Independently review changes, test acceptance criteria, and identify defects or regressions. Report verified evidence and concrete follow-up actions.", ["Quality"]),
  ];
  const createdEvents: RuntimeEvent[] = [appendEvent(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Session created. Your workspace is ready.")];
  for (const thread of data.threads) createdEvents.push(appendEvent(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} workstream created`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id }));
  const [row] = await db.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name, data }).returning();
  if (!row) throw new Error("Session could not be created");
  for (const item of createdEvents) logEvent(item);
  return hydrate(row);
}

[ERROR LIST]
- Line 8: `randomUUID().slice(0, 12)` takes the first 12 characters of a canonical UUID (`xxxxxxxx-xxxx-...`), so the suffix always contains the hyphen at index 8 and carries only 11 hexadecimal characters; identifiers come out as e.g. `evt_lz1abc2d_9b1deb4d-3b7` instead of 12 random characters.
- Line 10–11: `refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent>` is spread last (`...refs`), so any caller can override `id`, `type`, `message`, `created_at` and `session_id`; a `message` supplied through `refs` is stored and logged unredacted, defeating `redact(message)`, and a `session_id` supplied through `refs` attributes the event to a foreign session. Because TypeScript drops `undefined` from optional properties in object spreads, `{ id: undefined }` also type-checks while producing a `RuntimeEvent` with a missing required field at runtime.
- Line 33: `now()` is evaluated twice, so `created_at` and `updated_at` of a freshly created thread can differ when the two calls straddle a millisecond boundary.
- Line 45–46: `row` destructured from `.returning()` is passed straight to `hydrate(row)` without a presence check, unlike the guards on lines 19, 25 and 68; under `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` this is a compile error (`row` is `... | undefined`) and otherwise a `TypeError` on `row.createdAt` if no row is returned.

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadConfig, redact } from "./config";
import { policySchema, type RuntimeEvent, type Session, type SessionConfig, type SessionData, type Thread } from "./models";

type EventRefs = Partial<Omit<RuntimeEvent, "id" | "type" | "message" | "created_at" | "session_id">>;

export const id = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 12)}`;

export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

export function event(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: RuntimeEvent["type"], message: string, refs: EventRefs = {}): void {
  const item: RuntimeEvent = { ...refs, id: id("evt"), type, message: redact(message), created_at: now(), session_id: sessionId };
  data.events.push(item);
  console.info(redact(JSON.stringify(item)));
}

function hydrate(row: typeof sessions.$inferSelect): Session {
  return { id: row.id, name: row.name, created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(), updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(), data: row.data };
}

export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> {
  const rows = await db.select().from(sessions).orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt));
  return rows.map(hydrate);
}

export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).limit(1);
  if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
  return hydrate(row);
}

export async function mutateSession<T>(sessionId: string, fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).limit(1).for("update");
    if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
    const session = hydrate(row);
    const result = await fn(session);
    await tx.update(sessions).set({ name: session.name, data: session.data, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
    return result;
  });
}

export function createThread(name: string, prompt: string, tags: string[] = []): Thread {
  const timestamp = now();
  return { thread_id: id("thr"), name, system_prompt: prompt, created_at: timestamp, updated_at: timestamp, status: "ready", tags: [...tags], tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}), episodes: [] };
}

  const sessionId = id("ses");

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadConfig, redact } from "./config";
import { policySchema, type RuntimeEvent, type Session, type SessionConfig, type SessionData, type Thread } from "./models";

export const id = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

function toIsoTimestamp(value: unknown, field: string): string {
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid ${field}`);
    return value.toISOString();
  }
  if (typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0) {
    const parsed = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid ${field}`);
    return parsed.toISOString();
  }
  throw new Error(`Invalid ${field}`);
}

function appendEvent(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent> = {}): RuntimeEvent {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.events)) throw new Error("Session data is invalid");
  const base: RuntimeEvent = {
    id: id("evt"),
    type,
    message: redact(message),
    created_at: now(),
    session_id: sessionId,
  };
  const item = { ...base, ...refs, ...base } as RuntimeEvent;
  data.events.push(item);
  return item;
}

function emitEvent(item: RuntimeEvent): void {
  console.info(redact(JSON.stringify(item)));
}

export function event(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: Partial<RuntimeEvent> = {}): void {
  emitEvent(appendEvent(data, sessionId, type, message, refs));
}

function hydrate(row: typeof sessions.$inferSelect): Session {
  if (!row || !row.data || typeof row.data !== "object" || Array.isArray(row.data)) throw new Error("Session data is invalid");
  return {
    id: row.id,
    name: row.name,
    created_at: toIsoTimestamp(row.createdAt, "createdAt"),
    updated_at: toIsoTimestamp(row.updatedAt, "updatedAt"),
    data: row.data,
  };
}

export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> {
  return (await db.select().from(sessions).orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt))).map(hydrate);
}

export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const [row] = await db.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
  if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
  return hydrate(row);
}

export async function mutateSession<T>(sessionId: string, fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update");
    if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
    const session = hydrate(row);
    const result = await fn(session);
    const updatedAt = new Date();
    const updated = await tx.update(sessions).set({ name: session.name, data: session.data, updatedAt }).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).returning({ id: sessions.id });
    if (updated.length !== 1) throw new Error("Session not found");
    session.updated_at = updatedAt.toISOString();
    return result;
  });
}

  return {

    name,
    system_prompt: prompt,
    created_at: now(),
    updated_at: now(),

    tags,
    tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}),
    episodes: [],
  };
}

export async function createSession(name: string, description = "", config: Partial<SessionConfig> = {}, starterThreads = true): Promise<Session> {
  const sessionId = id("ses");
  const data: SessionData = {
    threads: [],
    runs: [],

    config: await loadConfig(config),
    description,

    data.threads = [

      createThread("Implementation", "Implement focused, maintainable changes that satisfy the requested acceptance criteria. Verify the existing environment, follow project instructions, and report the exact files changed.", ["Engineering"]),
      createThread("Review & validation", "Independently review changes, test acceptance criteria, and identify defects or regressions. Report verified evidence and concrete follow-up actions.", ["Quality"]),
    ];
  }
  appendEvent(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Session created. Your workspace is ready.");
  for (const thread of data.threads) appendEvent(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} workstream created`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id });
  const timestamp = new Date();
  const inserted = await db.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name, data, createdAt: timestamp, updatedAt: timestamp }).returning();
  const row = inserted[0];
  if (!row) throw new Error("Failed to create session");
  const session = hydrate(row);
  for (const item of data.events) emitEvent(item);
  return session;
}

export async function ensureWorkspace(): Promise<void> {
  const pendingEvents: RuntimeEvent[] = [];
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(72419731::bigint)`);
    const existing = await tx.select({ id: sessions.id }).from(sessions).limit(1);
    if (existing.length) return;
    const sessionId = id("ses");
    const threads = [
      createThread("Research & discovery", "Investigate requirements, inspect the project, and hand off verified findings and recommendations. Keep each task bounded.", ["Research"]),
      createThread("Implementation", "Build focused, maintainable changes against explicit acceptance criteria. Follow project instructions and verify your work.", ["Engineering"]),
      createThread("Review & validation", "Independently validate changes, inspect code, and report concrete evidence, defects, and next steps.", ["Quality"]),
    ];
    const data: SessionData = {
      threads,
      runs: [],
      steering: [],
      messages: [],
      events: [],
      config: await loadConfig(),
      description: "A fresh workspace for your next big idea. Give the orchestrator a goal, and let your threads take it from there.",
    };
    appendEvent(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Your first session is ready");
    for (const thread of threads) appendEvent(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} is ready for its first task`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id });
    const timestamp = new Date();
    const inserted = await tx.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name: "My first session", data, createdAt: timestamp, updatedAt: timestamp }).returning({ id: sessions.id });
    if (inserted.length !== 1) throw new Error("Failed to create session");
    pendingEvents.push(...data.events);
  });
  for (const item of pendingEvents) emitEvent(item);
}

export async function deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const [row] = await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update");
    if (!row) throw new Error("Session not found");
    if (!row.data || !Array.isArray(row.data.runs)) throw new Error("Session data is invalid");
    for (const run of row.data.runs) {
      if (run == null || typeof run !== "object") throw new Error("Session data is invalid");
      if (run.status === "running") throw new Error("Cancel the active run before deleting this session");
    }
    const deleted = await tx.delete(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).returning({ id: sessions.id });
    if (deleted.length !== 1) throw new Error("Session not found");
  });
}

```typescript
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadConfig, redact } from "./config";
import { policySchema, type RuntimeEvent, type Session, type SessionConfig, type SessionData, type Thread } from "./models";

type SessionRow = typeof sessions.$inferSelect;
type EventRefs = Partial<Omit<RuntimeEvent, "id" | "type" | "message" | "created_at" | "session_id">>;

const SESSION_NOT_FOUND = "Session not found";

export const id = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

function requireRow<T>(rows: readonly T[], message: string): T {
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(message);
  return row;
}

function toIsoString(value: unknown, field: string): string {
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
    return value.toISOString();
  }
  if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number") {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
    return date.toISOString();
  }
  throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function readSessionData(value: unknown): SessionData {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  const data = value as Partial<SessionData>;
  if (!Array.isArray(data.threads)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  if (!Array.isArray(data.runs)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  if (!Array.isArray(data.steering)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  if (!Array.isArray(data.messages)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  if (!Array.isArray(data.events)) throw new Error("Invalid session data");
  return data as SessionData;
}

export function event(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: EventRefs = {}): void {
  const item: RuntimeEvent = { ...refs, id: id("evt"), type, message: redact(message), created_at: now(), session_id: sessionId };
  data.events.push(item);
  console.info(redact(JSON.stringify(item)));
}

function hydrate(row: SessionRow): Session {
  return { id: row.id, name: row.name, created_at: toIsoString(row.createdAt, "createdAt"), updated_at: toIsoString(row.updatedAt, "updatedAt"), data: readSessionData(row.data) };
}

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "@/db";
import { sessions } from "@/db/schema";
import { loadConfig, redact } from "./config";
import { policySchema, type RuntimeEvent, type Session, type SessionConfig, type SessionData, type Thread } from "./models";

type SessionRow = typeof sessions.$inferSelect;
type EventRefs = Partial<Omit<RuntimeEvent, "id" | "type" | "message" | "created_at" | "session_id">>;

const SESSION_NOT_FOUND = "Session not found";
const INVALID_SESSION_DATA = "Invalid session data";

export const id = (prefix: string): string => `${prefix}_${Date.now().toString(36)}_${randomUUID().slice(0, 12)}`;
export const now = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

function requireRow<T>(rows: readonly T[], message: string): T {
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row === undefined) throw new Error(message);
  return row;
}

function toIsoString(value: unknown, field: string): string {
  if (value instanceof Date) {
    if (Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number") {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
    return date.toISOString();
  }

  throw new Error(`Invalid session ${field}`);
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null;
}

function readSessionData(value: unknown): SessionData {
  if (!isRecord(value)) throw new Error(INVALID_SESSION_DATA);

  const data = value as Partial<SessionData>;

  if (!Array.isArray(data.threads) || !Array.isArray(data.runs) || !Array.isArray(data.steering) || !Array.isArray(data.messages) || !Array.isArray(data.events)) {
    throw new Error(INVALID_SESSION_DATA);
  }

  return data as SessionData;
}

function hasRunningRun(data: SessionData): boolean {
  return data.runs.some((run: unknown) => {
    if (!isRecord(run)) throw new Error(INVALID_SESSION_DATA);
    return run.status === "running";
  });
}

export function event(data: SessionData, sessionId: string, type: string, message: string, refs: EventRefs = {}): void {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.events)) throw new Error(INVALID_SESSION_DATA);

  const item: RuntimeEvent = { ...refs, id: id("evt"), type, message: redact(message), created_at: now(), session_id: sessionId };
  data.events.push(item);
  console.info(redact(JSON.stringify(item)));
}

function hydrate(row: SessionRow): Session {
  return { id: row.id, name: row.name, created_at: toIsoString(row.createdAt, "createdAt"), updated_at: toIsoString(row.updatedAt, "updatedAt"), data: readSessionData(row.data) };
}

export async function listSessions(): Promise<Session[]> {
  return (await db.select().from(sessions).orderBy(desc(sessions.updatedAt))).map(hydrate);
}

export async function getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<Session> {
  const row = requireRow(await db.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)), SESSION_NOT_FOUND);
  return hydrate(row);
}

export async function mutateSession<T>(sessionId: string, fn: (session: Session) => T | Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const row = requireRow(await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update"), SESSION_NOT_FOUND);
    const session = hydrate(row);
    const result = await fn(session);
    const updatedAt = new Date();
    session.updated_at = updatedAt.toISOString();
    await tx.update(sessions).set({ name: session.name, data: readSessionData(session.data), updatedAt }).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
    return result;
  });
}

export function createThread(name: string, prompt: string, tags: string[] = []): Thread {
  const timestamp = now();
  return { thread_id: id("thr"), name, system_prompt: prompt, created_at: timestamp, updated_at: timestamp, status: "ready", tags: [...tags], tool_policy: policySchema.parse({}), episodes: [] };
}

export async function createSession(name: string, description = "", config: Partial<SessionConfig> = {}, starterThreads = true): Promise<Session> {
  const sessionId = id("ses");
  const data: SessionData = { threads: [], runs: [], steering: [], messages: [], events: [], config: await loadConfig(config), description };

  if (starterThreads) {
    data.threads = [
      createThread("Research & discovery", "Investigate requirements and the current project. Verify facts, identify constraints, and produce actionable findings. Do not modify application code unless explicitly asked.", ["Research"]),
      createThread("Implementation", "Implement focused, maintainable changes that satisfy the requested acceptance criteria. Verify the existing environment, follow project instructions, and report the exact files changed.", ["Engineering"]),
      createThread("Review & validation", "Independently review changes, test acceptance criteria, and identify defects or regressions. Report verified evidence and concrete follow-up actions.", ["Quality"]),
    ];
  }

  event(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Session created. Your workspace is ready.");

  for (const thread of data.threads) {
    event(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} workstream created`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id });
  }

  const row = requireRow(await db.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name, data }).returning(), "Failed to create session");
  return hydrate(row);
}

export async function ensureWorkspace(): Promise<void> {
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`select pg_advisory_xact_lock(72419731)`);

    const existing = await tx.select({ id: sessions.id }).from(sessions).limit(1);
    if (existing.length > 0) return;

    const sessionId = id("ses");
    const threads = [
      createThread("Research & discovery", "Investigate requirements, inspect the project, and hand off verified findings and recommendations. Keep each task bounded.", ["Research"]),
      createThread("Implementation", "Build focused, maintainable changes against explicit acceptance criteria. Follow project instructions and verify your work.", ["Engineering"]),
      createThread("Review & validation", "Independently validate changes, inspect code, and report concrete evidence, defects, and next steps.", ["Quality"]),
    ];
    const data: SessionData = { threads, runs: [], steering: [], messages: [], events: [], config: await loadConfig(), description: "A fresh workspace for your next big idea. Give the orchestrator a goal, and let your threads take it from there." };

    event(data, sessionId, "session.created", "Your first session is ready");

    for (const thread of threads) {
      event(data, sessionId, "thread.created", `${thread.name} is ready for its first task`, { thread_id: thread.thread_id });
    }

    await tx.insert(sessions).values({ id: sessionId, name: "My first session", data });
  });
}

export async function deleteSession(sessionId: string): Promise<void> {
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const row = requireRow(await tx.select().from(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId)).for("update"), SESSION_NOT_FOUND);
    const data = readSessionData(row.data);

    if (hasRunningRun(data)) throw new Error("Cancel the active run before deleting this session");

    await tx.delete(sessions).where(eq(sessions.id, sessionId));
  });
}

import { HTTPProvider } from "./providers";
import { allowedTools, jailedPath, type ToolContext } from "./tools";
import { now } from "./store";

export type WorkerOutcome = Omit<Episode, "episode_id" | "sequence">;

type EpisodeSubmission = z.infer<typeof episodeSubmissionSchema>;

type UsefulFile = EpisodeSubmission["useful_files"][number] & {
  sha256?: string | undefined;

function describeError(error: unknown): string {
  let message: string;

  try {
    message = error instanceof Error ? String(error.message) : String(error);
  } catch {
    message = "The thrown error could not be converted to a message.";
  }

  try {
    return redact(message) || "The error did not provide a reportable message.";
  } catch {
    return "The error message could not be safely redacted.";
  }
}

export class WorkerFailure extends Error {
  constructor(
    public readonly detail: EpisodeError,
    public readonly usage: Usage,
    public readonly duration: number,
  ) {
    super(detail.message);
    this.name = "WorkerFailure";
  }
}

export async function executeWorker(
  thread: Thread,
  action: string,
  sources: SourceEpisode[],
  config: SessionConfig,
  workspace: string,
  audit: (name: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>,
): Promise<WorkerOutcome> {
  const started = performance.now();
  const duration = (): number =>
    Math.max(0, Math.round(performance.now() - started));

  let usage = emptyUsage();
  let mutated = false;
  let deadline: number | undefined;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const signal = controller.signal;
  const timeoutError = new Error("The operation was aborted due to timeout");
  timeoutError.name = "TimeoutError";

  const touched = new Set<string>();
  const outcomes: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];

  const expireIfNeeded = (): void => {
    if (
      deadline !== undefined &&
      performance.now() >= deadline &&
      !signal.aborted
    ) {
      controller.abort(timeoutError);
    }
  };

  try {
    const timeoutSeconds = config.timeout_sec;
    const maxTurns = config.max_turns;
    const sessionMaxToolCalls = config.max_tool_calls;
    const policyMaxToolCalls = thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls;

    if (!Number.isFinite(timeoutSeconds) || timeoutSeconds < 0) {
      throw new RangeError("timeout_sec must be a finite, non-negative number");
    }

    const timeoutMilliseconds = timeoutSeconds * 1000;

    if (
      !Number.isFinite(timeoutMilliseconds) ||
      timeoutMilliseconds > 2_147_483_647
    ) {
      throw new RangeError(
        "timeout_sec must not exceed 2,147,483.647 seconds",
      );
    }

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxTurns) || maxTurns < 1) {
      throw new RangeError("max_turns must be a positive safe integer");
    }

    if (
      !Number.isSafeInteger(sessionMaxToolCalls) ||
      sessionMaxToolCalls < 0
    ) {
      throw new RangeError(
        "Session max_tool_calls must be a non-negative safe integer",
      );
    }

    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(policyMaxToolCalls) || policyMaxToolCalls < 0) {
      throw new RangeError(
        "Thread max_tool_calls must be a non-negative safe integer",
      );
    }

    const maxToolCalls = Math.min(sessionMaxToolCalls, policyMaxToolCalls);

    deadline = started + timeoutMilliseconds;
    timer = setTimeout(
      () => controller.abort(timeoutError),
      Math.max(0, Math.ceil(deadline - performance.now())),
    );

    const checkActive = (): void => {
      expireIfNeeded();
      signal.throwIfAborted();
    };

    const run = <T>(operation: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> =>
      new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
        const onAbort = (): void => {
          signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
          reject(signal.reason);
        };

        signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });

        let pending: Promise<T>;

        try {
          checkActive();
          pending = operation();
        } catch (error) {
          signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
          reject(error);
          return;
        }

        void pending.then(
          (value) => {
            signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);

            try {
              checkActive();
              resolve(value);
            } catch (error) {
              reject(error);
            }
          },
          (error: unknown) => {
            signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);

            try {
              checkActive();
            } catch (abortError) {
              reject(abortError);
              return;
            }

            reject(error);
          },
        );
      });

    checkActive();

    const workspaceRoot = await run(async () => jailedPath(workspace, "."));
    const root = await run(async () =>
      jailedPath(workspaceRoot, thread.tool_policy.working_dir),
    );
    const instructions = await run(async () =>
      loadInstructions(root, workspaceRoot, action, thread.system_prompt),
    );

    const context = buildContext(
      thread,
      action,
      sources,
      config,
      instructions,
    );

    checkActive();

    const messages = [...context.messages];
    const tools = allowedTools(thread.tool_policy);
    const submissionDefinition = {
      name: "submit_episode",
      description:
        "Submit the one terminal handoff episode for this bounded task. Runtime metadata is assigned by the store.",
      input_schema: jsonSchema(episodeSubmissionSchema),
    };

    const definitions = [
      ...tools.map(({ name, description, input_schema }) => ({
        name,
        description,
        input_schema,
      })),
      submissionDefinition,
    ];

    const provider = new HTTPProvider(config);
    const toolContext: ToolContext = {
      root,
      policy: thread.tool_policy,
      signal,
      touched,
    };

    const repairInstruction =
      "Call submit_episode now, by itself, with a truthful schema-valid handoff. Do not call any other tool. This is your only repair turn.";

    let calls = 0;
    let turns = 0;
    let repairPending = false;
    let finalText = "";

    const inspectUsefulFile = async (
      file: EpisodeSubmission["useful_files"][number],
    ): Promise<UsefulFile> => {
      const resolved = await run(async () => jailedPath(root, file.path));
      const relativePath = path.relative(workspaceRoot, resolved);

      if (
        relativePath === "" ||
        relativePath === ".." ||
        relativePath.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
        path.isAbsolute(relativePath)
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          `Useful path cannot be represented as a file within the workspace: ${file.path}`,
        );
      }

      const info = await run(async () => stat(resolved));

      if (!info.isFile()) {
        throw new Error(`Useful path is not a file: ${file.path}`);
      }

      let sha256: string | undefined;

      if (info.size <= 16_000_000) {
        const contents = await run(async () =>
          readFile(resolved, { signal }),
        );
        const after = await run(async () => stat(resolved));

        if (
          !after.isFile() ||
          after.dev !== info.dev ||
          after.ino !== info.ino ||
          after.size !== info.size ||
          contents.byteLength !== info.size ||
          after.mtimeMs !== info.mtimeMs ||
          after.ctimeMs !== info.ctimeMs
        ) {
          throw new Error(
            `Useful file changed while it was being inspected: ${file.path}`,
          );
        }

        sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(contents).digest("hex");
      }

      const checkedPath = await run(async () =>
        jailedPath(root, file.path),
      );

      if (checkedPath !== resolved) {
        throw new Error(
          `Useful path changed while it was being inspected: ${file.path}`,
        );
      }

      checkActive();

      return {
        ...file,
        path: relativePath.replaceAll(path.sep, "/"),
        sha256,
      };
    };

    const finish = (
      submission: EpisodeSubmission,
      usefulFiles: UsefulFile[],
      error?: EpisodeError,
    ): WorkerOutcome => {
      checkActive();

      if (submission.status === "failed") {
        throw new Error(`Worker reported failure: ${submission.summary}`);
      }

      const outcome: WorkerOutcome = {
        ...submission,
        useful_files: usefulFiles,
        thread_id: thread.thread_id,
        created_at: now(),
        requested_action: action,
        token_usage: usage,
        duration_ms: duration(),
        source_episode_refs: context.sourceIds,
        ...(error === undefined ? {} : { error }),
      };

      checkActive();

      return outcome;
    };

    while (turns < maxTurns || repairPending) {
      checkActive();

      const repairTurn = repairPending;
      repairPending = false;

      if (!repairTurn) {
        turns += 1;

        if (turns === maxTurns) {
          messages.push({
            role: "user",
            content:
              "This is your last regular turn. Submit your best truthful handoff with submit_episode by itself.",
          });
        }
      }

      const availableDefinitions =
        repairTurn || calls >= maxToolCalls
          ? [submissionDefinition]
          : definitions;

      const response = await run(async () => {
        const received = await provider.chat(
          messages,
          availableDefinitions,
          config.worker_model,
          signal,
        );

        usage = addUsage(usage, received.usage);

        return received;
      });

      const responseText = response.text || "";

      if (responseText.trim()) {
        finalText = responseText;
      }

      messages.push({
        role: "assistant",
        content: responseText,
        ...(response.tool_calls.length
          ? { tool_calls: response.tool_calls }
          : {}),
      });

      if (!response.tool_calls.length) {
        if (repairTurn) {
          break;
        }

        repairPending = true;
        messages.push({
          role: "user",
          content: `VALIDATION ERROR: You ended without submit_episode. ${repairInstruction}`,
        });
        continue;
      }

      const submissionCall = response.tool_calls.find(
        (call) => call.name === "submit_episode",
      );

      if (submissionCall && response.tool_calls.length !== 1) {
        for (const call of response.tool_calls) {
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: call.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({
              error:
                "submit_episode must be the only tool in the terminal response; none of this turn's tools were executed",
              instruction: repairTurn
                ? "The single repair turn has ended without a valid terminal submission."
                : repairInstruction,
            }),
          });
        }

        if (repairTurn) {
          break;
        }

        repairPending = true;
        continue;
      }

      if (submissionCall) {
        let submission: EpisodeSubmission;

        try {
          submission = episodeSubmissionSchema.parse(
            submissionCall.arguments,
          );
        } catch (error) {
          checkActive();

          if (repairTurn) {
            throw error;
          }

          repairPending = true;
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: submissionCall.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({
              error: describeError(error),
              instruction: repairInstruction,
            }),
          });
          continue;
        }

        if (submission.status === "failed") {
          throw new Error(`Worker reported failure: ${submission.summary}`);
        }

        try {
          const usefulFiles: UsefulFile[] = [];

          for (const file of submission.useful_files) {
            usefulFiles.push(await inspectUsefulFile(file));
          }

          return finish(submission, usefulFiles);
        } catch (error) {
          checkActive();

          if (repairTurn) {
            throw error;
          }

          repairPending = true;
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: submissionCall.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({
              error: describeError(error),
              instruction: repairInstruction,
            }),
          });
          continue;
        }
      }

      if (repairTurn) {
        for (const call of response.tool_calls) {
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: call.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({
              error:
                "Only a standalone submit_episode call was permitted during the repair turn; none of this turn's tools were executed",
            }),
          });
        }

        break;
      }

      for (const call of response.tool_calls) {
        checkActive();

        if (calls >= maxToolCalls) {
          throw new Error("Worker tool-call limit exceeded");
        }

        calls += 1;

        const selected = tools.find((tool) => tool.name === call.name);

        if (!selected) {
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: call.id,
            content: JSON.stringify({
              error: describeError(
                `Tool ${call.name} is not granted by this thread's policy`,
              ),
            }),
          });
          continue;
        }

        if (selected.is_mutating) {
          await run(async () =>
            audit("tool.mutation_started", {
              tool: selected.name,
              environment_may_have_advanced: true,
            }),
          );
        }

        let result: unknown;

        try {
          result = await run(async () => {
            if (selected.is_mutating) {
              mutated = true;
            }

            return selected.execute(call.arguments, toolContext);
          });
        } catch (error) {
          checkActive();

          const message = describeError(error);
          const text = truncate(
            JSON.stringify({
              error: message,
              environment_may_have_advanced: mutated,
            }),
            24_000,
          );

          await run(async () =>
            audit("tool.failed", {
              tool: selected.name,
              error: message,
              environment_may_have_advanced: mutated,
            }),
          );

          outcomes.push({
            key: selected.name,
            value: truncate(text, 1_000),
          });
          messages.push({
            role: "tool",
            tool_call_id: call.id,
            content: text,
          });
          continue;
        }

        let text: string;

        try {
          const serialized = JSON.stringify(result);

          text =
            serialized === undefined
              ? JSON.stringify({
                  tool_execution_completed: true,
                  json_result_available: false,
                })
              : truncate(redact(serialized), 24_000);
        } catch (error) {
          text = truncate(
            JSON.stringify({
              tool_execution_completed: true,
              error: `The tool returned successfully, but its result could not be prepared for the conversation: ${describeError(error)}`,
              environment_may_have_advanced: mutated,
              instruction:
                "Verify the actual state before retrying. Do not repeat a mutating operation solely because its result could not be prepared.",
            }),
            24_000,
          );
        }

        checkActive();

        await run(async () =>
          audit("tool.completed", {
            tool: selected.name,
            is_mutating: selected.is_mutating,
          }),
        );

        outcomes.push({
          key: selected.name,
          value: truncate(text, 1_000),
        });
        messages.push({
          role: "tool",
          tool_call_id: call.id,
          content: text,
        });
      }

      if (turns >= maxTurns || calls >= maxToolCalls) {
        repairPending = true;

        const reason =
          calls >= maxToolCalls
            ? "The tool-call budget is exhausted."
            : "The regular turn budget is exhausted.";

        messages.push({
          role: "user",
          content: `${reason} ${repairInstruction}`,
        });
      }
    }

    checkActive();

    const usefulFiles: UsefulFile[] = [];
    const fileInspectionErrors: string[] = [];

    for (const file of touched) {
      checkActive();

      if (usefulFiles.length >= 80) {
        break;
      }

      try {
        usefulFiles.push(
          await inspectUsefulFile({
            path: file,
            role:
              "File modified during this worker run; inspect to verify the current state",
          }),
        );
      } catch (error) {
        checkActive();

        if (
          (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException | null | undefined)?.code !==
            "ENOENT" &&
          fileInspectionErrors.length < 80
        ) {
          fileInspectionErrors.push(
            truncate(
              describeError(
                `Useful file ${file}: ${describeError(error)}`,
              ),
              1_000,
            ),
          );
        }
      }
    }

    if (fileInspectionErrors.length) {
      outcomes.push({
        key: "file_inspection_errors",
        value: truncate(fileInspectionErrors.join("\n"), 1_000),
      });
    }

    if (!finalText.trim() && !outcomes.length && !usefulFiles.length) {
      throw new Error(
        "Worker ended without a final message, useful files, or recorded tool outcomes",
      );
    }

    const retainedOutcomes = outcomes.slice(-80);
    const summaryParts = [
      "The worker did not submit a validated terminal handoff.",
    ];

    if (retainedOutcomes.length) {
      summaryParts.push(
        `Observed outcomes:\n${retainedOutcomes
          .map((outcome) => `${outcome.key}: ${outcome.value}`)
          .join("\n")}`,
      );
    }

    if (finalText.trim()) {
      summaryParts.push(
        `Last non-empty assistant text (unverified):\n${redact(finalText)}`,
      );
    }

    const submission = episodeSubmissionSchema.parse({
      summary: truncate(summaryParts.join("\n\n"), 4_000),
      useful_files: usefulFiles.map((file) => ({
        path: file.path,
        role: file.role,
      })),
      results: retainedOutcomes,
      open_questions: [
        "The worker did not submit a validated handoff; verify these observed results and any unverified assistant claims.",
      ],
      next_steps: [
        "Verify the actual workspace state before continuing.",
      ],
      status: "partial",
    });

    return finish(submission, usefulFiles, {
      type: "episode_not_submitted",
      message:
        "No validated episode was submitted after the single repair turn; a partial handoff was extracted from the actual transcript, file inspection, and tool outcomes.",
      recoverable: true,
      environment_may_have_advanced: mutated,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    expireIfNeeded();

    throw new WorkerFailure(
      {
        type: signal.aborted ? "worker_timeout" : "worker_failure",
        message: describeError(error),
        recoverable: true,
        environment_may_have_advanced: mutated,
      },
      usage,
      duration(),
    );
  } finally {
    if (timer !== undefined) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }
}
```

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { buildContext, truncate, type SourceEpisode } from "./context";
import { redact } from "./config";
import { loadInstructions } from "./instructions";
import { addUsage, emptyUsage, episodeSubmissionSchema, jsonSchema, type Episode, type EpisodeError, type SessionConfig, type Thread, type Usage } from "./models";
import { HTTPProvider } from "./providers";
import { allowedTools, jailed Path, type ToolContext } from "./tools";
import { now } from "./store";

export type WorkerOutcome = Omit<Episode, "episode_id" | "sequence">;
export class WorkerFailure extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly detail: EpisodeError, public readonly usage: Usage, public readonly duration: number) { super(detail.message); this.name = "WorkerFailure"; }
}
export async function executeWorker(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, workspace: string, audit: (name: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>): Promise<WorkerOutcome> {
  const started = Date.now();
  let usage = emptyUsage();
  let mutated = false;
  const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(config.timeout_sec * 1000);
  const touched = new Set<string>();
  const outcomes: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];
  try {
    const root = await jailedPath(workspace, thread.tool_policy.working_dir);
     const instructions = await loadInstructions(root, workspace, action, thread.system_prompt);
     const context = buildContext(thread, action, sources, config, instructions);
     const messages = context.messages;
     const tools = allowedTools(thread.tool policy);
     const definitions = [...tools.map(({ name, description, input_schema }) => ({ name, description, input_schema })), { name: "submit_episode", description: "Submit the one terminal handoff episode for this bounded task. Runtime metadata is assigned by the store.", input_schema: jsonSchema(episode SubmissionSchema) }];
     const provider = new HTTPProvider(config);
     const toolContext: ToolContext = { root, policy: thread.tool_policy, signal, touched };
     let calls = 0;
     let repaired = false;
     let finalText = "";
     const finish = async (submission: z.infer <typeof episodeSubmissionSchema>, error?: EpisodeError): Promise<WorkerOutcome> => {
       if (submission.status === "failed") throw new Error(`Worker reported failure: ${submission.summary}`);
       const usefulFiles = [];
       for (const file of submission.useful_files) {
         const resolved = await jailedPath (root, file.path);
         const info = await stat(resolved);
         if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error(`Useful path is not a file: ${file.path}`);
         const sha256 = info.size <= 16000000 ? createHash("sha256").update(await readFile(resolved)).digest ("hex") : undefined;
         usefulFiles.push({ ...file, path: path.relative(workspace, resolved).replaceAll(path.sep, "/"), sha256 });
       }
       return { ...submission, useful_files: usefulFiles, thread_id: thread.thread_id, created_at: now(), requested_action: action, token_usage: usage, duration_ms: Date.now() - started, source_episode_refs: context.sourceIds, ...(error ? { error } : {}) };
     };
     for (let turn = 0; turn < config.max_turns + 1; turn++) {
       signal.throwIfAborted();
       const response = await provider.chat(messages, definitions, config.worker_model, signal);
       usage = addUsage(usage, response.usage);
       finalText = response.text || finalText;
       messages.push({ role: "assistant", content: response.text, ...(response.tool_calls.length ? { tool_calls: response.tool_calls } : {}) });
       if (!response.tool_calls.length) {
         if (!repaired) { repaired = true; messages.push({ role: "user", content: "VALIDATION ERROR: You ended without submit_episode. Call submit_episode now with a truthful schema-valid handoff. This is your only repair turn." }); continue; }
         break;
       }
       const submissionCalls = response.tool_calls.filter((call) => call.name === "submit_episode");
       if (submissionCalls.length && response.tool_calls.length !== 1) {
         for (const call of response.tool_calls) messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: "submit_episode must be the only tool in the terminal response; none of this turn's tools were executed" }) });
         continue;
       }
       for (const call of response.tool_calls) {
         signal.throwIfAborted();
         if (call.name === "submit_episode") {
           try { return await finish(episodeSubmissionSchema.parse(call.arguments)); }
           catch (error) {
             if (repaired) throw error;
             repaired = true;
             messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: redact(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)), instruction: "Repair your episode and call submit_episode once. This is your only repair turn." }) });
             continue;
           }
         }
         if (++calls > Math.min(config.max_tool_calls, thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls)) throw new Error("Worker tool call limit exceeded");
         const selected = tools.find((tool) => tool.name === call.name);
         if (!selected) { messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: `Tool ${call.name} is not granted by this thread's policy` }) }); continue; }
         if (selected.is_mutating) { mutated = true; await audit("tool.mutation_started", { tool: selected.name, environment_may_have_advanced: true }); }
         try {
           const result = await selected.execute(call.arguments, toolContext);
           const text = truncate(redact(JSON.stringify (result)), 24000);
           outcomes.push({ key: selected.name, value: truncate(text, 1000) });
           messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: text });
           await audit("tool.completed", { tool: selected.name, is_mutating: selected is_mutating });
         } catch (error) {
           signal.throwIfAborted();
           const message = redact(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error));
           messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message }) });
           await audit("tool failed", { tool: selected.name, error: message, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated });
         }
       }
       if (turn === config.max_turns - 2) messages.push({ role: "user", content: "Turn budget is almost exhausted. Submit your best truthful complete or partial episode now." });
     }
     const files: { path: string; role: string }[] = [];
     for (const file of touched) { try { if ((await stat(await jailedPath(root, file))).isFile()) files.push({ path: file, role: "File modified during this worker run; inspect to verify the current state" }); } catch (error) { if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "ENOENT") throw error; } }
     if (!finalText && !outcomes.length) throw new Error("Worker ended without a final message or useful tool outcomes");
     return await finish({ summary : truncate(finalText || outcomes.map((outcome) => `${outcome.key}: ${outcome.value}`).join("\n"), 4000), useful_files: files.slice(0, 80), results: outcomes.slice(-80), open_questions: ["The worker did not submit a validated handoff; verify these transcript-derived results "], next_steps: ["Verify the actual workspace state before continuing."], status: "partial" }, { type: "episode_not_submitted", message: "No episode was submitted after the repair request; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes.", recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced : mutated });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new WorkerFailure({ type: signal.aborted ? "worker_timeout" : "worker_failure", message: redact(error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)), recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated }, usage, Date.now() - started);
 }
}
