import { open, readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { buildContext, truncate, type SourceEpisode } from "./context";
import { redact } from "./config";
import { loadInstructions } from "./instructions";
import { addUsage, emptyUsage, episodeSubmissionSchema, jsonSchema, type Episode, type EpisodeError, type SessionConfig, type Thread, type Usage } from "./models";
import { HTTPProvider } from "./providers";
import { allowedTools, jailedPath, type ToolContext } from "./tools";
import { now } from "./store";

type Submission = z.infer<typeof episodeSubmissionSchema>;

class FailedSubmission extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "FailedSubmission";
  }
}

function errorText(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message;
  if (typeof error === "string") return error;
  return "Worker request failed";
}

function safeRedact(value: string): string {
  try {
    return redact(value);
  } catch {
    return "[redaction failed]";
  }
}

function encodeJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (typeof value === "symbol" || typeof value === "function") {
    return JSON.stringify({ error: "Tool result was not JSON-serializable", executed: true });
  }
  try {
    const encoded = JSON.stringify(value, (_key, item) => typeof item === "bigint" ? item.toString() : item);
    if (typeof encoded === "string") return encoded;
  } catch {
    return JSON.stringify({ error: "Tool result was not JSON-serializable", executed: true });
  }
  return "null";
}

function withSignal<T>(work: Promise<T>, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  const promise = Promise.resolve(work);
  void promise.catch(() => undefined);
  if (signal.aborted) {
    const reason = signal.reason;
    return Promise.reject(reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error("The operation was aborted due to timeout"));
  }
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    const onAbort = () => {
      const reason = signal.reason;
      reject(reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error("The operation was aborted due to timeout"));
    };
    signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    promise.then(
      (value) => {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
        resolve(value);
      },
      (error) => {
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
        reject(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(errorText(error)));
      }
    );
  });
}

function timeoutMilliseconds(seconds: number): number {
  if (typeof seconds !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) throw new Error("Invalid worker timeout");
  const milliseconds = seconds === 0 ? 0 : Math.max(1, Math.round(seconds * 1000));
  if (milliseconds > 2147483647) throw new Error("Invalid worker timeout");
  return milliseconds;
}

function nonNegativeInteger(value: number, label: string): number {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) throw new Error(`Invalid ${label}`);
  return Math.floor(value);
}

function portableRelative(workspace: string, resolved: string, requested: string): string {
  const relativePath = path.relative(workspace, resolved);
  if (relativePath.length === 0 || relativePath === ".." || relativePath.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(relativePath)) {
    throw new Error(`Useful path escapes workspace: ${requested.slice(0, 500)}`);
  }
  return relativePath.replaceAll(path.sep, "/");
}

async function hashFile(filePath: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<string> {
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  const info = await stat(filePath);
  signal.throwIfAborted();
  if (info.size <= 16000000) {
    const data = await readFile(filePath);
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    if (data.length > 64000000) throw new Error("Useful file changed size during hashing");
    return createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");
  }
  const handle = await open(filePath, "r");
  try {
    const hash = createHash("sha256");
    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(1024 * 1024);
    while (true) {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      const read = await handle.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length, null);
      if (read.bytesRead === 0) break;
      hash.update(buffer.subarray(0, read.bytesRead));
    }
    return hash.digest("hex");
  } finally {
    await handle.close().catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

export type WorkerOutcome = Omit<Episode, "episode_id" | "sequence">;

export class WorkerFailure extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly detail: EpisodeError, public readonly usage: Usage, public readonly duration: number) {
    super(detail.message);
    this.name = "WorkerFailure";
    if (typeof Error.captureStackTrace === "function") Error.captureStackTrace(this, WorkerFailure);
  }
}

export async function executeWorker(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, workspace: string, audit: (name: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>): Promise<WorkerOutcome> {
  const started = Date.now();
  let usage = emptyUsage();
  let mutated = false;
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const signal = controller.signal;
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  let settled = false;
  try {
    const timeoutMs = timeoutMilliseconds(config.timeout_sec);
    const maxTurns = nonNegativeInteger(config.max_turns, "worker turn limit");
    const toolCallLimit = Math.min(nonNegativeInteger(config.max_tool_calls, "worker tool-call limit"), nonNegativeInteger(thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls, "thread tool-call limit"));
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (settled) return;
      const timeoutFailure = new Error("The operation was aborted due to timeout");
      timeoutFailure.name = "TimeoutError";
      controller.abort(timeoutFailure);
    }, timeoutMs);
    const timerObject = timer as unknown as { unref?: () => void };
    if (typeof timerObject.unref === "function") timerObject.unref();
    const root = await withSignal(jailedPath(workspace, thread.tool_policy.working_dir), signal);
    const instructions = await withSignal(loadInstructions(root, workspace, action, thread.system_prompt), signal);
    const context = buildContext(thread, action, sources, config, instructions);
    if (!context || !Array.isArray(context.messages)) throw new Error("Worker context is missing messages");
    const messages = [...context.messages];
    const tools = allowedTools(thread.tool_policy);
    const definitions = [...tools.map(({ name, description, input_schema }) => ({ name, description, input_schema })), { name: "submit_episode", description: "Submit the one terminal handoff episode for this bounded task. Runtime metadata is assigned by the store.", input_schema: jsonSchema(episodeSubmissionSchema) }];
    const provider = new HTTPProvider(config);
    const toolContext: ToolContext = { root, policy: thread.tool_policy, signal, touched };
    const touched = new Set<string>();
    const outcomes: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];
    let calls = 0;
    let repaired = false;
    let pendingRepairTurn = false;
    let toolLimitReached = false;
    let finalText = "";
    const finish = async (submission: Submission, episodeError?: EpisodeError, strictFiles = true): Promise<WorkerOutcome> => {
      if (submission.status === "failed") throw new FailedSubmission(`Worker reported failure: ${submission.summary}`);
      const usefulFiles: Submission["useful_files"] = [];
      const notes: string[] = [];
      let omittedFileNotes = false;
      const declaredFiles = Array.isArray(submission.useful_files) ? submission.useful_files : [];
      for (const file of declaredFiles) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        try {
          if (!file || typeof file.path !== "string" || file.path.length === 0 || file.path.includes("\0")) throw new Error("Useful path is not a file");
          const resolved = await withSignal(jailedPath(root, file.path), signal);
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const info = await withSignal(stat(resolved), signal);
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error(`Useful path is not a file: ${file.path}`);
          const sha256 = await withSignal(hashFile(resolved, signal), signal);
          const portable = portableRelative(workspace, resolved, file.path);
          usefulFiles.push({ ...file, path: portable, sha256 });
        } catch (error) {
          if (signal.aborted || strictFiles) throw error;
          if (notes.length < 20) notes.push(truncate(safeRedact(errorText(error)), 500));
          else if (!omittedFileNotes) {
            omittedFileNotes = true;
            notes.push("Additional useful file errors were omitted.");
          }
        }
      }
      const baseQuestions = Array.isArray(submission.open_questions) ? submission.open_questions : [];
      return {
        ...submission,
        useful_files: usefulFiles,
        thread_id: thread.thread_id,
        created_at: now(),
        requested_action: action,
        token_usage: usage,
        duration_ms: Date.now() - started,
        source_episode_refs: context.sourceIds,
        ...(notes.length ? { open_questions: [...baseQuestions, ...notes] } : {}),
        ...(episodeError ? { error: episodeError } : {})
      };
    };
    toolContext.touched = touched;
    for (let turn = 0; turn < maxTurns || pendingRepairTurn; turn += 1) {
      if (turn > maxTurns) break;
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (turn >= maxTurns) pendingRepairTurn = false;
      const response = await withSignal(provider.chat(messages, definitions, config.worker_model, signal), signal);
      if (!response || typeof response !== "object") throw new Error("Provider returned an invalid response");
      if (response.usage) usage = addUsage(usage, response.usage);
      if (response.tool_calls != null && !Array.isArray(response.tool_calls)) throw new Error("Provider returned an invalid tool call list");
      const text = typeof response.text === "string" ? response.text : "";
      if (text.trim().length > 0) finalText = text;
      const toolCalls = Array.isArray(response.tool_calls) ? response.tool_calls : [];
      for (const call of toolCalls) {
        if (!call || typeof call.name !== "string" || typeof call.id !== "string") throw new Error("Provider returned an invalid tool call");
      }
      messages.push({ role: "assistant", content: text, ...(toolCalls.length ? { tool_calls: toolCalls } : {}) });
      if (!toolCalls.length) {
        if (!repaired) {
          repaired = true;
          pendingRepairTurn = turn + 1 >= maxTurns;
          messages.push({ role: "user", content: "VALIDATION ERROR: You ended without submit_episode. Call submit_episode now with a truthful schema-valid handoff. This is your only repair turn." });
          continue;
        }
        break;
      }
      const submissionCalls = toolCalls.filter((call) => call.name === "submit_episode");
      if (submissionCalls.length && toolCalls.length !== 1) {
        for (const call of toolCalls) {
          messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: "submit_episode must be the only tool in the terminal response; none of this turn's tools were executed" }) });
        }
      } else {
        for (const call of toolCalls) {
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          if (call.name === "submit_episode") {
            try {
              return await finish(episodeSubmissionSchema.parse(call.arguments));
            } catch (error) {
              if (error instanceof FailedSubmission || signal.aborted) throw error;
              if (repaired) throw error;
              repaired = true;
              pendingRepairTurn = turn + 1 >= maxTurns;
              messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: truncate(safeRedact(errorText(error)), 4000), instruction: "Repair your episode and call submit_episode once. This is your only repair turn." }) });
              continue;
            }
          }
          if (calls >= toolCallLimit) {
            toolLimitReached = true;
            messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: "Worker tool-call limit exceeded", instruction: "Submit your best truthful complete or partial episode now. Do not call tools other than submit_episode." }) });
            continue;
          }
          calls += 1;
          const selected = tools.find((tool) => tool.name === call.name);
          if (!selected) {
            messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: `Tool ${call.name} is not granted by this thread's policy` }) });
            continue;
          }
          if (selected.is_mutating) {
            mutated = true;
            await withSignal(audit("tool.mutation_started", { tool: selected.name, environment_may_have_advanced: true }), signal);
          }
          try {
            const result = await withSignal(Promise.resolve().then(() => selected.execute(call.arguments, toolContext)), signal);
            const encoded = truncate(safeRedact(encodeJson(result)), 24000);
            outcomes.push({ key: selected.name, value: truncate(encoded, 1000) });
            messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: encoded });
            await withSignal(audit("tool.completed", { tool: selected.name, is_mutating: selected.is_mutating }), signal);
          } catch (error) {
            if (signal.aborted) throw error;
            const message = truncate(safeRedact(errorText(error)), 4000);
            outcomes.push({ key: selected.name, value: truncate(JSON.stringify({ error: message }), 1000) });
            messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message }) });
            await withSignal(audit("tool.failed", { tool: selected.name, error: message, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated }), signal);
          }
        }
      }
      if (turn === maxTurns - 2) messages.push({ role: "user", content: "Turn budget is almost exhausted. Submit your best truthful complete or partial episode now." });
    }
    const files: { path: string; role: string }[] = [];
    const inspectionNotes: string[] = [];
    let omittedInspectionErrors = false;
    for (const file of touched) {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      try {
        const resolved = await withSignal(jailedPath(root, file), signal);
        const info = await withSignal(stat(resolved), signal);
        if (info.isFile()) files.push({ path: file, role: "File modified during this worker run; inspect to verify the current state" });
      } catch (error) {
        if (signal.aborted) throw error;
        const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code;
        if (code === "ENOENT") continue;
        if (inspectionNotes.length < 20) inspectionNotes.push(truncate(safeRedact(errorText(error)), 500));
        else if (!omittedInspectionErrors) {
          omittedInspectionErrors = true;
          inspectionNotes.push("Additional touched path inspection errors were omitted.");
        }
      }
    }
    if (!finalText && outcomes.length === 0 && files.length === 0 && !mutated) {
      throw new Error(toolLimitReached ? "Worker tool-call limit exceeded" : "Worker ended without a final message or useful tool outcomes");
    }
    const stopDetail = toolLimitReached && repaired
      ? "Worker tool-call limit exceeded and no episode was submitted after the repair request; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes."
      : toolLimitReached
        ? "Worker tool-call limit exceeded before submit_episode; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes."
        : repaired
          ? "No episode was submitted after the repair request; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes."
          : "Turn budget ended before submit_episode; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes.";
    const openQuestions = ["The worker did not submit a validated handoff; verify these transcript-derived results.", ...inspectionNotes];
    if (files.length > 80) openQuestions.push(`Truncated useful_files from ${String(files.length)} to 80.`);
    if (outcomes.length > 80) openQuestions.push(`Truncated results from ${String(outcomes.length)} to the most recent 80.`);
    const summarySource = finalText || outcomes.map((outcome) => `${outcome.key}: ${outcome.value}`).join("\n") || "Worker ended without a final message. Inspect the workspace state before continuing.";
    return await finish({
      summary: truncate(summarySource, 4000),
      useful_files: files.slice(0, 80),
      results: outcomes.slice(-80),
      open_questions: openQuestions,
      next_steps: ["Verify the actual workspace state before continuing."],
      status: "partial"
    }, {
      type: "episode_not_submitted",
      message: stopDetail,
      recoverable: true,
      environment_may_have_advanced: mutated
    }, false);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof WorkerFailure) throw error;
    throw new WorkerFailure({
      type: signal.aborted ? "worker_timeout" : "worker_failure",
      message: truncate(safeRedact(errorText(error)), 4000),
      recoverable: true,
      environment_may_have_advanced: mutated
    }, usage, Date.now() - started);
  } finally {
    settled = true;
    if (timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

```typescript
import { readFile, stat } from "node:fs/promises";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import path from "node:path";
import { z } from "zod";
import { buildContext, truncate, type SourceEpisode } from "./context";
import { redact } from "./config";
import { loadInstructions } from "./instructions";
import { addUsage, emptyUsage, episodeSubmissionSchema, jsonSchema, type Episode, type EpisodeError, type SessionConfig, type Thread, type Usage } from "./models";
import { HTTPProvider } from "./providers";
import { allowedTools, jailedPath, type ToolContext } from "./tools";
import { now } from "./store";

export type WorkerOutcome = Omit<Episode, "episode_id" | "sequence">;

type EpisodeSubmission = z.infer<typeof episodeSubmissionSchema>;
type UsefulFileSubmission = NonNullable<EpisodeSubmission["useful_files"]>[number];
type UsefulFileOutcome = NonNullable<WorkerOutcome["useful_files"]>[number];

const MAX_HASH_BYTES = 16000000;
const MAX_ABORT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2147483647;

export class WorkerFailure extends Error {
  constructor(public readonly detail: EpisodeError, public readonly usage: Usage, public readonly duration: number) {
    super(detail.message);
    this.name = "WorkerFailure";
    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);
  }
}

function safeString(value: unknown): string {
  try {
    return String(value);
  } catch {
    try {
      return Object.prototype.toString.call(value);
    } catch {
      return "[unprintable value]";
    }
  }
}

function messageFromError(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof Error) return error.message || error.name || safeString(error);
  return safeString(error);
}

function redactText(text: string): string {
  try {
    return redact(text);
  } catch {
    return "[redaction failed]";
  }
}

function redactRequiredText(text: string): string {
  const redacted = redactText(text);
  return redacted.trim() ? redacted : "[redacted]";
}

function redactedErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
  return redactRequiredText(messageFromError(error));
}

function timeoutMilliseconds(timeoutSeconds: number): number {
  if (timeoutSeconds === Infinity) return MAX_ABORT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  if (!Number.isFinite(timeoutSeconds)) return 0;
  const milliseconds = Math.ceil(timeoutSeconds * 1000);
  if (milliseconds === Infinity) return MAX_ABORT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  if (!Number.isFinite(milliseconds) || milliseconds <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.min(milliseconds, MAX_ABORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

function createTimeoutSignal(timeoutSeconds: number): AbortSignal {
  const milliseconds = timeoutMilliseconds(timeoutSeconds);
  if (milliseconds === 0) {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    controller.abort(new Error("Worker timed out"));
    return controller.signal;
  }
  if (typeof AbortSignal.timeout === "function") return AbortSignal.timeout(milliseconds);
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(new Error("Worker timed out")), milliseconds);
  (timeout as { unref?: () => void }).unref?.();
  return controller.signal;
}

function abortError(signal: AbortSignal): Error {
  const reason = (signal as AbortSignal & { reason?: unknown }).reason;
  if (reason instanceof Error) return reason;
  return new Error(typeof reason === "undefined" ? "Operation aborted" : safeString(reason));
}

function withAbort<T>(operation: () => Promise<T> | T, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  if (signal.aborted) return Promise.reject(abortError(signal));
  let operationPromise: Promise<T>;
  try {
    operationPromise = Promise.resolve(operation());
  } catch (error) {
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
  if (signal.aborted) {
    operationPromise.catch(() => undefined);
    return Promise.reject(abortError(signal));
  }
  return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    const onAbort = () => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
      reject(abortError(signal));
    };
    signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
    operationPromise.then(
      (value) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
        resolve(value);
      },
      (error) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        signal.removeEventListener("abort", onAbort);
        reject(error);
      },
    );
  });
}

function nonNegativeSafeInteger(value: number, name: string): number {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(value) || value < 0) throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative safe integer`);
  return value;
}

function parseArguments(argumentsValue: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof argumentsValue !== "string") return argumentsValue;
  const trimmed = argumentsValue.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return argumentsValue;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return argumentsValue;
  }
}

function stringifyUnknown(value: unknown): string {
  const seen = new WeakSet<object>();
  try {
    const json = JSON.stringify(value, (_key, current: unknown) => {
      if (typeof current === "bigint") return current.toString();
      if (current instanceof Error) return { name: current.name, message: current.message };
      if (typeof current === "object" && current !== null) {
        if (seen.has(current)) return "[Circular]";
        seen.add(current);
      }
      if (typeof current === "undefined") return "[Undefined]";
      if (typeof current === "function") return `[Function${current.name ? ` ${current.name}` : ""}]`;
      if (typeof current === "symbol") return current.toString();
      return current;
    });
    if (typeof json === "string") return json;
  } catch (error) {
    return JSON.stringify({ serialization_error: messageFromError(error) });
  }
  return JSON.stringify({ result: safeString(value) });
}

function portableRelativePath(base: string, resolved: string): string {
  const relative = path.relative(base, resolved);
  if (relative === "" || relative === ".." || relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) || path.isAbsolute(relative)) throw new Error(`Path escaped workspace: ${resolved}`);
  return relative.split(path.sep).join("/");
}

function redactSubmission(submission: EpisodeSubmission): EpisodeSubmission {
  return {
    ...submission,
    summary: redactRequiredText(submission.summary),
    useful_files: (submission.useful_files ?? []).map((file) => ({ ...file, role: redactRequiredText(file.role) })),
    results: (submission.results ?? []).map((result) => ({ ...result, key: redactRequiredText(result.key), value: redactRequiredText(result.value) })),
    open_questions: (submission.open_questions ?? []).map((question) => redactRequiredText(question)),
    next_steps: (submission.next_steps ?? []).map((step) => redactRequiredText(step)),
  };
}

async function normalizeUsefulFile(file: UsefulFileSubmission, root: string, workspaceRoot: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<UsefulFileOutcome> {
  const resolved = await withAbort(() => jailedPath(root, file.path), signal);
  const relativePath = portableRelativePath(workspaceRoot, resolved);
  const info = await withAbort(() => stat(resolved), signal);
  if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error(`Useful path is not a file: ${file.path}`);
  let sha256: string | undefined;
  if (info.size <= MAX_HASH_BYTES) {
    const content = await withAbort(() => readFile(resolved), signal);
    sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(content).digest("hex");
  }
  const normalizedFile = { ...file, path: relativePath };
  delete (normalizedFile as { sha256?: string }).sha256;
  if (sha256 !== undefined) (normalizedFile as { sha256?: string }).sha256 = sha256;
  return normalizedFile as UsefulFileOutcome;
}

export async function executeWorker(thread: Thread, action: string, sources: SourceEpisode[], config: SessionConfig, workspace: string, audit: (name: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>): Promise<WorkerOutcome> {
  const started = Date.now();
  let usage = emptyUsage();
  let mutated = false;
  const signal = createTimeoutSignal(config.timeout_sec);
  const touched = new Set<string>();
  const outcomes: { key: string; value: string }[] = [];
  try {
    const maxTurns = nonNegativeSafeInteger(config.max_turns, "config.max_turns");
    const toolCallLimit = Math.min(nonNegativeSafeInteger(config.max_tool_calls, "config.max_tool_calls"), nonNegativeSafeInteger(thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls, "thread.tool_policy.max_tool_calls"));
    signal.throwIfAborted();

    const workspaceRoot = path.resolve(workspace);
    const root = await withAbort(() => jailedPath(workspaceRoot, thread.tool_policy.working_dir), signal);
    const instructions = await withAbort(() => loadInstructions(root, workspaceRoot, action, thread.system_prompt), signal);
    const context = buildContext(thread, action, sources, config, instructions);
    const messages = context.messages;
    const tools = allowedTools(thread.tool_policy);
    if (tools.some((tool) => tool.name === "submit_episode")) throw new Error("Tool name submit_episode is reserved");
    const definitions = [...tools.map(({ name, description, input_schema }) => ({ name, description, input_schema })), { name: "submit_episode", description: "Submit the one terminal handoff episode for this bounded task. Runtime metadata is assigned by the store.", input_schema: jsonSchema(episodeSubmissionSchema) }];
    const provider = new HTTPProvider(config);
    const toolContext: ToolContext = { root, policy: thread.tool_policy, signal, touched };
    const auditWithTimeout = async (name: string, detail: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> => {
      await withAbort(() => audit(name, detail), signal);
    };
    let calls = 0;
    let repairRequested = false;
    let finalText = "";
    const finish = async (submission: EpisodeSubmission, error?: EpisodeError, strictUsefulFiles = true): Promise<WorkerOutcome> => {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      const safeSubmission = redactSubmission(submission);
      const usefulFiles: UsefulFileOutcome[] = [];
      for (const file of safeSubmission.useful_files ?? []) {
        try {
          usefulFiles.push(await normalizeUsefulFile(file, root, workspaceRoot, signal));
        } catch (fileError) {
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          if (strictUsefulFiles) throw fileError;
        }
      }
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      return { ...safeSubmission, useful_files: usefulFiles, thread_id: thread.thread_id, created_at: now(), requested_action: action, token_usage: usage, duration_ms: Date.now() - started, source_episode_refs: context.sourceIds, ...(error ? { error } : {}) };
    };

    let stopForFallback = false;
    for (let turn = 0; turn < maxTurns + 1; turn++) {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      const response = await withAbort(() => provider.chat(messages, definitions, config.worker_model, signal), signal);
      usage = addUsage(usage, response.usage ?? emptyUsage());
      const responseText = typeof response.text === "string" ? response.text : "";
      if (responseText.trim()) finalText = responseText;
      const toolCalls = Array.isArray(response.tool_calls) ? response.tool_calls : [];
      messages.push({ role: "assistant", content: responseText, ...(toolCalls.length ? { tool_calls: toolCalls } : {}) });

      if (!toolCalls.length) {
        if (!repairRequested) {
          repairRequested = true;
          messages.push({ role: "user", content: "VALIDATION ERROR: You ended without submit_episode. Call submit_episode now with a truthful schema-valid handoff. This is your only repair turn." });
          continue;
        }
        stopForFallback = true;
        break;
      }

      const onlyToolCall = toolCalls.length === 1 ? toolCalls[0] : undefined;
      if (repairRequested && (!onlyToolCall || onlyToolCall.name !== "submit_episode")) {
        const message = "The repair turn may only call submit_episode; none of this turn's tools were executed.";
        for (const call of toolCalls) messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message }) });
        outcomes.push({ key: "worker_protocol", value: truncate(message, 1000) });
        stopForFallback = true;
        break;
      }

      const submissionCalls = toolCalls.filter((call) => call.name === "submit_episode");
      if (submissionCalls.length && toolCalls.length !== 1) {
        const message = "submit_episode must be the only tool in the terminal response; none of this turn's tools were executed";
        const instruction = "Call submit_episode once with a truthful schema-valid handoff. This is your only repair turn.";
        for (const call of toolCalls) messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message, instruction }) });
        outcomes.push({ key: "worker_protocol", value: truncate(`${message}. ${instruction}`, 1000) });
        repairRequested = true;
        continue;
      }

      for (const call of toolCalls) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        if (call.name === "submit_episode") {
          try {
            return await finish(episodeSubmissionSchema.parse(parseArguments(call.arguments)));
          } catch (error) {
            signal.throwIfAborted();
            const message = redactedErrorMessage(error);
            outcomes.push({ key: "submit_episode", value: truncate(`Invalid episode submission: ${message}`, 1000) });
            if (repairRequested) {
              messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message, instruction: "Episode remained invalid after the repair turn; falling back to a transcript-derived partial handoff." }) });
              stopForFallback = true;
              break;
            }
            repairRequested = true;
            messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message, instruction: "Repair your episode and call submit_episode once. This is your only repair turn." }) });
            continue;
          }
        }

        if (++calls > toolCallLimit) throw new Error("Worker tool-call limit exceeded");
        const selected = tools.find((tool) => tool.name === call.name);
        if (!selected) {
          const message = redactRequiredText(`Tool ${call.name} is not granted by this thread's policy`);
          messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message }) });
          continue;
        }

        if (selected.is_mutating) {
          await auditWithTimeout("tool.mutation_started", { tool: selected.name, environment_may_have_advanced: true });
          mutated = true;
        }

        let text: string;
        try {
          const toolArguments = parseArguments(call.arguments) as Parameters<typeof selected.execute>[0];
          const result = await withAbort(() => selected.execute(toolArguments, toolContext), signal);
          text = truncate(redactRequiredText(stringifyUnknown(result)), 24000);
        } catch (error) {
          signal.throwIfAborted();
          const message = redactedErrorMessage(error);
          messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: JSON.stringify({ error: message }) });
          await auditWithTimeout("tool.failed", { tool: selected.name, error: message, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated });
          continue;
        }

        outcomes.push({ key: selected.name, value: truncate(text, 1000) });
        messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: text });
        await auditWithTimeout("tool.completed", { tool: selected.name, is_mutating: selected.is_mutating });
      }

      if (stopForFallback) break;
      if (turn === maxTurns - 2) messages.push({ role: "user", content: "Turn budget is almost exhausted. Submit your best truthful complete or partial episode now." });
    }

    const files: { path: string; role: string }[] = [];
    for (const file of touched) {
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      try {
        const resolved = await withAbort(() => jailedPath(root, file), signal);
        const info = await withAbort(() => stat(resolved), signal);
        if (info.isFile()) files.push({ path: file, role: "File modified during this worker run; inspect to verify the current state" });
      } catch (error) {
        signal.throwIfAborted();
        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== "ENOENT") outcomes.push({ key: "touched_file", value: truncate(redactRequiredText(`Unable to inspect ${file}: ${messageFromError(error)}`), 1000) });
      }
    }

    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const fallbackResults = outcomes.slice(-80);
    const outcomeSummary = fallbackResults.map((outcome) => `${outcome.key}: ${outcome.value}`).join("\n");
    const summarySource = finalText.trim() ? finalText : outcomeSummary.trim() ? outcomeSummary : "Worker ended without a final message or useful tool outcomes.";
    const fallbackSubmission = episodeSubmissionSchema.parse({ summary: truncate(redactRequiredText(summarySource), 4000), useful_files: files.slice(0, 80), results: fallbackResults, open_questions: ["The worker did not submit a validated handoff; verify these transcript-derived results."], next_steps: ["Verify the actual workspace state before continuing."], status: "partial" });
    return await finish(fallbackSubmission, { type: "episode_not_submitted", message: "No episode was submitted after the repair request; a partial handoff was extracted from actual transcript and tool outcomes.", recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated }, false);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof WorkerFailure) throw error;
    throw new WorkerFailure({ type: signal.aborted ? "worker_timeout" : "worker_failure", message: truncate(redactedErrorMessage(error), 4000), recoverable: true, environment_may_have_advanced: mutated }, usage, Date.now() - started);
  }
}
```
